verses.text: Thumaan lote thukhuppihna zui loin, mi mawhte lampi ah a ding lo mi, mi thusim lote tutna ah a tu lo mi in thupha ngah mi ahi hi.
Ama nopsakna pen Yahweh’ Thukham sung bek hi a, amah in sun leh zanin Ama Thukham a lungngaingai hi.
Amah pen a gah hunin a gah, a teh a vul ngei lo, luitui luang gei-a kisuan singkung tawh ki bang ding a, a sepna peuhpeuh ah a daupai ding hi.
Thumaan lo mite tua bang hi lo uh a, huih letkhiat anvai tawh kibang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thumaan lote in thukhenna thuak zo lo ding uh a, thumaan mite’ pawl sungah mi mawhte om zo lo ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in thumaan mite lampi thei a, ahi zongin thumaan lote lampi a siamang ding hi.

headings.text: Yahweh a Muangte Thupha Ngah ahi

verses.text: Bang hangin minam dangte hehin, mite in thu mawknapi sawmsim uh ahi hiam?
Leitung kumpite dingto-in, gam-ukte in Yahweh leh a Sathau nilhpa langpanin vaihawm uh a,
“Amau hong gaknate sukham mang nila, amau hong puaksak hakkolte i kiang panin lawnkhia ni,” a ci uh hi.
Vantungte ah a tupa in amaute thusim loin nuihsan lel ding a, Yahweh in amaute zahpih ding hi.
Amah in hehna tawh amaute hopih ding hi. Ama lungkim loh luatna tawh amaute lausakin,
“Ka mual siangtho Zion Mual tungah Ka Kumpipa ka tusak hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh’ genkhiat thupiakna ka tangko ding hi: Yahweh in kei kiangah, ‘Nang pen Ka tapa na hi a, tuni-in na pa ka suak khin hi.
Hong ngen in, Na luah dingin minamte kong pia ding hi. Lei mongte zong Nangma neihsa hi ding hi.
Sik pum tawh minamte na satzan ding a, leibeel kitam them bangin amaute na suzan ding hi!’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin no gam-ukte khempeuh aw, pilvang unla, no leitung thukhente aw thu thei un.
Note khempeuh in zahtakna tawh Yahweh’ na sem unla, liing kawmin nuam un.
Tapa nam un, tua bang hi keileh Ama hong heh kha ding a, Ama hehna tawmcik bek hong kitawhkuang ciangin lampi panin na siamang ding uh hi.

headings.text: Yahweh aw, kote’ lum na hi!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, ko hong gimsakte pung mahmah uh hi! Kote langah mi tampi pang uh hi.
“Yahweh kiangah amaute a huh ding kuamah om lo hi!” ci-in kote’ thu a gen mi tampi om hi. Selah.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang pen ko aa dingin kidalna lum lianpi na hi hi! Yahweh aw, kote nong lamto a, ka minthanna uh na hi hi!
Ka aw uh tawh nang tungah kong kiko uh a, Na mual siangtho panin kote nong za hi! Selah.
Eite lumin i ihmu a, tua khit ciangin i khanglokik hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in eite hong nuntasak lai hi.
I kiimkot khempeuh-a ei hong langpang mi tulsawm tampite i kihta kei ding hi.
Yahweh aw, tho inla, kote hong honin, ka galte uh beeng mang in! Yahweh aw, nangmah in ka galte uh paang na beengkhin a, migilote’ ha na sutan hi.
A lian Yahweh aw, hotkhiatna pen nang aa hi a, Na mite tung mahmah ah na thupha om tahen. Selah.
A thumaan kote vanglianpa Yahweh aw, nang kong sap uh ciangin kote hong dawng in. Ka lungkham hun lai-un noptuam nong pia a, tu-in kote nong hehpihkhin hi! Kong thungetna uh hong dawng in!
Ala, no mihingte aw, bang tanvei Yahweh’ minthanna maizumna suaksak ding na hi uh hiam? Bang tanvei thu mawkna deihin, zuau thu zongzong lai ding na hi uh hiam?
Yahweh in Ama aa dingin thumaan mite a koihtuamna thu thei limlim un. Eite in thumaan ding hahkat i hih manin Yahweh i sap ciangin Amah in eite hong za ding hi.
Zahtak unla, mawhna bawl kei un; ka lungsim takpi tawh ka sem ding hi, ci un. Na lupna tungah zong Yahweh zahtak un! Zahtak un! Selah.
A thumaan biakpiaknate pia unla, Yahweh sungah muanna nei un.
“Kote, kua in thumaan lampi hong lak ding ahi hiam?” a ci mi tampi om hi. Yahweh aw, ko tungah na maipha hong tangsak inla, na thumaan lampite amaute lak in.
Ka lungtang sung uh ah nopsakna nong koihzo a, ka ante uh leh ka leenggahzu tampi a phak hun anlak hun sangin nong lungdamsak zaw hi, Yahweh aw!
Lungnuamin lumin lungnuamin ka ihmu ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in muanhuaina sungah kote nong tengsak hi! Nangmah bek in hih thute na sem thei hi!

headings.text: Nang Hong Muangte Lungdam uh hen!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, ka thute uh na bil hong ngat inla, ka thuumnate uh hong ngaihsutsak in!
Yahweh kote Kumpipa aw, Nang tungah kong kiko uh hi! Kote thungetna awgingte hong ngai in.
Yahweh aw, ka awte uh zingsangin na za ding hi. Ka thungetnate uh nang lam kong ngat ding uh a, lametna tawh kong ento uh hi.
Gitlohna nuam a sa Pa na hi kei a, nang tawh siatna teng khawm thei ngei lo ding hi.
Nangma muhna ah mimawhte ding thei lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh thukham zuilo-a gamtate khempeuh na mudah hi.
Nangmah in zuau thugente na susia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in mi that nuamte leh mi khem nopna lungsim a neite a kih hi.
Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, Yahweh’ Inn sungah Nangma hehpihna tampi tawh kong pai ding uh a, Nangma omna siangtho lam nga-in zahtak takin kong bia ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, gal tampi nei ka hih manun nangma thumaanna sungah kote hong makaih in. Kote mai-ah Nangma lampi mansak inla, tangsak in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute kam sungah thuman om lo hi. Amau sungah kisiatna om a, leii zuaute tawh hong phat mawkmawk laitakun amau kammalte in hankhuk lam bek manawh hi.
Yahweh aw, amaute a mawh-in seh in! Amau khensatnate mah tawh amaute puksak in! Amaute in Nang hong lehdo uh ahih manin amau thupalsatna tampite hangin amaute lawnkhia in.
Ahih hangin Nang hong muang mi khempeuh lungdam uh hen! Amaute na dalna hangin lungdamin awng den uh hen! Yahweh aw, Na Min a itte in nangma sung nuamsa uh hen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nangmah in thumaan mite thupha na pia ding a, Na thupitna tawh kidalna lum bangin kote nong tuam ding hi.
Yahweh aw, Na heh laitak hong taii kei inla, Na lungso laitak hong thuhilh kei in.
Yahweh aw, thaneem ka hih manun kote hong hehpih in! Yahweh aw, ka guhte uh na lua-in hong zen ahih manin hong damsak in!
Yahweh aw, ka hin gim mahmah uh hi; bang tanvei sawt lai ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh aw, hong kik inla, hong honkhia in! Na hehpih theihna hangin kote hong hon in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh sihna ah Nang hong kiphawk thei lo a, hankhuk panin Na Min kiphat thei lo hi!
Ka tautauna-un ka zawm ta uh hi. Zan tawntungin ka lupna tung uh khitui tawh kidim a, ka kahna uh tawh ka delhphahte uh a kawt hi.
Ka dahna uh hangin ka mitte uh mial a, ka galte khempeuh hangin ka mitte uh a zawm hi!
No siatna a gamtate aw, ko kiang panin paikhia un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kote kahna awging za zo hi.
Yahweh in ka thungetnate uh hong sangkhin a, amah in kote thuumna a za zo hi.
Ka galte khempeuh uh maizumin, thakhatin buaigawp tahen! Amaute nungkikin, nakpi-in maizum ta uh hen!
Kote Kumpipa Yahweh aw, Nang kong muang uh hi! Yahweh aw, ko hong bawlsia ka langte khempeuh kiang panin hong hu inla hong hon in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in humpinelkai bangin kote hong bal uh a, hong hun ding a om loh laitakin hong balnen uh hi.
Kote Kumpipa Yahweh aw, kote khut in khialhna a neih leh, hong siatvat in.
Dikna pen gitlohna tawh thukin, a thu omlo pi-in ka suk uh leh,
ka galte un hong delhin, hong pha uh hen! Hi hi, leilak ah ka nuntakna uh amaute hong tuancilsak inla, leivui lakah ka minphatna uh sialpaisak in. Selah.
A lian Yahweh aw, kote hih bangin ka gamta kei uh hi! Na hehna tawh amaute langah pang in! Ka galte uh hehluatna hangin khanglo-in thu khen in!
Tua khit ciangin nangma kiimkot ah mihonte kikhawmsak in! Amaute na khualna hangin kote kiangah hong paikik in, Yahweh kote Kumpipa aw!
Yahweh in minamte thu khen ding hi! Kote thumaanna leh ko sunga om dikna tawh kizui-in thu hong khen in!
A lian Yahweh aw, ka lungtangte uh leh ka lungsimte uh hong sin in. Yahweh kote Kumpipa aw, mi gilote siatna beisak inla, mi thumaante kipsak in.
Eite kidalna pen lungsim thutangte a hu Yahweh kiang pan ahi hi.
Yahweh pen a thutang Thukhenpa hi a, thupalsatte tungah nisimin Yahweh a heh hi.
Mi khat a kisik nop loh ciangin Yahweh in a namsau taathiam a, Amah in a thal kekin kigingsa-in a om hi.
Amah in sih theihna nazatte bawlkhol zo a, mi bawlsiate langpanin Ama meikuang thaltangte thu a pia hi.
En in, thupalsatte in mawhna paai uh a, a sungah siatna gaii a, zuau thu a suakkhia hi.
Dum bawlin a to mipa, ama bawlsa guam sungah a kia ding hi.
Ama bawl buai-na ama lu tung mah ah tu ding a, ama ngongtatna ama luguh tung mah ah tu ding hi.
Yahweh kote Kumpipa aw, Nangma thumaanna tawh kizui-in Nang kong phat ding uh hi! A Lianpen Kumpi Yahweh aw, Na Min phatna la ka sa ding uh hi!
Ukna lianpen a nei Kumpi Yahweh aw, leitung khempeuh ah Na Min lian lua mahmah hi! Vantungte tungah Na minthanna kiptakin na koih hi.
Nangmah in galte daisakin, phulapa a kisukgawp nadingin naupangte leh nawiteep lai naungekte kam panin thahatna na kipsak hi.
Na vantungte, Na khutmete tawh na bawl na nasepna, Nangmah in na kipsak kha leh aksite ka lungngaih uh ciangin,
Na ngaihsut tham dingin mihing in bang hilel ahi hiam? Ama kiang na hawh tham dingin mihing’ tapa bang hilel ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in vantungmite sangin a ngiamzaw deuhin amah na bawl a, ahih hangin Nangmah in minthanna leh pahtawina lukhu na khusak ding hi.
Na khuta na nasepte a uk dingin mihing na bawl a, na khempeuh ama khenuai ah na koih ding hi;
Hi hi, tuu leh bawngtal khempeuh, gamlak gamsate khempeuh,
huihlak vasate leh tuipi ngasa khempeuh leh gunpite tawnin tuipite ah a pai peuhmah, mihing ukna nuai-ah na koih ding hi.
Leitung Kumpi Yahweh aw, leitung khempeuh ah Na Min lian mahmah hi!

headings.text: Leitung ah Na Thukhenna Hong Tung Tahen, Yahweh!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nang kong phat ding uh a, Na bawl na lamdangte ka genkhia ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Na Min phatna ka sa ding uh a, Nangma sungah nuamin ka kipaak ding uh hi!
Ka langte uh a taimang ciangin, Nangma mai-ah pukin a kisia ding uh hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in kote thutanna leh ka thu uh nong letkipsak a, Na kumpi-tokhom tungah tu-in thumaan takin thu na khen hi.
Nangmah in mi ngongtatte na taii a, migilote na susia hi! Migilo khempeuhte’ min a tawntungin na phiatkhia hi!
Ka galte uh tungah mong nei lo suksiatna tung a, Nangmah in amau khuapite susia-in, ka galte uh min kiphawknate nangawn a kisiamang khin hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh mang tawntung lai ding hi; Amah in thukhen nadingin Ama kumpi-tokhom bawlkhol zo hi.
Yahweh in thumaan takin leitung thukhen ding a, Ama mite khempeuh tungah thutang taka thukhenna zang ding hi.
Yahweh pen haksat hun ciangin eite Bukna hi a, a kinengniam mite aa ding zong ahi hi.
Na Min a theite in Nang hong muang ding uh hi! Nang hong zong mite na nusia kei ding hi!
Zion ah omin a uk Yahweh tungah phatna la sa un! Mite lakah Ama nasepnate tangko un.
Amah in sisan phulapa thu a sit ciangin amaute a phawk hi; Yahweh in a mi kiniamkhiatte kikona a mangngilh kei hi.
Hehpihna a nei Yahweh aw, kote hong hehpih in! Sihna kongpite panin hong domto pa aw, hong mudahin hong bawlsia ka galte zia hong en in;
Tua ahih ciangin Zion’ tanu’ kongpite ah Nangmah phatna ka pulaak ding uh a, Nangma hotkhiatna ah nuam ka sa ding uh hi!
Amau’ bawlsa dum sung mah ah minamte kiasuk uh a, amau ngen ah amau khe mah a awk hi!
Yahweh pen Ama thukhenna tawh kithei hi; tua ahih ciangin migilote pen amau khut tawh a bawlsa thang ah a awk uh hi! Higgaion; Lungngai dide. Selah.
Migilote hankhuk sungah kia leuleu ding a, Yahweh a mangngilh minamte kisia ding hi.
Mizawngte kimangngilh tawntung lo ding a, mizawngte lametna bei paisuak lo ding hi.
Yahweh aw, tho in! Mihing gualzosak kei in! Na muhna ah minamte thu kikhen hen!

Vanglian Yahweh aw, minamte in amaute mihing a hih lelna uh a theih nadingin nakpi-in lausak in! Yahweh aw, tho in! Mihing gualzosak kei in! A Lian Yahweh aw, leitung ah Na thukhenna hong tungsak ta in! Selah.
Yahweh aw, bang hangin gamla din na hi hiam? Ka haksat hun uh ciangin bang hangin kibucip na hi hiam?
Migilote in kiphatsakna tawh mizawngte delhin bawlsia uh a, amau ngaihsut vaihawmna mah ah amaute awksak in!
Migilo in ama lungsim deihna kisaktheihpih a, amah in Nangma muhdah a mi huaihamte thupha a pia hi!
Migilo in Nang hong zong lo ding hi! A kiphasakna hangin ama ngaihsutna sungah Nang na om kei hi!
Na thukhennate ama muh zawh hi lo a, ama lampite dahna vive a hi lel hi. Amah in a galte khempeuh; Na Thukhamte, a nehpiksanin,
a lungsim sungah amahmah kikhemin, ‘Lungkhamna nei lo ding ka hih manin kei hong kilok zo ngei lo ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Ama kamsung ah samsiatna, zuauna leh khemna tawh kidim a, a leii nuai-ah khemna, buai-na leh mawhna a om hi!
Amah in khuaneute ah mi buksim a, mun simthamte ah mawhbaang lo mite a that hi; ama mittangte in a huh ding omlo mite ensim gige hi.
A kua sunga om humpinelkai bangin Amah in buk khikhe a, haksatna a tuak mite manin, ama ngen sungah amaute a kilawn hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a mi cimawhte sugawp dingin buksim a, ama thahatna nuai-ah a huh ding nei lo mite a puk uh hi.
Amah in a sia ama lungsim sungah, ‘Yahweh in mangngilh zo hi! Amah in Ama maitang seel a, a mu kei hi!’ a ci hi!
Yahweh aw, hong tho in! Na khut liik to in! Na mi kiniamkhiatte mangngilh kei in.
Bang hangin migilopa in Yahweh gensia ding ahi hiam? Bang hangin thumaan lo mipa in, ‘Yahweh in hong sit peuhmah lo ding hi,’ ci-in kingaihsun ding ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin Nangmah in hih thu na mu zo hi! Hi hi, Na khut tawh na thukkik dingin lungkhamna leh khasiatna na ciamteh hi! Nang kiangah a huh ding a omlo mite hong ki-ap hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen pa nei lote a huhpa na hi hi.
Migilopa khutte suktansak in! Bangmah na muh nawn loh dongin ama gitlohna beisiangsak in!
Yahweh pen Kumpi hi tawntung a, minamte Ama gam panin a kibeimangsak hi.
Yahweh aw, tu-in lungnemte ngetna na za zo hi. Lungnemte’ lungtang na hatsak ding a, amaute Na bil tawh na zasak ding hi;
pa nei lote leh a kinengniamte a kivaihawmsak nading hi a, tua hileh leitung mihingte in nengniam nawn lo ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Nang kong muang uh hi. Bang hangin ko kiangah, “Vasa bangin na mualtung uh ah taimang un;
bang hang hiam cihleh ka galte un a thalte uh kek uh hi. Amaute in lungsim thutangte a simtham takin a kap ding, khuamial sung panin a kap dingin a thaltangte uh kigingzo uh hi.
Bulpite kisusia leh, thumaan mite in bangcih thei nawn ding ahi hiam?” hong ci ding na hi hiam?

Yahweh pen a siangtho Ama munsiangtho ah om a, vantung ah Yahweh’ kumpi-tokhom a om hi. Yahweh’ mit in a vekpi-in mu hi. A mitvun in mihingte entelin, a mitte in na khempeuh mu a, Amah in mihingte a ze-et hi.
Yahweh in mi thumaante encian a, ahih hangin Amah in migilote leh ngongtatna nuam a sate a mudah hi.
Yahweh in migilote tungah thangzaak, kaat, meikuang leh huihsate a zusak hi. Hih pen a ngah ding uh amau sehtan hai ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen thumaan a, Amah in Ama mi thumaante a it hi. Yahweh’ maitang in lungsim thuthangte khempeuh a en hi.

headings.text: Gilote kiang pan hong Kem In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, kote hong huh in; bang hang hiam cihleh mi thumaan om nawn lo hi! Mihingte lak panin a citak mite puk mang ta uh hi!
Amaute in a sanggampa uh tawh thu mawkna teng gen a, phat khemna muk leh lungsim nih tawh thu a gen uh hi.
A Lian Yahweh in phat khemna muk khempeuh paaikhia ding a, kiphatsakna a zang leii a sattan ding hi;
Tua mite in, ‘I leii tawh i gualzo ding hi. I kamte ei aa hi a, tua ahih ciangin ei tunga hong uk kua ahi hiam?’ a ci uh hi.
Mizawngte kinengniam a, micimawhte khuisa uh hi! Tua ciangin Yahweh in, ‘Tu-in ka tho ding a, Ka hotkhiatna a lunggulh mipa tungah Ka hotkhiatna ka pia ding hi!’ ci ding hi.
Yahweh’ Thukhamte pen a siangtho Thukhamte hi a, tungman sunga meikuang sungah sagihvei a kisiangsak ngun tawh kibang hi.
Yahweh aw, tuate na kemcing ding hi! Hih khang panin tuate na dal ding hi.
Yahweh aw, miginalote a kitawisan ciangin mun khempeuh ah migilote a vak kawikawi uh hi.
Yahweh aw, bang tanvei kote hong mangngilh ding na hi hiam? Bang tanvei na maitang seel ding na hi hiam? A tawntung ding ahi hiam?
Bang tanvei ka lungsim sung uh ah dahna tawh nisimin kibuanbuan lai ding ka hi uh hiam? Kote tungah ka galte uh bang tanvei kitawisang lai ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh kote Kumpipa aw, ngaihsun inla hong za in. Ka hakkolte uh hong zaangsak in; tua bang hi keileh sihna ah kote ka ihmu ding uh a,
tua ciangin ka galte un, ‘Amaute langah ka gualzo uh hi!’ ci ding uh hi. Tua hi a, ka ki-lin uh ciangin ko hong buaisakte nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin kote in Na hehpihna lianpi ka muang uh hi; Nangma hotkhiatna ah ka lungtangte uh nuam ding hi!
Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, ko tungah hong cingh na hih manin la kong sak ding uh hi.

headings.text: Yahweh aw, Na mite kiangah na hotkhiatna sawl in!

verses.text: Mihai pa in a lungsim sungah, “Vanglian Khat beek om lo hi!” a ci hi. Amaute kihhuai gamtat mangkhin uh a, mihai pa’ nasemnate a siagawp hi. Thumaanin a gamta khat beek om lo hi.
Mihingte in a theitel thei uh hiam, amaute in Amah a zong uh hiam, cih a theih nadingin vantungte panin Yahweh in mihingte a ensuk hi.
Amaute khempeuh kihhuai mangkhin uh a, lampial mangkhin uh hi! A siangtho khat beek omlo a, khat beek zong thumaanin gamta lo hi!
Amau anlum a nek bangun Ka mite a ne hih a gamtatsia mite in thu theihna nei lo ahi uh hiam? Mawhna a bawl amaute in Yahweh min lo lo uh a,
Ahih hangin zahtakna a nei mi om a, Yahweh in midik khanggui ahi eite hong ompih hi.
Note in mizawngte’ geelna na zumhuaisak uh hangin, Yahweh in kote bukna ahi hi!

Aw, Israyl a kihotkhiat nading Zion panin hong paikhia leh maw! Yahweh aw, Na mite kiangah hotkhiatna hong sawl lecin maw! Yahweh aw, Na mite saltanna pan hong paikhiatpih in! Nangma hotkhiatna hong tun ciangin Yaaqob in nakpi-in nuamsa ding a, Israyl kipaak mahmah ding hi.

headings.text: Nang tawh Kua Om Ding, Yahweh?

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Na Inn sungah kua omkip ding ahi hiam? Na mual siangtho ah kua teng ding ahi hiam?
Thutang takin kalsuanin, a lungtang ah a man thu a gen pa pen thumaan takin gamta hi. Yahweh aw, hih mite Nang tawh om thei ding a, Na mual siangtho ah teng thei ding uh hi.

Amah in a sanggampa gensia lo a, a lawmpa tungah zong siatna bawl lo hi; amah in a leii tawh gensia loin kosia lo hi. Yahweh aw, hih mite Nang tawh om thei ding a, Na mual siangtho ah teng thei ding uh hi.

Amah in migilote simmawh a, ahih hangin Nang hong itin hong zahtak mite a pahtawi hi. Ama natna ding nangawn ah ciampel loin a kikhelkhel lote Nang tawh om thei ding hi, Yahweh aw! Hih mite Na mual siangtho ah teng thei ding uh hi.

Amah in ama mipihte tungah summet kha lo a, mawhbaang lo mite langah golhguk a la kei hi. Hihte bangin a gamta mipa pen cikmahin kiliing ngei lo ding a, Nang tawh om thei ding hi, Yahweh aw! Hih mite Na mual siangtho ah teng thei ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, hong kemcing in! Kote muanna in Nangmah ahi hi!
Kote in Nang kiangah, “Nang pen kote Pa leh ka Thumaanpa na hi hi! Nangmah bek na hi hi!” kong ci uh hi.
Leitunga a thuman misiangthote pen ka lawmte uh leh ka lungkimna uh hi a, kote muanna in Nangmah ahi hi.
Pasiante (elohim) a zong mite, amau dahna a khang hi! Amau sisan biaknate i pia kei ding a, amau minte zong lawhin i nei kei ding hi.
Yahweh pen eite sehtan leh i gamh ahi hi. Kote hai sehtan, ka ngah ding uh nong kepcingsak hi.
Ka gamgite uh mun nuamte ah tu khin a, kote in gamh hoih ka nei taktak uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nang kong phat ding uh hi! Nangmah in ngaihsutna na hong pia a, zan hun sungin kote lungsim ah nong thuhilh hi.
Ka mai-ah Yahweh ka omsak tawntung hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Ama taklam khut ah kei ka om hi. Tua hi a, kei kikhin loin zong ka liing kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kei hong ompih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka lungsim kipaak a, ka thupitna zong a lungdam hi! A Lian Yahweh aw, nang sungah ka cilesa zong nuam takin a tawlnga ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh hankhuk sungah kei nong nusia kei ding a, Yahweh aw, Nangma Siangthopa muatna na thuaksak kei ding hi.
Nangmah in nuntakna lampite kei nong lak ding hi! Nangma omna ah lungnopna a dimin om hi. A thahat Na taklam khut ah a tawntung nopsaknate a om hi.

headings.text: Nang Hong Muangte Na Hon Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, a man thu hong za inla, kote kikona hong ngai in! Ka thungetnate uh a zuau thei mukte pan ahi kei hi.
Yahweh aw, Na omna panin Na suahtaksak thukhenna hong tungsak ta in. Na mitte in ka thumaanna uh hong mu tahen!

Aw, Nangmah in ka lungtangte uh nong sittelkhin a, zanin kote kiang nong hawh hi; Nangmah in kote nong sinkhin a, bangmah na mu kei ding hi! Ka kamte uh a paukhialh loh ding ka khensat uh hi; Yahweh aw, kote nong ze-et khin zo hi.
Mihing nasepte tawh kisai thu ah, a susiapa’ lampite panin Na Thukhamte tawh ka kikem uh hi.
Na lampite ah kote hong lenkip in; tua hileh ka khete uh taal lo ding a, Na lampite khempeuh ah ka paina uh kip ding hi!
Yahweh aw, a za theipa na hih manin nang kong sam uh hi! Na bil hong ngat inla, ka thugen uh hong za in.
Na taklam khut tawh kote hong hon pa aw, a lamdang nong hehpih-itna kote hong lak in. Yahweh aw, kote langa pang galte kiang panin nang hong muangte na hon taktak hi.
Na kha lianpi liim nuai-ah kote hong seel inla, Na mitnauta bangin kote hong kem in.
Migilo mi nengniamte kiang leh kote hong umcih sih theihna galte kiang panin kote hong kem in.
Kote langah amaute kiphasak takin hong pau uh a, amau thau mah in amau a tuam hi.
Eite lei lakah hong lawnthal dingin amau mitte in hong sal gega uh hi. Amaute in tu-in i kalsuanna khempeuh hong umcih uh a,
Amaute pen sa man nuam humpinelkai tawh kibang a, a buksim khikhe humpinelkai khanglai tawh a kibang uh hi.
Yahweh aw, tho inla, lungkim kei in! Yahweh aw, amaute lawnkhia mang in! Nangma namsau tawh kote hong hon in!

Yahweh aw, tua bang mite kiang pan leh amaute’ thaman hih nuntakna mah ah a ngah leitungzia mite kiang panin Nangma khut tawh kote hong hon in. Na van manpha tawh amau gilpi kidim a, amaute in ta tampi nei-in, a tanote aa dingin a hauhna a nusiat uh hi.

Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, thumaanna tawh Na maitang ka en ding uh a, Yahweh hangin ka lungkim ding uh hi! Yahweh in Amah sutna bangin hong khanlawhsak ciangin, maitang kituahin nang kong en ding uh hi!

headings.text: Yahweh in Thukin zong Khahkhia hi

verses.text: Kote thahatna Yahweh aw, nang kong it uh hi.
Yahweh pen i Suangpi, i Munkip muanhuai, i Honpa ahi hi; kote Thahatna kote Pa aw, Nang sungah muanna ka nei uh hi; ka kidalna, ka Hotkhiatna Ki leh ka Tausang uh na hi hi.
Yahweh samin amah i phat hi; tua ahih ciangin i galte kiang panin eite hong kihon ding hi.
Sihna lunggimnate in ei hong kiimvel a, mi thumaan lo honpite in eite hong lausak hi.
Hankhuk khauhual in eite hong kiimvel a, sihna thangzakte in ei hong dawntuah hi.
I lunggimna ah Yahweh i sam a, i Pa kiangah i kiko hi. Ama mun siangtho panin Amah in i awging leh i kikona hong za hi.
Yahweh lungso-in heh ahih manin, leitung kilokin liing damdam a, mual bulpite a kin hi.
Ama nakvang panin meikhu paikhia a, Ama kam sung pana meikuang in kang ziahziah hi; tua in suang meihol a tawhkuang hi.
Amah in vantungte zalkhia-in kum suk a, Ama khe nuai ah meii vomte a om hi.
Cherub tungah Amah tuang a, huih khate tungah a leng hi.
Amah a seel dingin kikhuhna-in khuamial bawl a, Ama kiimkota Ama succah; Ama buk, pen a mial tuite leh van-a meii sahpite ahi hi.
Ama omna pana a taang panin meii sahpite kikhawm a, gialtangte leh kektangte tawh a kigawm hi.
Yahweh in vantungte panin vangingsak a, Vanglianpenpa in Ama awging, gialtangte leh kektangte a gingkhiasak hi.
Yahweh in a thaltangte lawn a, i galte a kithehthang hi; Amah in khuaphialepte phiasak a, amaute a taikek uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh aw, tai-in na thu hilh ciangin tuipi kingakna dawk a, leitung bulpite a guakin a om hi.
Amah in a sangna panin hong zam sukin, eite hong len a, tui thukpite panin eite hong kaikhia hi.
Amah in a thahat i galte, ei aa dingin a vanglian lua, ei hong mudah mite kiang panin hong honkhia hi.
Amaute in i tuahsiat ni-in hong maituah uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh pen i belh leh i huhpa ahi hi.
Amah in mun tanzau ah ei hong paikhiatpih a, ei tungah Amah lungkim ahih manin hong honkhia hi.
Yahweh in i thumaanna tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia a, sianthona leh i khut mawhbaan lohna tawh kizui-in Amah in hong dinkik hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh eite in Yahweh’ lampite i kemcing a, i Pa kiang panin i kiheikhia kei hi.
Ama thukhennate khempeuh eite mai-ah om a, Ama ngeina kipte khat beek zong i paikhia kei hi.
Ama mai-ah eite i thutang a, mawhna panin i kikem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in i thumaanna hang leh Ama mit ah i khut sianthona tawh kizui-in ei hong dinkik hi.
A hehpih theipa tungah na hehpih theihna na lak a, thutangin a kawkbaang lo mipa tungah thutang-in kawkbaang loin na kilak hi.
A siangtho mi tungah a siangtho-in na kilak a, ahih hangin thu kawi-in a thutak lo mipa tungah ngiansiamin a thukawi-in na kilak hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in haksatna thuakin a kiniamkhiat mite na honkhia ding a, ahih hangin a kiphasakte na niamkoih ding hi.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in ka meivakte uh na kuangsak a, i Pa in khuamial khuavakin a hei hi.
Nangma hangin galkap honkhat ka sugawpzo ding uh a, i Pa hangin eite in kulhpi khat diangin i kanzo ding hi.
Yahweh ahih leh, Ama Ngeina bukimin, Yahweh’ Thukham a manna kilang zo hi. Amah a muangte khempeuh aa dingin kidalna ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh lobuang a Vanglian Kua ahi hiam? I Pa lobuang Suangpi Kua ahi hiam?
Thahatna hong guanin i lampi hong hoihkimsakpa Yahweh ahi hi.
Amah in i khete sazukpi khe bangsak a, a sangna munte ah kiptakin hong dingsak hi.
Amah in galsim dingin i khutte hong pantah hi; tua ahih ciangin i bante in sumngo thal a kek zo hi.
Nangma hotkhiatna lum kote nong piazo a, na taklam khut tawh kote nong kaito hi; na hehpihna lianpi hangin kote nong liansak hi.
Kote nuai-a lampi zaisak na hih manin ka khe uh taal lo ding hi.
Ka galte uh delhin ka pha uh a, amaute a beisiang mateng ka ciahkik kei uh hi.
Amaute a thawhkik theih nawn loh nadingun ka liamsak uh a, kote khe nuai-ah amaute pukkhin uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in galdo dingin kote nong hatsak a, kote langa pang mite, kote khut nuai-ah na tungsak hi.
Ko hong mudahte ka suksiat theih nadingun ka galte’ ngawng kote nong pia hi.
Amaute kiko uh a, ahih hangin a honkhia ding kuamah omlo hi. Amaute Yahweh kiang nangawn ah kiko uh a, ahih hangin Amah in amaute a dawng kei hi.
Huih let mang leivui bangin amaute ka sat vui a, kongzing laka nin bangin amaute ka lawnkhia hi.
Mite hong do-na panin nong honkhia hi. Nangmah in minamte lutangin kote nong bawl a, ka theih ngei loh minamte in kote’ na sem ding uh hi.
Amaute in ko thu a zak phetun ko thu hong mang pah ding uh a, gamdang mite amau leh amau-in hong ki-ap ding uh hi.
Gamdang mite lungkia ding uh a, amau leihawm sung leh amau bukna munte panin liingsa-in hong paikhia ding uh hi.
Yahweh nungta hi! I Suangpi kiphat tahen! I honpa Yahweh kitawisang hen!
I phu hong laksakin, eite khut nuai-ah minamte hong koihsakpa Yahweh ahi hi.
Amah in i galte kiang panin hong honkhia hi! Nangmah in ko hong langpang mite tungah kote nong lamto lai a, a ngongtat mite kiang panin nong hukhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh aw, Gentile mite lakah Nang kong phat ding uh hi! Na Min phatna la ka sa ding uh hi.
Amah in Ama Kumpipa tungah hotkhiatna lianpi pia a, Ama Sathau nilhpa tung, David leh a suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin hehpihna a lak hi.
Vantung kamtaite in Yahweh’ minthanna pulak uh a, van zaipi in Ama khuta a sepnate a tangko hi.
Ni khat khit ni khat thu kigengen a, zan khat khit zan khat theihtelna kilak khiakhia hi.
Amau kammalte a kizak lohna mun ah thugenna ahi a, kampauna ahi zongin om lo hi.
Leitung khempeuh ah amau teci kizel a, lei mong dong ah amau tangthu a tung hi. Amau sungah Amah in khuavak aa dingin inn khat a koih khin hi;
Ama kikhuhna panin zipipa bangin amah hong pai a, tai kidemna-a a gualzo penpa bangin a lawp mahmah hi.
Mainawtin ama manawhna pen a Tungzel Ama Pawi leh vantungte mong khat panin tuate mongte dong ah hi a, Ama hehna panin kuamah kibucip thei lo hi.
Yahweh’ Thukhamte hoihkim a, mihing a pumpi bupin a khel hi. Yahweh’ tecipanna muantak a, mi mawkmawk khat zong a pilsak hi.
Yahweh’ ngeina kipte man a, lungsim nuam sak hi. Yahweh’ thupiaknate siangtho a, mitte tungah thutheihna a puak hi.
Yahweh’ zahtakna pen siang a, a tawntungin kipkho hi. Yahweh’ thukhennate thuman a, thumaan kim hi.
Tuate pen kham sangin deihhuai zaw tham hi; hi hi, kham citak sangin deihhuai zaw taktak hi. Tuate pen khuaizu leh khuailuzu taakte sangin khumzaw hi.
Tua tham loin tuate hangin Na nasemte in thu phawk uh a, tuate zuihna ah thaman lianpi a om hi.
Kua in ama khialhna khentel thei ahi hiam? A kisel ka mawhnate uh panin hong siangsak in.
Mawh kaltangna panin zong Na nasemte hong kem inla, tuate hong uksak kei in. Tua ciangin kote ka thutang thei ding uh a, thupalsatna lianpi panin ka kawkbaang kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh, ka Suangpi leh ko hong Tanpa aw, ka kam uh pana kammalte leh ka lung ngaihngaihnate uh Nangma muhna ah san theih hong hisak in!
Na haksat hun ciangin Yahweh in hong dawng tahen. Yaaqob’ Pa Min in nang hong dal tahen.
Amah in munsiangtho panin nang hong huh ding hong sawl henla, Zion panin nang hong thahatsak tahen.
Amah in na biaknate khempeuh hong phawk henla, na meihal biakpiakna hong sang tahen. Selah.
Amah in na lunggulhna hong ngahsak henla, na geelna khempeuh hong tangtungsak tahen.
Nangma hotkhiatna ah lungdamin ka awng ding uh a, Yahweh i Pa’ Min tawh i lante i khai ding hi! Yahweh in na ngetnate khempeuh uh hong hihsak tahen.
Yahweh in Ama Sathau nilhpa a hot lam tu-in ka thei ta hi; Amah in Ama vantung siangtho panin a taklam khut thahat tawh honin amah a dawng hi.
Mi pawlkhat in leengte muangin adangte in sakolte muang uh a, ahih hangin eite in Yahweh i Pa’ Min i phawk ding hi!
Amaute boksukin puk uh a, ahih hangin eite tho-in i ding tang hi.
Yahweh aw, kote hong hon in! Ka sap uh ciangin Kumpipa in hong dawng tahen!

headings.text: Yahweh aw, Na Hatna hangin Hong Kitawisang Hen!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Na thahatna hangin Kumpipa lungdam hi! Na hotkhiatna ah nakpi takin Amah lungdam hi!
Nangmah in ama lunggulhna na piakhin a, Ama muk in hong ngetna na khaktan kei hi. Selah.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in thumaanna thuphate tawh Amah na dawn hi. Ama lu tungah kham citak kumpi-lukhu na khusak hi.
Amah in Nang kiang panin nuntakna hong ngen a, Nangmah in nuntak tawntungna Amah na pia hi.
Na hotkhiatna tungtawnin Ama minthanna lian taktak hi; pahtawina leh thupitna Ama tungah na koih hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in a tawntungin thupha ngah penin amah na bawlkhin a, Nangma omna-a nopsakna ah Amah na lungkimsak khin hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Kumpipa in Yahweh muang a, Vanglianpenpa’ itna panin cikmahin Amah kihei ngei lo ding hi.
Na khut in Na galte khempeuh mu ding a, Na taklam khut in Nang hong mudahte zong ding hi.
Na heh huna a sa mahmah meiphual kuang bangin amaute na bawl ding hi! Yahweh in a heh ciangin amaute nawmvalh ding a, meikuang in amaute kangtum ding hi.
Leitung panin amau suante na susia ding a, mihingte’ tapate lak panin amau suanlekhakte na susia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Nangma langah thusia geel uh a, a tangtun theih loh uh sawmsimna a vaihawm uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in na thal tawh amau mai na ngim ciangin amau nunglam mah ah amaute na heikik ding hi.
Yahweh aw, Nangma thahatna hangin hong kitawisang hen! Kote in Na vangliatna la sa-in kong phat ding uh hi!

headings.text: Yahweh! Yahweh! Gamla Om Kei In
Yahweh kiangah Leitung Mi Khempeuh Kihei Hen!

verses.text: Ka Thahatna! Ka Thahatna! Yahweh! Yahweh aw! Bang hangin Kei hong taisan na hi hiam? Kei huh nading pan leh ka tauna kammalte panin bang hangin gamla pek ah om na hi hiam?
Yahweh aw, sun hun leh zanin Ka kiko a, Ka dai kei hi; ahih hangin nangmah in nong za kei hi.
Ahi zongin Israyl-te’ phatna teng a ngahpa Nangmah na siangtho hi.
Ka pate un Nang hong muang hi; amaute in Nang hong muang a, Nang in amaute na honkhia hi.
Nang kiangah amaute hong kiko uh a, amaute kihonkhia hi; amaute in Nang hong muang uh a, a zahla kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Keimah mihing hi loin, tangtel ka hi lel a, hong kisimmawh hi. Mite in Kei hong zahpih-in, mipi in kei hong simmawh uh hi.
Kei hong mu-te nui-in, hong nehpik sanin a lu hong peisan uh a,
“Amah in Yahweh muang hi! Yahweh in Amah hon hen! Ama sungah Yahweh lungkim ahih nungsang Yahweh in Amah honkhia hen!” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, Ka nu’ gil sung panin Kei nong la a, Ka nu’ anglum sung nangawn panin Nang hong muang dingin Kei nong bawl hi.
Ka suah-a kipanin Nang tungah Kei hong kipaai a, Ka nu gil sunga pat Nang pen Ka Thahatna na hi hi.
Haksatna hong nai ta ahih manin Kei kiang panin gamla om kei in; Nang lobuang hong huh ding khat beek a om kei hi.
Bawngtal tampi in Kei hong umcih uh a, Bashan’ bawngtalte in Kei hong umcih-in, hong khuhcip uh hi.
Sa manin a hawk humpinelkaite bangin amaute in Kei hong kamkat beba uh hi.
Tui bangin Kei ka kibua khia a, Ka thahatna khempeuh in Kei hong nusia hi. Ka lungtang khuainun bang hi a, Keima sungah tuisuak hi.
Leibeel phel bangin ka thahatna keu a, ka leii in ka dang matcip hi. Nangmah in sihna leivui ah Kei nong paipih zo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh uite leh migilo pawlte in Kei hong umcih uh hi. Amaute in Ka khutte leh Ka khete sulet uh hi;
Ka guh khempeuh ka sim thei hi. Amaute in hong enin, Kei hong sal gega uh hi.
Amaute in amau lakah ka puante balin hawm uh a, Ka puantual; tallit, ahih leh amaute in hawm dingin ai lawn lai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Nang na hih leh Yahweh aw, Kei kiang panin gamla om kei in! Ka thahatna aw, Kei hong huh dingin hong manlang in!
Namsau panin Kei hong honkhia inla, uite’ vangliatna panin a manh nei ka nuntakna hong honkhia in.
Humpinelkai’ kam pan leh gam bawngtalte’ ki panin Kei hong hu in! Yahweh aw, Kei nong dawng khin zo hi! Phatna khempeuh Nangma aa ahi hi!
Ka sanggamte kiangah Na Min ka tangko ding a, mi honpi laizang ah Nang kong phat ding hi.
No Yahweh a zahtakte in Amah phat un! Yaaqob’ suante aw, Amah pahtawi un! No Israyl’ suanlekhakte khempeuh in Amah zahtak un!

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in simmawhna zang loin, a gimte’ thuakna zong kih lo a, Kei kiang panin zong Amah in a mai hong sel lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kiang ka kiko ciangin Amah in hong za hi!
Yahweh aw, mihon lianpi lakah Keima phatna in Nang na hi ding hi! Nang hong zahtak mite mai-ah Ka kamciamnate ka pia ding hi.
Mizawngte in an ne-in gilvah ding uh hi. Halleluyah! Yahweh a zong mite, nungta tawntung uh hen!
Leitung mongte khempeuh in phawkin, Yahweh lamah kihei ding uh hi! Gentile mi innkuante khempeuh Ama mai-ah kun ding uh hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh kumpigam pen Yahweh aa hi a, Amah in minamte uk hi!

Leitunga a haute leh a vangliante khempeuh in ne-in bia ding uh hi; Leitung leivui ah a paisuk amaute khempeuh, Ama mai-ah kun ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute nuntakna ngahkiksak ding hi.
Khaici khat in Ama’ na sem ding a, tua pen Yahweh aa dingin khanggui khatin kiseh ding hi.
Amaute hong pai-in a hong suak ding mite tungah hih Ama sepsa, a thumaanna tangko ding uh hi.
Yahweh pen tuu banga ei hong cingpa hi a, bangmah i kisam kei ding hi.
Lonona ah ei hong lumsak a, tui kiangah ei hong paipih hi.
Yahweh in i nuntakna tha hong dimsak a, Ama min hangin thumaan lampi ah ei hong kha hi.
Hi hi, sihna liim guam sung i nawk hangin, Yahweh in eite hong ompih ahih manin siatna bangmah i kihta kei ding hi. Na molhtum leh na ciangkhut in kote hong lungmuangsak hi.
Ka galte omna mai-ah ko aa ding an nong lui hi. Ka lu sathau nong nilh-a ka hai a dimlet hi.
Hoihna leh hehpihna in ka nuntak sung tawntung hong zui taktak ding a, Yahweh’ Inn sungah ka teng tawntung ding uh hi!
Leitung leh a sunga om khempeuh Yahweh aa hi a, leitung leh mihing khempeuh zong Yahweh aa ahi hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in tuipite leh a tupcipnate tungah leitung a phut hi.
Ama mual ah kua kahto ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ mun siangtho ah kua ding ding ahi hiam?
Khut siangtho-in lungsim siang a nei mipa, pasian (el) khatpeuh tungah a lungsim pia loin, zuaupi-a a kiciam ngei lo mipa, Yahweh’ mun siangtho ah ding ding hi!
Amah in A lian Yahweh kiang panin thupha sang ding a, amah a honkhia Yahweh kiang panin thumaanna ngah ding hi.
Nangmah hong zong kote pen Nangma mai hong zong Yaaqob leh Israyl taktak ka hi uh hi! Hih khang mite in A lian Yahweh zong taktak hi! Selah.
Kulh kongpite aw, na lute uh lamto un! No kongkhakte aw, kikhangto un! Tua ciangin minthang Kumpipa hong pai ding hi!
Minthang Kumpipa kua ahi hiam? Thakhauh-in a thahat Yahweh, gal sunga a thahat Yahweh ahi hi!
Kulh kongpite aw, na lute uh lamto un! Kongkhakte aw kikhangto un! Tua ciangin minthang Kumpipa hong pai ding hi!
Minthang Kumpipa kua ahi hiam? Vanglianpen Yahweh! Thakhauh-in a thahat Yahweh, Amah in Kumpipa ahi hi! Selah.

headings.text: Nang tungah Ka Lungsim uh Kong Lamto
Hehpihna leh Thuman, Yahweh’ Lampi Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Nang tungah ka lungsim uh kong lamto uh hi!
A lian Yahweh aw, Nang kong muang uh hi! Ko tungah ka langte uh hong gualzosak kei inla, kote hong zahlasak kei in!
Nang hong ngakte kuamah zahlasak peuhmah kei in. Thu om lopi-a thupalsatte zahhuaisak in.
Yahweh aw, Nangma ziate hong lak in! Kote Kumpipa aw, na lampite hong hilh in!
Na thuman sungah kote hong makaih inla, hong hilh in. Sun tawntung kong ngak uh hi. Nang pen Yahweh kote hotkhiatna na hi hi! Sun tawntungin Nang kong ngak uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Na hehpihnate hong phawkkik in! Nong hehpih-itnate hong ngaihsun in; bang hang hiam cihleh tanglai peka kipanin tuate a om ahi hi.
Ka khangno lai-a ka mawhnate uh phawk nawn kei inla, ka thupalsatnate zong phawk nawn kei in. Yahweh aw, na thumaanna leh na hehpihna tawh kizui-in, na thumaanna hangin kote hong phawk in.
Thutangin a dik Nangmah Yahweh na hi hi. Nangmah in mi mawhte Na lampi na hilh hi.
Nangmah in lungsim kiniamkhiatte a man ah paipihin, Nangma ziate na hilh hi.
A lian Yahweh’ lampite pen thumaanin man hi. Ama thuciamna leh a Thukham a zuite khempeuh in tua sung tawn den ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, kote mawhna khempeuh lian mahmah ahih manin Na Min na khualna-in hong maisak in. Yahweh aw, Na thumaan lampite khempeuh ka zui tawntung ding uh hi!
A lian Yahweh’ lampite pen hehpihna leh thuman ahi hi! Yahweh a zahtak Mipa kua ahi hiam? Yahweh in Ama telsa lampi a hilh ding mipa ahi hi.
Tua mipa’ nuntakna nuam takin om ding a, ama suanlekhakte in leitung luah ding uh hi; Amaute in A lian Yahweh’ lampite zui uh hi!
Amaute in A lian Yahweh zahtak uh ahih manin amau kiangah Yahweh’ thusim om hi! Amaute in A lian Yahweh zahtak uh ahih manin Yahweh in Ama thuciamna a lak ding hi.
Yahweh in ngen-thang panin i khete hong kaih khiatsak ahih manin i mitte in Yahweh lam en gige den ding hi.
Kote hong kineng lua ahih manin ko lamah hong kihei inla, ko tungah hehpihna hong nei in!
Ka lungsim gimnate uh lian mahmah a, ka lungkhamnate uh panin hong paikhiatpih in.
Ka thuakna uh leh ka natna uh hong en in! Yahweh aw, ko mawhnate khempeuh hong maisak in!
Ka galte uh ngaihsun in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute tamin kote nakpi-in hong mudah uh hi!
Kote nuntakna hong kem inla, hong honkhia in! Yahweh aw, Nang hong muang ka hih manun hong zahlasak kei in.
Nang hong lamen ka hih manun cihtakna leh thutanna in kote hong tuam tahen!
A lian Yahweh aw, Israyl-te amau lungkhamna panin tankhia in!

headings.text: Thu Hong Khen in, Yahweh aw!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, kote tung thu hong khen in, kote ka hoi kei ding uh hi. Lungsim siang takin ka kalsuan ngitnget uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Nang kong muang den uh hi. Tu-in hong sit inla, hong entel in. Yahweh aw, ka lungsim uh leh ka lungtangte uh hong sin in!
Nong hehpih-itna ka mu taktak uh a, Na thuman lampite ka zui uh hi.
Pasian-bia mite tawh ka tu khawm kei uh a, mi hoih kineihkhemte tawh zong ka ton khawm kei uh hi.
Siatna bawl mipawlte ka mudah uh a, migilote tawh ka tu khawm kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, mawhbaan lohna ah ka khut ka sil ding hi; tua hileh Nangma biaknatau ka kiimkot thei ding uh hi.
Lungdam kohna tangko-in Nangma nasep a lamdangte khempeuh ka gen ding uh hi.
Nangma minthanna a tenna mun Yahweh’ Inn ka it uh hi.
Mi mawhte lakah kote hong gawm khawm kei inla, sisan suah thei mite tawh ka nuntakna uh hong la khawm kei in;
Amau khutte pen gihlohna tawh kidim a, amau taklam khut, golhguk tawh a kidim hi.
Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, paubanna om loin ka kalsuan uh hi. Hong tankhia inla, ko tungah hehpihna hong nei in!
Thutang mite lakah ka khe uh ding kip hi! A lian Yahweh aw, mipi lakah dingin Nang kong phat uh hi!
Yahweh pen i khuavak ahi hi! Amah pen i kihotkhiatna ahi hi! Yahweh pen i nuntakna Tha zong ahi hi! Eite in kua kihta ding i hi hiam? Lau nawn ding i hi hiam?
I sa hong ne nuamin i langah i galte hong kuan uh ciangin amaute tukgawp uh hi! I galte tukgawpin puk uh hi!
Mi honkhat in ei langpangin phual a sat zongin i lungsim ah lau-na a om kei ding hi. Ei hong langpangin gal hong kuan hangin zong tua thu ah kimuanna i nei hi.

Yahweh kiang pan thu khat ka deih uh a, tua in ka nuntak sung tawntung ka zon ding uh, Nangma hoihna mu-in Nangma munsiangtho panin Nangma kiang thu kong dot theih nadingun Yahweh’ Inn ah ka ten theih nading uh ahi hi.
Haksat hun ciangin Nangmah in na buk sungah kote nong seel ding a, mun simthama om Nangma Inn sungah kote nong seel ding hi! Suangpi khat tungah kote nong sangkoih ding hi!

Tu-in ka kiimkot-a om ka galte uh tungah ka lute uh kilamto ding hi. Yahweh aw, nang hong kiphat hen! Nang tungah phatna late ka sa ding uh a, Nangma’ Inn sungah lungdam biakpiaknate kong pia ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, nang tungah kong kiko uh ciangin hong za in! Kote hong hehpih inla, hong dawng in!
Nangmah in, ‘Ka mai hong zong un!’ nong cih ciangin, nang tungah ka lungtangte un, ‘Yahweh aw, Na maitang ka zong ding uh hi!’ a ci hi.
Ko kiang panin Na mai hong seel kei inla, hehna tawh na nasemte kiang panin paikhia kei in; Nangmah in ko hong huhpa na hi hi! Kote kihotkhiatna Pa aw, kote hong lawnkhia kei inla, hong nusia kei in!
I pate leh i nute in hong nusiat ciangin zong Yahweh in eite hong sang veve ding hi.
Yahweh aw, Na lampi hong hilh inla, ka galte uh hangin lam phei ah hong paipih in.
Ka langte deihna bangin kote hong nusia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh kote langah teci man lote pang khin uh a, amaute in ngongtatna leh muhdahna hu sang uh hi.
Eite in Yahweh i lunggulh a, a nungtate’ gam sungah Yahweh’ thumaanna i muh ding lamtak i thei hi.
Nakpi-in lungsim thakhauh un! Yahweh muang un, Amah in na lungsim hong khauhsak ding hi! Yahweh ngak un!

headings.text: Nang Kong Muang uh a, Nong Huh

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Nang tungah kong kiko uh hi! Yahweh kote Suangpi aw, kote tungah hong dai dide kei in! Bang hang hiam cihleh kote tungah hong daih dide lecin, a si mite tawh ka kibang ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Nang tungah kong kiko uh ciangin kong thuumnate uh hong za in! A siangtho nangma mun siang lamah ka khutte ka laptoh uh ciangin Yahweh aw, hong za in!
Mawhna bawlin, amau lungsim sungah siatna om napi, a sanggampa tawh kilemna thu a gen khem migilote tawh kote hong paaikhia khawm kei in.
Amau sepna leh amau khuta sepna mah bangin thukkik in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Yahweh’ nasepte ahi a, Ama khutte sepsa peuhmah ahi zong kin lo uh a, Yahweh in amaute hawkkhia ding hi. Amah in amaute lam loin susiazaw ding hi!
Yahweh in eite hong za-in i thuumna awgingte hong za ahih manin Yahweh kiphat hen.
Yahweh pen i Thahatna leh i Lum ahi hi. I lungtangte in Amah muang khin a, Amah in eite hong huh zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin eite lungdam kipaakin Ama tungah phatna late i sa hi!
Yahweh pen i Thahatna leh Ama Sathau nilhpa a Honkhia Thahatpa ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, Na mite hon inla, na luahte thupha hong pia in. Hong vaak inla, hong keem den in!

headings.text: Minthanna, Pahtawina leh Thahatna Nang aa ahi!

verses.text: No mi thahatte aw, minthanna leh thahatna Yahweh aa ci unla, Yahweh aa ci un.
Yahweh tungah Ama Min tawh kituak minthanna pia un! A siangtho kizepnate tawh Amah bia un.
Tuite tungah Yahweh’ awging om a, a minthang Vanglianpa’ aw ging damdam hi; tui tampite tungah Yahweh a om hi.
Vanglian Yahweh’ awging khauh mahmah a, Yahweh’ awging pen thupitna tawh kidim hi.
Yahweh’ awging in tamtak kungte sukham a, Yahweh in Lebanon tamtak kungte a sukham hi.
Amah in bawngno bangin tuate zuansak a, Lebanon leh Sirion-a amaute, gam bawngtalno bangin diangsak hi.
Yahweh’ awging in mei phualpite phalkhen hi!
Yahweh’ awging in sehnel gam lok a, Yahweh’ awging in Kadesh Sehnel gam sing hi.
Yahweh’ awging in sazukpite nau tolhsak a, Yahweh’ awging in gammang tulak susia hi! Ama munsiangtho sungah mi khempeuh in ‘Ama minthanna,’ ci-in a kiko uh hi!
Tuikhang tungah kumpi-tokhom tawh Vanglian Yahweh tu hi! Tawntung Kumpi hihna tawh Yahweh tu hi!
Yahweh in a mite tungah thahatna pia hi! Minthanna, Pahtawina leh Thahatna Nang aa ahi hi! Yahweh in a mite nopsakna thupha pia ding hi!
Yahweh aw, nang kong phat ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in kote nong honkhia khin a, kote tungah ka galte uh na kisialsak kei hi!
Yahweh kote Pa aw, nang tungah kong kiko uh a, nong damsak khin hi!
Nangmah in kote nong nungtasak hi! Nangmah in hankhuk panin kote nong lakhia zo a, dum sungah ka pai ding uh nong phal kei hi.
No Ama misiangthote khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah la sa un! Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un! Nangma Min siangtho phawkin Nangma tungah lungdam kong ko uh hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama hehna tomno sung bek hi a, ahih hangin Ama deihsakna ah nuntakna om hi. Zan hun sung teng kahna om kha mah ding a, ahih hangin zingsangin nuamna hong tung ding hi.
Ngaihmuang ka kisak ciangin, keimah in, ‘Ka liing ngei kei ding hi!’ ka ci hi.
Yahweh aw, kote nong angvan ciangin mual kip khat bangin kote hong kikipsak hi; ahih hangin ko kiang panin na mai na seel ciangin nakpi-in ka buai uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nang tungah kong kiko uh a, kote Pa tungah thuumna kong bawl uh hi.
Hankhuk a tung ding hi zenzen le ung, Nang aa dingin kote’ sisan in bang phattuamna nei ding ahi hiam? Leivui in nang hong phat ding ahi hiam? Leivui in Nangma thuman pulaak ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh aw hong za inla, kote tungah hehpihna hong nei in! Yahweh aw, kote huhpa hong hi in!
Nangmah in ka thuumnate uh laamna-in nong heisak hi! Nangmah in ka puan hampi uh hong suahkhiatsak-in, nakpi-in lungdamna tawh nong tuunna a hang in,
a tawp dongin ka hihna khempeuh uh tawh Nangma phatna ka sak theih na’ng uh ahi hi! Ka dai dide kei ding uh hi! Yahweh kote Siangthopa aw, Nang tungah a tawntungin lungdam kong ko ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, nang kong muang uh hi! Hong zahlasak kei in! Na thumaanna tawh kote hong honkhia in!
Na bil hong ngat inla, hong hon pak in. Kote Bukna Suangpi hong hi inla, kote hong hu ding kidalna Inn hong hi in!
Nangma Min na khualna-in kote hong makaih inla, hong tonpih in; bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen ka Suangpi leh ka Munkip muanhuai uh na hi hi!
Kote hong siah simna ngenthang panin kote hong kaikhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen ka Thahatna uh na hi hi.
Nangma khut sungah ka nuntakna kong ap uh hi; Yahweh, a thuman kote Vantung Pa aw, nangmah in kote nong tankhia zo hi.
Pasiante (elohim) a thupi ngaihsutte ka kih uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang kong muang ngaungau uh hi!
Nangma hehpihna tawh kote lungdamin ka kipaak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka lungkhamnate uh hong mu-in, ka haksat hun uh ah nong donkhin a,
ka galte khut sungah kote nong pia kei hi. Nangmah in mun tanzau ah ka khete uh na dingsak hi.
Yahweh aw, genthei ka hih manun kote hong hehpih in! Kahna hangin ka mitte uh ngui a, dahna in ka pumpi uh netum hi.
Ka nuntakna uh dahna vive hi a, ka hunte uh khuisatna vive ahi hi. Ka mawhna uh leh ka khialhna uh hangin ka thahatna uh bei a, ka guh ka tangte nangawn uh zong ngaam ta hi.
Ka galte khempeuh in hong nehtawh uh a, ka vengte un hong nehtawh phadeuh lai hi; ka meltheihte gimneih ka hi uh hi. Amaute in lampi ah hong mu-in, hong taisan uh hi.
Theihna a nei nawn lo misi khat bangin amaute in kote hong mangngilh uh a, beel kitaam them ka bang lel uh hi.
Mi tampite’ gensimna za ka hih manun ka kiim ka pam uh lauhuai hi! Amaute in kote langah hong sawmsim uh a, amaute in ka nuntakna uh hong laksak sawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang kong muang uh hi! Kote in, ‘Nang pen kote Vantung Pa na hi hi,’ kong ci uh hi.
Ka nuntaknate uh Nangma khut sung ahi hi! Ka galte khut sung pan leh, kote hong delhin hong suulzuih mite kiang panin kote hong honkhia in!
Na nasemte tungah Na mai pha hong tangsak inla, Nangma hehpihna hangin kote hong hu in!
Yahweh aw, nang hong sam ka hih manun kote hong zahlasak kei in! Migilote maizumsak inla, hankhuk sungah amaute dai takin omsak in!
Kiphatsakna leh sinsiatna tawh thumaan mite tungah kampau a khauh, a zuau thei kamte dai didesak in!
Aw, Nang hong zahtakte aa dinga na koih, mihing’ tapate mai-ah Nang hong muang mite aa dingin na bawl ahi Nangma thumaanna leh na citna lian mah si e.
A kiphasak mipa kiang panin Nangma omna a simtham ah kote nong seel ding a, kitotna leiite panin buk khat sungah kote nong keem bit ding hi.
Yahweh kiphat tahen! Bang hang hiam cihleh a ki-umcih khuapi sungah Amah in a lamdang Ama hehpihna eite hong lakzo hi.
Kote in patauhna tawh, ‘Nang muhna panin kote hong kikhenkhia ta ei!’ ka ci uh hi. Tua hi napi-in Nang tungah kong kiko uh ciangin kong ngetnate uh leh kong thuumna awging nong za hi!
No Ama mi siangthote khempeuh aw, Yahweh it un! Yahweh in mi citakte keem hi! No Ama mi siangthote khempeuh aw, Yahweh it un! Yahweh in a kiphasakte thukkik hi!
Nakpi-in hangsan un! Amah in amah lamenin a muang mite tungah thahatna pia ding hi!
A mawhna kimaisakin a thupalsatna a kikhuhsak mi, thupha ngah ahi hi.
Yahweh in mawhna nei-a a seh loh mi, a lungsim ah khemna a paii lo mi, thupha ngah ahi hi.
Sun tawntung i tautauna hangin i daih dide ciangin i guhte a teemgawp hi.
Sun leh zanin ko tungah na khut hong gik hi. Khuakhal hun keu bangin i thahatna teng keu cip hi. Selah.
Nang tungah ka mawhnate uh kong pulaak a, ka khialhnate uh ka im kei uh hi. ‘Yahweh tungah i thupalsatnate i pulaak ding hi’ i ci hi. Nangmah in ko mawhna hanga mawhsakna nong maisak hi.

Hih thu hangin Nang hong kimuh theih hun a hun khat ciangin Nang tungah thumaan mi khempeuh in thu hong ngen uh hen. Hong ki-umcih hun ciangin mun muanhuaina sangin Yahweh hoihzaw a, tuikhauh a khan ciangin Amah a muang mite Ama’n a don hi.
Nang pen kote bukna mun na hi hi! Haksatna panin kote nong keem ding hi! Nangmah in hotkhiatna late tawh nong umcih ding hi! Selah.
Yahweh in, ‘Note kong hilh ding a, na pai nadinga kilawm lampi kong hilh ding hi. Ka mit tawh note kong cing ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Yahweh in, ‘Thutheihna a nei lo sakol bang ahi a, laa-sakol bangin ahi zongin om kei un. Amaute kamkaih leh khau tawh uk kul a, tua bang hi keileh thumang lo ding uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Migilote’ thuakna tampi hi a, ahih hangin Yahweh a muang mipa pen hehpih-itna in umcih ding hi.
Yahweh sungah lungdam unla awng un! Thuman mite Nangma sungah lungdam kipaak uh hi! Yahweh aw, lungsim thutang mite khempeuh, Nang sung nuamsa uh hi!

headings.text: Yahweh in Amah a Zahtakte Mu

verses.text: No thumaan mite aw, Yahweh tungah lungdamin laam un! Phatna pen thutang mite tawh kilawm kituak hi.
Harp khausai tawh Yahweh phat unla, Ama aa dingin lyre zang sawm khausai tum un.
Ama tungah la thak sa unla, a lungdam huai awgingte tawh zaknop takin tum un.
Yahweh’ Thukham thuman hi a, Ama nasepte khempeuh thuman tawh kisem hi!
Amah in thumaanna leh thutanna deih hi! Leitung pen Yahweh’ hehpihna tawh kidim a,
vantungte ahih leh Ama kammal tawh kibawl hi; vantunga a honpite pen Ama kam pana huu tawh kibawl hi! Yahweh aw, Nang kong phat uh hi!
Amah in kholkhopna khat ah tuipite kaikhawm a, tui thukpite vankholna-inn khat ah a koih hi.
Leitung khempeuh in Yahweh zahtak uh hen! Leitung mite in Amah lamdangsakna tawh ding uh hen!
A lian Yahweh pau a, a cih bangin kizo hi! Yahweh in thupia a, kiptakin ding pah hi.
Yahweh in minamte kikhupna a mawkna suaksak hi! Amah in mite ngaihsutna leh a geelnate uh gah neisak lo hi.
Yahweh’ geelna kip tawntung a, Ama lungsim ngaihsutnate khang tawntungin a kip hi! Yahweh aw, Nang kong phat uh hi!
Yahweh pen Pa bangin a thei minamte thupha ngah ahi hi! Ama luahin a teel mite thupha ngah ahi hi!
Vantung panin Yahweh in ensuk a, Amah in mihing’ tapate khempeuh a mu hi.
Ama tenna mun panin Amah in leitunga a teng khempeuh en gige hi;
Amah in amaute’ lungsim thei sinsen a, amau sepnate a mu hi.
Galkap honpi in a hotkhiat kumpi om lo a, thahatna lianpi tawh vanglian mipa kihonkhia lo hi;
Kihotkhiat nadingin sakol pen lametna mawknapi hi a, ama thahatna in khatpeuh zong honkhia thei lo hi.
En un, Yahweh in Amah a zahtak mite mu hi. Amah in Ama hehpihna a lamen mite mu hi!
9 Amah in sihna panin amaute honkhia a, kialpi hun sungah amaute a nungta-in keem hi!
Thumaan Yahweh i ngak hi! Yahweh pen i huhpa leh i lum ahi hi!
Yahweh aw, kote in Na Min siangtho ka muang uh a, Nang sungah nuam ka sa uh hi!
Nang kong muanna uh tawh kizui-in kote tungah Na hehpihna hong tung tahen! Nang kong lamen uh hi!

headings.text: Nang Hong Zong Mite sungah Kisapna Om Lo

verses.text: Yahweh i phat tawntung ding hi. I kam tawh a thumaan ama phatna i gengen ding hi.
Vanglian Yahweh aw, Nang sungah ka nuntakna ka kisathei uh hi. Mi kiniamkhiatte in za henla, lungdam uh hen.
Yahweh liansak ni! Amah phat khawm ni! Tu-in Ama Min tawisang khawm ni!
Yahweh aw, Nang kong zong uh a, ka kikona nong za hi! Ka kihtakte khempeuh panin kote hong honkhia in!
Nang kong mitsuan uh a, ka maitai uh hi. Maizumna in eite cikmahin hong tuam lo ding hi.
Mi kiniamkhiatpa kiko a, Yahweh in amah a za hi. A haksatnate khempeuh panin amah a honkhia hi.
Yahweh zahtakin amah bia mite kiimkot ah Yahweh’ vantungmi in giahphual sat a, amaute a kihonkhia hi.
Yahweh a thumaanna ciam unla, mu un! Nangmah thupha na hi a, Nang hong muang mipa, thupha ngah ahi hi!
No, Ama misiangthote khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah zahtakna pia un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang hong zahtak mite sungah kisapna bangmah om lo hi!
Mihaute kiamin gilkial ding uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh a zongte in na hoih khatpeuh a tasam kei ding uh hi.
No tanote aw, hong pai un; Yahweh zahtakna thu kong hilh ding uh hi!
Gualzawhna a nopsak theih nadingin no lakah kua in a thumaan nuntak sawt deih na hi uh hiam?
Na leii uh siatna gensak kei unla, na mukte uh zuau gensak kei un!
Kilemna zong unla, nung delh un! Siatna panin kihemkhia unla, thumaanin gamta un!
Yahweh’ mit in thumaan mite en a, amau kikona a za dingin Ama bilte a hong hi.
Leitung panin siatna a bawl mite a kiphawk khak nawn loh nadingin Yahweh’ maitang in siatna a bawl mite langpan hi.
Thumaan mite kiko a, Yahweh in amaute’ kikona a za hi. Amah in amaute’ haksatna khempeuh panin a honkhia hi.
Lungsim kitamzante kiangah Yahweh nai om a, lungsim zangawpte a hon hi.
Thumaan mite thuakna tampi hi a, ahih hangin Yahweh in tuate khempeuh panin amaute a honkhia hi.
Amah in Ama guhte khempeuh keem a, tuate khat beek zong kitan lo hi!
Siatna in migilote that ding a, thumaan mudah mite kimawhsak ding hi.
Yahweh in ama nasemte’ nuntakna tankhia hi! Yahweh a muang mite kuamah kimawhsak lo ding hi!
Yahweh aw, ko hong langpangte langpan inla, ko hong dote do in!
Lum leh kidalna la inla, ko hong huh dingin dingto in!
Ko hong delhin hong bawlsia mite langah teipi leh teitangzang dok inla, kote tungah, ‘Keimah note hotkhiatna ka hi,’ hong ci in.
Ka nuntakna a la nuamte maizum henla, mindai tahen! Ka puk nadingun a geel mite maimialsa-in ciahkik uh hen!
Amaute, huih laka anvai bang hi henla, Yahweh’ vantungmi in amaute delhkek tahen!
Yahweh’ vantungmi in amaute a delhna ah a lampi uh mialin nal tahen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in thu om lopi-in thaang hong siah uh a, thu om lopi-in ka nuntakna dum hong siah uh hi;
tua ahih ciangin theih kholh lohin suksiatna in amaute pha henla, kote hong siahna thaang ah amaute awk uh hen! Amau tawhsa dum sungah amau mah kia uh hen!
Tua ciangin Yahweh sungah eite in nuam i sa ding a, Ama hotkhiatna ah i kipaak mahmah ding hi.

I guhte khempeuh in, ‘Yahweh aw, Nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Ama aa dingin a thakhauh mahmah mipa kiang panin zawngin a genthei mipa a honkhia, Nang bang kua om ahi hiam? Hi hi, amau neihsa teng a suhsak mite kiang panin mi zawngte leh mi cimawhte a honkhia Nang bang kua om ahi hiam?’ i ci ding hi.
Mi a el tecite hong dingto uh a, amaute in i theih khak loh thute hong dong uh hi.
Amaute in hoihna pen siatna tawh thuk uh a, i khawngai mahmah hi.
Tua hi napi-in amaute a ci a nat uh ciangin eite in puanhampi silhin, kiniamkhiatin an i tang hi. I lute i ang ah kunin thu i ngen hi.
A lawmpa, a sanggampa hanga a dah khat bangin i dah hi. A nu’ nusiatna hangin a khawngai khat bangin dahna-in i kun hi.
Ahih hangin ei i puk ciangin amaute lungdamin a kikhawm uh hi. I phawk loh kalin ei langah mi gensiate leh mi kosiate kikhawm uh a, amaute in ei hong gensia-in hong kosiatna tawp lo uh hi.
Pawite ah hong pai zahtak meel nei lo mi zahkote tawh amaute in a ha uh hong gawisan uh hi.
Yahweh aw, hih thu bang tanvei en ziau bek ding na hi hiam? Amau suksiatnate panin Ka nuntakna hong hu inla, a susia nuam humpinelkaite kiang panin Nangma aa Khat bek ahi keimah hong hon in!
Mihon lianpi lakah lungdamna kong ko ding uh a, mihon tampi lakah Nang kong phat ding uh hi!
Ko hong lehhek ka galte uh ko tungah kisialsak kei inla, ko hong mudahte zong mitheek kipiasak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in kilemna thu a gen laitakun gam sunga kilemtaka om mite langah lehhekna leh mawhsiatna man lote bawltawm uh hi.
Hi hi, amaute in kote langah kamka beba in, ‘Awi sing! Awi sing! Eima mit mahmah tawh mu khin hang ei!’ a ci uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Na mu hi; dai dide kei in! Yahweh aw, kote kiang panin gamla om kei in!
Yahweh aw, tho in! Ka Pa leh kote Kumpipa aw, ka thumaanna uh leh kote’ thu ah hong khanglo in!
Yahweh kote Pa aw, Na thumaanna tawh kituakin kote thutanna hong kilangsak inla, kote tungah ka galte uh lungdam takin gualzosak kei in.
Amaute lungkimna tawh kote tungah, ‘Awi mah sing, tua bang lian hi i deih!’ cisak kei in. Amaute kisialin, ‘Amaute nawmvalh khin hang ei!’ cisak kei in.
Kote pukna ah lungdamin a kisial mite maizumin zahla tahen! Hong mindaisakin hong gensia mite, maimialin mindaina tawh kituamcip tahen!
I thumaanna a lunggulh mite lungdamna tawh awngin lungkimna ngah uh hen! Tua ciangin amaute in, ‘A nasemte hoihna ah a lungkim Yahweh kiliansak hen!’ cici tawntung ta uh hen.
Tua ciangin ka kamte un Nangma thumaanna leh thutanna genkhia ding a, Nangma phatna sun tawntungin ka tangko ding uh hi!

headings.text: Migilote amau Lungsim sung Nangawn ah Mawh

verses.text: Migilopa in ama lungsim nangawn ah mawhna bawl a, ama kam pana kammalte in zuauna leh khemna vive ahi hi. Yahweh aw, ama mit sungah Nangmah zahtakna om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a huathuai mawhna leh khialhna ama sungah a kimuh ding deih loin, amah le amah kikhemin, ama mit ah amah le amah a kiphat hi.
Ama kam sung pana thute pen khialna leh zuau vive ahi hi. Amah in pil ding leh na hoih sep ding nusia khin a, pil ding leh na hoih sep ding khawl ta hi.
Amah a lupna tungah lumin siatna geelgeel a, mawhna lampi tung tawnin, amah in thupalsatna leh siatna a nolh kei hi.
A lian Yahweh aw, na hehpihna in vantungte ban hi! Na cihtakna in vanpite dong ban hi!
Na thumaanna pen muan lianpi dawnte dong ah kizel hi! Yahweh aw, na thukhennate pen tuipite sangin thuukzaw hi! Yahweh aw, mihing, ganhing a kempa Nang ahi hi!
Yahweh aw, a lian nangma nong hehpih-itna thupi lua sa’ng! Tua ahih ciangin ko mihing’ tate in Na kha liim nuai-ah ka muanna kong nga uh hi!
Kote in pawi khamin, Na Inn-a biaknate tawh nakpi-in nuam ka sa uh a, Nangma lungkimna guntui ka dawn ding uh hi.
Nuntakna tuikhuk Nang tawh om a, Nangma khuavak sungah khuavak ka mu ding uh hi.
Nang hong thei kote tungah na hehpih-itna hong zom lai inla, a lungsim thutang mite tungah na thumaanna zom lai in!
Kote langpangin a ngongtatte leh a kihisak mite’ khe hong paisak kei inla, migilote’ khut in kote hong nawtkeksak kei in!
Hua lai-a dumte ah Mawhna bawlte kia a, thokik lo uh hi! Mawhna bawlte kipaaisuk a, ding thei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Siatna bawl mite hangin kilungsosak kei inla, a man loin a gamta mite zong eng kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a sawt loin amaute lopa bangin vul pak ding uh a, kungno hing bangin amaute maimang ding uh hi.
A lian Yahweh aw, nang muangin thumaan gamtatna tawh Nangma gam sungah ka teng ding uh a, Nangma cihtakna tawh kote hong kivak ding hi.
A lian Yahweh sungah nuamsa in; tua ciangin Amah in na lungsima na lunggulhna teng hong pia ding hi!
Yahweh tungah na vai teng ap in, Amah muang in, Ama’n hong sem ding hi!
Amah in na thumaanna khuavang bangin tangsak ding a, na dikna sun nitang hong bangsak ding hi!
Yahweh sungah tawlnga in, lungduai takin Amah ngak in. A sepna ah gualzawhna ngahin ama gitloh geelna a tangtun mipa tungah heh se kei in.
Hehna panin khawl in! Siatna bawl kei in! Lungsona nusia in; bang hang hiam cihleh tua in siatna lam bek ah hong paipih hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh siatna bawlte kipuaseh ding hi! Ahih hangin Yahweh a ngakte in leitung luah ding uh hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh tomno sung bek hi napi-in migilopa om nawn lo ding a, na zong zongin na mu kei ding hi!
Lungnemte in leitung luah ding hi. Amaute in gen zawh loin nuamsa ding uh hi.
Migilo in thumaanpa sawm a, a ha a gawisan hi.
Yahweh in leitunga migilote zahpihna-in a nuihsan hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in amau hunte a tun dek lam a mu hi.
Mizawngte leh mi cimawhte puk nading, gamtatna ah a thutang mite that dingin migilote in a namsaute uh dokin, a thalte a kek uh hi.
Amau namsau mah amau lungtang ah kiphut ding a, amau thalte kitan mang ding hi!
Migilopa’ hauhna lianpite sangin thumaan mipa tawmno khat bek a neihsun hoihzaw lai hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Migilote’ khut kitan mang ding a, ahih hangin Yahweh in thumaan mite lenkip ding hi.
Yahweh in thutangte’ mite thei a, amau gamluah a kip tawntung ding hi.
Haksat hun ciangin amaute vul lo ding uh a, kialpi a tun ciangin amaute gilvah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin migilote pen kisia ding uh a, Yahweh’ galte pen tuuno’ thaute bangin kangtumin, meikhu sungah mangthang ding uh hi.
Migilote in leitawi la-in lohkik lo uh a, ahih hangin thumaan mi in hehpihna nei-in cingh takin a pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ thupha piakte in leitung luah ding uh a, ahih hangin samsiatna thuakte, Ama’n susia ding hi.
Yahweh in thumaan mipa lampi ding hilh a, thumaan mipa in Ama lampi nuam a sa hi!
Amah a tuk leh zong Yahweh in lawnkhia paisuak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a thumaan Yahweh in a khutte tawh amah lenkip hi.
Khangno ka hi ngei a, tu-in ka teek ta hi; ahih hangin thumaan mite kinawtsiat lam ka mu ngei kei a, a tate khut dawh ngena vak zong ka mu ngei kei hi.
Thumaan mite in a tawntungin hehpihna nei-in leitawi pia hi; tua ahih ciangin a suanlekhakte in thupha ngah uh hi.
Siatna panin kihemkhia un! Thumaan gamtat unla, nungta tawntung un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in thutang mite it a, Ama misiangthote nusia lo hi. Amaute kikem cing ngitnget a, ahih hangin migilote’ tate ahih leh kipuaseh ding hi.
Thumaan mite in gam luah ding uh a, a sungah teng tawntung ding uh hi!
Thumaan mipa kam in pilna pulak a, ama leii in thuhoih gen hi.
Ama lungsim sungah Yahweh’ Thukham om a, cik mahin ama’ khe tal lo ding hi!
Misiapa in thumaan mi encikin, amah suksiat theih nadingin a zon ciangin,
Yahweh in tua mi’ khut sungah amah pia lo a, a hahkat hangin zong a khialin a kimawhsak ding phal lo hi.
Yahweh ngak in! Yahweh’ lampi zui in; tua ciangin leitung a luah dingin hong kitawisang ding a, migilote kipuahsehna na mu ding hi.
Leihoihna-a po singkung hing tawh a kibang, a vanglian mahmah migilote i mukhin a,
6 ahih hangin amaute beimang uh hi; en un, amaute om nawn peuhmah lo uh hi. Amaute i zong a, ahih hangin amaute kimu zo nawn lo hi.
Paubang lo mi ciamteh inla, thutang mi en gige in. Tua mipa mailam ding pen a bukim kilemna ahi hi!
Ahih hangin thupalsatte kisusia khawm ding hi. Migilote’ mailam hun pen kipuasehna hi ding hi!
Thumaan mite’ kihotkhiatna pen Yahweh kiang pan ahi hi! Amah pen haksat hun ah i thahatna ahi hi!
Yahweh in eite hong huhin hong honkhia ding hi! Yahweh in migilote kiang panin eite hong hon ding hi! Yahweh muang i hih manin Amah in eite hong hu ding hi!

headings.text: Yahweh aw, Hehsa-in Hong Taii Kei In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Na heh laitakin hong tai kei inla, lungsosa-in hong thuhilh kei in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh kote sungah Nangma thaltangte hong thuktum a, Vanglian Yahweh aw, Na khut in kote hong nensuk hi.
A lian Yahweh aw, Nangma hehna hangin kote cilesa in thuakzawhna nei peuhmah lo a, ka mawhnate uh hangin zong ka guhte uh tawldam lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ko aa dingin a gik lua mahmah hakkol bangin ka mawhna uh ko lu tung mah ah hong tu hi.
Yahweh aw, ka haina uh hangin ka liamnate uih-in a muat hi.
Kote ka cimawh uh a, nakpi takin ka boksuk uh hi. Sun thapai-in kote ka tautau uh hi!
Ka kawng teng ah a muhdah huai natna tawh kidim a, ka ci ka sa un a thuakzo kei hi.
Kote thanem-in ka tamkham uh hi! Lungsim natluatna tawh ka khuisa uh hi!
Yahweh aw, ka lunggulhna uh tu-in nangma mai-ah om a, nang kiang panin ka khuisatna uh kiselcip lo hi.
Ka mit-a khuavak in kote hong nusia khin ahih manin ka lungtangte uh kisatin ka tha teng uh a bei hi.
Ka liammate uh hangin ka itte leh ka lawmte un kote hong pel uh a, ka kinaipihte un gamlapi ah hong omsan uh hi.
Ka nuntakna hong bengte in thang hong siah uh hi. Amaute in ka puk nadingun sawmsim uh a, sun tawntungin ka siatna ding uh geelgeel uh hi.
Ahih hangin kote, bangmah a za lo bilngongte leh a pauthei lo bangin ka om uh a, ka kam ka kak kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bangmah a za lo, ama kam sungah gen ding bangmah a om lo mipa tawh ka kibang uh hi.
Vanglian Yahweh aw, nang kong lamen taktak uh hi! Vantung Pa Yahweh aw, na za ding hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in, ‘Ka galte uh lungdamsak kei inla, kote langah amaute a kiliansak kei inla, ka khe uh hong talsak kei in,’ ka ci hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh kote ka puk dektak uh hi, Yahweh aw! Kote maitang ah dahna om ngitnget hi!
Ka mawhnate ka pulak ding uh hi! Ka mawhnate uh hangin nakpi-in ka lungkham uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka galte un tha nei-in thakhauh uh hi! A man lopi-in ko hong mudah ka galte uh tampi pha hi.

Hoihna pen siatna tawh a thukte pen ka galte hi uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in Na lampi zui-in a manin ka gamta uh hi. Yahweh aw, Na heh laitakin kote hong thuhilh kei inla, lungsosa-in kote hong taii kei in. Kote cimawhin nakpi-in kong boksuk uh hi! Sun thapai-in ka tautau uh hi!
Yahweh aw, kote hong nusia kei in! Kote Vantung Pa aw, ko kiang panin gamla om kei in!
Yahweh kote kihotkhiatna aw, a huh dingin hong manlang in!
Eite in, ‘Ka gamtatna ka kikem ding uh hi, tua bang hi keileh ka leiite uh hangin ka puk kha ding hi. I omna ah migilote a om laiteng i kam i kham ding hi,’ i ci hi.
Eite dai-in i om dide a, i pau kei hi; ahih hangin lungkhamna in eite hong toknawi hi.
I sungah i lungsim kuang hi! Hih thu i ngaihsut laitakin, mei kitawh kuang a, tua ciangin i kam tawh thu i gen hi;
‘Yahweh aw, kote nuntakna hun bei hong lak in! Kote aa ding a kiseh kumte, bangzah ahi hiam? Ka nuntak hunte a beipak ding hong theisak in!’ i ci hi.
Ka nuntak nite khutpek tan bekbekin na tomsak a, Nangma muhna ah ka nuntakna uh bangmah a hi kei hi! Kala, mihing khempeuh aa ding a thupipen hu khat bek hi zen! Selah.

Mihing khempeuh liim khat banga pai kawikawi takpi hi. Kala, mihing in bangmah lopi teng thalawh kankan hi! Amaute khat ciat in neihsa ciang venvan uh a, ahih hangin kua in tuate ngah lel ding cih a thei kei uh hi.
Tu-in Yahweh aw, bang ngaka bang lamen ka hi uh hiam? Kote lametna Nangma sungah om hi!
Ka thupalsatnate khempeuh panin kote hong honkhia inla, mihaite’ simmawh hong hisak kei in!
Ka dai dide hi; hih thu a sempa Nangmah na hih manin ka kam ka ka kei uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ko kiang panin Na misatna khauteep hemkhia in! Na khut tawh nong tupna in kote hong netum hi!
Mihing a mawhna hangin taihilhna tawh na puahpha a, kau-mulnei khat bangin ama hoihna na mawkmaisak hi. Kala, mi khempeuh bangmah lo ahi lel ve! Selah.

Yahweh aw, ka thungetna uh hong za in! Kote kikona hong ngaihsak in! Ka khituite luanna uh phamawh lo sa kei in! Ka pu ka pate uh mah bangin kote khualmi ka hi lel uh a, leitung ah a pai kawikawi bek ka hi lel uh hi!
Kote pai-in ka om nawn loh hun hong tun ma-in lungnuamin ka om theih nadingun kote hong kimuhmawh bawl in.

headings.text: Na Thukham Ka Genkhia Uh Hi!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, lungduai takin nang kong ngak uh a, ko lam hong nga-in kote kikona nong za hi.
A lipkhap huai dum sung, buan-nawi sung panin zong kote nong kaikhia hi. Suangpi tungah ko khe na nga a, ka khe sikna mun na kipsak hi.
Nangmah phatna la thak khat ka kam sungah nong koihsak hi! Halleluyah! Yahweh Phat un! Yahweh aw, tampite in mu ding uh a, Nang hong zahtakin hong muang ding uh hi!
Mi kiphasakte thupi sa lo a, zuau genna lamah kihei loin, ama muanna Yahweh a hisak mi, thupha ngah ahi hi.

Yahweh aw, na sepsa a lamdang na nasepnate tam mahmah hi. Kote aa dinga na ngaihsutnate lamdang mahmah hi! A lian Yahweh aw, Nang tungah tuate kong pulakkik zo kei uh a, limtakin zong gen thei loin, a phazah zong ka genzo kei uh hi!
Biakpiakna leh piaknate na lunggulh kei a, ka bilte nong hongsak khin hi! Meihal biaknate leh mawhna hanga biaknate, Na’ng na kal kei hi!
Tua ciangin Keimah in, ‘A lian Yahweh aw, en in, Nang kiangah kong pai hi! A zomzoma om Laibu sungah Kei thu kigelh hi:
‘Ka Pa aw, Na deihna banga sep ding ka nuam kasa a, Ka lungtang sungah Na Thukham om hi.
Mihon lianpi lakah thumaanna hanga lungkimna thute ka genkhin hi. Yahweh aw, na theih mah bangin ka mukte ka matcip kei taktak hi.
Ka lungsim sungah Na thumaanna ka selcip kei a, na cihtakna leh na hotkhiatna ka tangko hi! Mihon lianpi lakah Na hehpih-itna leh Na thuman ka selsim kei hi.
Yahweh aw, ko kiang panin na hehpihnate humcip kei inla, Na hehpih-itna leh Na thuman in kote hong dalsuak sak lai in.

Bang hang hiam cihleh sim zawh loh buai-na tampite in kote hong umcih a, ka khuadak theih loh zah dongun ka mawhnate un kote hong phakhin hi. Ka lutung uh-a samzangte sangin tuate tamzaw hi; tua ahih ciangin ka sungah ka lungsim un a lel hi.
Yahweh aw, kote nong hotkhiat ding nuamsa in! Yahweh aw, ko hong huh dingin manlangin hong pai in!
Ko hong susia nuamin hong zong mite buaigawpsak inla, amaute maimialin zahlasak in! Ko lama hong kuan siatna a lunggulh mite leh hawlkik inla, mindaisak in!
Ko tungah, ‘Ha, Ha’ ci-in hong nuihsante, amau maizumna leh a guaksuakna ah lauthawngsak in!
Nang hong zong mite khempeuh Nang sungah nuamin kipaak uh henla, Na hotkhiatna a itte in, ‘Yahweh kitawisang hen,’ ci den ta uh hen!
Eite zawngin i cimawh a, Yahweh i ei thu hong ngaihsut hi! Nang pen kote huhpa leh honpa na hi hi! Yahweh kote Pa aw, hong zekai kei in!
Mizawngte a khual mi in thupha ngah ahi hi. Yahweh in haksat hun ciangin amah huh ding hi.
Yahweh in ama dal ding a, Amah in a nungta-in kem ding hi! Leitunga ompa thupha ngah hi a, Nangmah in a galte deihna bangin amah na pia kei ding hi.
Yahweh in cinatna lupna tung panin amah thakhauhsak ding a, a lupna tungah amah a damsak ding hi.
Eite in, ‘Yahweh aw, ko tungah hehpihna hong nei inla, hong damsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma langah kote ka mawhkhin uh hi!
Ka galte un kote langah thusia genin, ‘Amaute cik ciang si ding uh hiam? Amau’ minte cik ciang mang ding hiam?’ a ci uh hi.
Ei kiang hong hawhin amaute hong pai ciangin, a lungsim uh ah gensiatna kam kaikhawmin zuau thu bekbek genkhia uh hi. I omna panin a paikhiat uh ciangin amaute in genthang uh hi.
Ei hong mudahte kipawlin kihuau sim uh a, i liam na dingin amaute in sawmsim uh hi.
Amaute in, ‘Natnasia amau tungah belh hi. Tu-in amau a kisialna panin amaute thokik nawn lo ding hi!’ a ci uh hi.
Hi hi, Ka muan mahmah, ka anlum a ne, ka it ka lawmpa in kei langah a khetul hong piksan hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, Nang na hih leh, ko tungah hehpihna hong nei inla, kote hong phongto in; tua hileh amah ka thukkik thei ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, ‘Ka galte uh ko tungah hong gualzo lo ding uh hi’ cihna hih lim hangin kote tungah nong lungkimna ka thei ding uh hi.
Ka lungsim siangthona uh hangin kote nong lenkip a, nangma omna ah kote nong koih tawntung hi.
Israyl-te’ Vanglianpa Yahweh in phatna ngah tahen! Vanglian Yahweh aw, a tawntungin nang hong kiphat hen! Halleluyah! Halleluyah!
Sakhi in luitui luang sialsial a lunggulh bangin, Yahweh aw, nang kong lunggulh uh hi.
A Nungta Pa aw, nang kong lunggulh uh hi! Cik ciangin Nang omna ah kote hong pai-in hong kilaak ding ka hi uh hiam?
Amaute in, ‘Na Vanglianpa uh koi-ah om hiam?’ hong cihcih sung teng, zan leh sunin ka khitui uh anin ka nei uh hi.

Hih nate ka phawk uh ciangin, ka kiko uh hi. Ka lungsim uh a tamzan hi. Yahweh’ Pawite a bawl a gualnuam mihonpi tawh lungdamna leh phatnate awngin, Yahweh’ Inn ah mi kigual makaihin, mihon tawh i kikholhnate i phawk hi.
Ka kha aw, bang hangin lungkia na hi hiam? Bang hangin ka sungah patau na hi hiam? Yahweh sungah lametna nei in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh omna pana hotkhiatna hangin amah ka phat veve ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka lungsim uh a tamkham hi. Tua ahih ciangin Yardan leitang, Hermon mualsangte leh Mizar Mual panin Nang kong phawk ding uh hi.
Na tuizeu hawk sungah tui thukpi in tui thukpi sam a, na tuihualte leh na tui kilokte khempeuh in kote hong nawk hi.
Tua hi napi-in Yahweh aw, Nangmah in sun hunin na hehpih-itna nong sawl ding a, kote nuntakna Pa tungah kong thungetna uh ahi nangma late tawh zanin kote nong ompih ding hi!
Eite in i Suangpi Yahweh kiangah, ‘Bang hangin kote hong mangngilh na hi hiam? Ka galte uh hong bawlsiatna hangin bang hangin tautau mawk ka hi uh hiam?’ i ci ding hi.
Ka guh dong uh hong sunsuk namsau bangin ka galte un hong zahpih-in, ‘Na Vanglianpa koi ah om ahi hiam?’ hong ci uh hi.
Ka kha aw, bang hangin lungkia na hi hiam? Bang hangin ka sungah lungkia na hi hiam? Yahweh sungah lametna nei in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh omna pana hotkhiatna hangin amah ka phat veve ding hi!

headings.text: Na Mual Siangtho ah Kote Hong Paipih In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, thu hong khen inla, a gilo minam tawh kote thu ah ka mawh lohna uh hong kilangsak in! Yahweh aw, zuau khemte leh thutang lo mipa kiang panin kote hong honkhia in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen kote Thahatna na hi hi! Bang hangin kote hong lawnkhia ding na hi hiam? Ka galte uh hong bawlsiatna uh hangin bang hangin kapkap ding ka hi uh hiam?
Na khuavak leh Na thuman hong sawl in! Yahweh aw, tuate in kote hong makaihsak inla, na mual siangtho leh na buk ah hong paipihsak in!
Tua ciangin na biaknatau leh nang kiangah kong pai ding uh hi, kote Lungnopna Lianpi ahi Yahweh aw! Hi hi, lyre khausai tawh nang kong phat ding uh hi, kote Siangthopa Yahweh aw!

Ka kha aw, bang hangin lungkia na hi hiam? Bang hangin om khinkhian thei lo na hi hiam? Vantung Pa sungah lametna nei in! Ka dahna maitang hong honkhia hangin Yahweh ka phat veve lai ding ka hih manin ka Pa Yahweh lamen in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Siangthopa aw nang kong phat ding uh hi! A Lian Yahweh aw, phatnate nang tungah hi tahen!
Ka pate un hong hilh a, tanglai hunin na hihna sate ka za uh hi.
Na khut tawh minam dangte na hawlkhiatzia leh ka pate uh na koihziate ka za uh hi. Nangmah in tua mite thuaksakin, na lawnkhia hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, amaute in amau namsau tawh leitang ngah lo banah, amau khut mah in amaute honzo lo hi. Ahih hangin Na taklam khut, na ban leh na maitang vang in honkhia a, ka pate uh tungah na hehpihna thuphate na pia hi!
Yaaqob tungah suahtakna thu na pia hi! Nang pen kote Kumpipa Yahweh na hi hi!
Nang tungtawnin ka galte uh ka nilpaai uh hi! Nangma Min tungtawnin ko langa hong pang mite ka tuancil uh hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh kihotkhiat nadingin kote in ka namsau leh ka thalte uh ka suang kei uh hi.
A Lian Yahweh in i galte khempeuh kiang panin eite hong hon hi! Nangmah in ko hong mudahte na maizumsak hi!
Yahweh aw, nang sungah ka angtang uh hi! Sun tawntungin ka kisial uh hi! Tu leh a tawntungin Nangma Min Yahweh ka phat uh hi! Selah.
Nangmah in kote hong lawnkhia-in nong maizumsak khin a, ka galkapte uh tawh nong kuan khawm kei hi.
Ka galte uh kiang panin nong taimangsak a, ko hong mudahte in ka neihsa teng uh hong buluhkhin uh hi.
Nangmah in a kigo ding tuu bangin kote nong pia a, minamte lakah kote nong thehthangkhin hi.
A meet pa loin Na mite nong zuak a, kote’ manh bangmah tham na ngah kei hi!
Ka vengte uh zahko dingin kote nong bawl a, ka kiimkota omte khempeuh’ etneu leh nuihsan dingin nong bawl hi.
Minamte lakah thusia-gentehna leh mite’ lupeisan nong suaksak hi.
-16 Ka galpa uh leh phulapa kiang panin gensiatna leh ngawhna awgingte hangin ka omna uh ah ka mindaina kizomsuak a, maizumna in kote hong tuamcip hi.
Hih thu khempeuh ko tungah hong tungzo a, ahih hangin Nang kong mangngilh kei uh a, Na thuciamna zong ka taisan tuan kei uh hi.
Ka lungsimte uh kihei tuan lo a, Na lampi panin ka khekhapte uh zong pialkhia tuan lo hi;
Ahih hangin Nangmah in gulte omna mun ah kote nong suzan kiuhkeuh a, sihna liim tawh nong tuam hi.
Yahweh aw, Na Min mangngilhkhin hi le ung, ahih keileh a kikham pasiante (elohim) lamah ka khutte uh a khak hi le ung,
Yahweh aw, hih thu mukhia ding hilo na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in lungsim’ thusimte na thei hi.
Tua hi napi-in Nangma hangin sun thapai-in kote hong kithat a, a kigo ding tuu bang bekin kote hong kingaihsun hi.
Yahweh aw, khanglo in! Bang hangin ihmu na hi hiam? Tho to inla, kote hong lawnkhia paisuak kei in.
Bang hangin Na maitang seel na hi hiam? Bang hangin ka thuakna uh leh hong kisukcipna mangngilh na hi hiam?
Leilak ah ka buksuk uh a, leivui lakah ka pumpite uh belhcip hi!
Kote aa dingin hong tho in! Na itna kip hangin kote hong huh inla hong tankhia in.

headings.text: Na Muk panin Pahtawina Hong Pai

verses.text: Thubul hoih khat tawh ka lungsim uh hong dimletin, Kumpipa kiangah natate thu ka gen hi! I leiite pen laigelh siamte’ laikung tawh kibang hi!
Nang pen mihing’ tapate sangin na hoihzaw tham hi. Na mukte sungah pahtawina kisung ahih manin Yahweh in Nang a tawntungin thupha hong piakhin hi!
Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, Na Inn sung tawngpente ah Na Kammal khihcip in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang na zahtakhuai mahmah hi.
Thumanna, kiniamkhiatna leh thumaanna hangin Na thupitna tawh gualzawhna ah pai in! A kihtakhuai nate leh a lipkhaphuai nasepnate ah Na taklam khut in nang hong hilh ding hi!
Kumpipa’ galte’ lungtang-a dingin Na thaltangte kitaat hiam hi! Na thaltangte kitaat hiam a, Nangma nuai-ah minamte puk ding uh hi!
Yahweh’ hong piak Na kumpi-tokhom a tawntungin kip paisuak ding a, Na kumpigam ciangkhut in a thumaan ciangkhut ahi hi.
Nangmah in zong thumaanna na deih a, gitlohna na mudah hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh Na Pa in Na gualte tungah kikhai to-in lungdamna sathau tawh nang hong nilhzo hi.
Na puantualpite saiha kizem kumpi-innte pana myrrh, aloes leh thalsing paknamtuite tawh a namtui hiuhiau hi; tua lai panin amaute in Nang hong kipaaksak uh hi.
Na pahtawi numeite lakah kumpite’ tanute om a, Na taklam khut ah Ophir kham tawh a kizem mo a ding hi.
Tanu aw, ngai inla, za in! Ngaihsun inla, kote thu hong za in! Na mipihte leh na pa’ innkuan mangngilh in;
Na mel hoihna Kumpipa lunggulhsak in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah pen na lutang hi a, ama mai-ah na kun ding ahi hi.
Letsong tawh Tyre’ tanu hong tung ding a, mi haute in Na maipha hong zong ding uh hi;
kumpipa’ tanu a inn sungah minthanna khempeuh tawh om a, a puansilhte kham tawh a kigankhawm ahi hi.
Mel tuamtuam a nei puantualpite silhin Kumpipa kiangah kipaipih a, ama kithuahpih, amah a zui nungakte Nang kiangah hong kipaipih ding hi.
Lungdamna leh nuamna tawh amaute kipaipih ding a, Kumpipa’ kumpi-inn sungah amaute lut ding uh hi!
Na pate’ tangdingin na tapate hi ding hi! Nangmah in leitung khempeuh ah amaute ukpi-in ka koih ding hi!
Khang tawntungin Nangma Min ka kiphawksak ding uh hi! Tua ahih ciangin minamte in a tawntungin nang hong phat ngitnget uh hen!

headings.text: I Bukna leh I Thahatna, Yahweh
