verses.text: Yahweh pen i bukna leh i thahatna hi a, haksat hunin hong huh pahpahpa ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin leitung kikhelin tuipite sungah mualliante a kikhin zongin i lau kei ding hi.
A tuite hawkin phuan hen! A kilokna hangin mual liante liing hen! Selah.
Gun khat om a, a tui luangte in i Pa tenna Mun Siangtho, Yahweh khuapi a kipaaksak hi.
Ama laizangah Yahweh om a, amah a liing kei hi. Yahweh in phalvak tung phetin amah a huh ding hi.
Minamte nakpi-in heh a, kumpigamte liing uh hi. Amah in Ama aw gingkhiasak a, leitung a tuisuak hi!
Vanglianpen Yahweh in eite hong ompih hi! Yaaqob’ Pa in eite bukna ahi hi! Selah.
Hong pai unla, leitung gamkhing a suaksak khinpa, Yahweh’ nasepnate hong en un.
Leitung mongte dong ah Amah in gal vengsak ding a, Amah in thalpeu kuaitanin, teipi tumnihin a sattan hi! Amah in meikuang ah leengte a hal hi.
Om hit-hiat unla, Yahweh ka hihna hong thei un! Minamte lakah Kei hong kitawisang ding hi! Leitung ah Kei hong kitawisang ding hi!
Vanglianpen Yahweh in eite hong ompih hi! Yaaqob’ Pa in eite bukna ahi hi! Selah.
Minamte khempeuh aw, pahtawina tawh na khutte uh beeng ziahziah un! Gualzawhna aw tawh Yahweh tungah nakpi-in awng un!
Sangpen Yahweh in lauhuai-in dipkuat-huai hi. Amah, leitung khempeuh tungah Kumpi lian ahi hi!
Yahweh in eite nuai-ah mite nuaisiah ding a, i khe nuai-ah minamte om ding hi.
Ama itpa Yaaqob’ angtanpih ahi eima aa dingin i luah ding hong teelsak ding hi.
Otna tawh eima Pa paitokhin a, peengkul aw tawh Yahweh paito hi.
Yahweh tungah phatna late sa un, phatna late sa un! Eite Kumpipa tungah phatna late sa un, phatna late sa un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen leitung khempeuhte’ Kumpipa ahi hi! Theihtelna tawh phatna late sa un!
Yahweh in minamte uk hi! Yahweh, a kumpi-tokhom siangtho tungah tu hi!
Leitung kidalna lumte Yahweh aa ahih manin Abraham’ Pa’ mite bangin minamte’ uliante kikhawm uh hi! Amah nakpi-in kitawisang hi!

headings.text: Yahweh Lian a, Nakpi-in Phat Ding ahi hi!

verses.text: Yahweh lian a, i Pa’ khuapi sung, ama sianthona mual ah nakpi-in phat ding ahi hi.
A saanna hoihin, leitung buppi lungdamna pen a Lian Kumpipa’ khuapi, leilulam pangte-a om Zion Mual ahi hi.
Ama kumpi-huang sunga Yahweh pen bukna-in kithei hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh en un, kumpite kikaikhawm uh a, tua khit ciangin taimang uh hi.
Amaute in mu uh a, tua ahih ciangin lamdang a sa uh hi; amaute dipkuatna in vatin a taikek uh hi.
Tua lai-ah lauluatna in amaute mancip a, numei nausuak bangin a nasak hi.
Nisuahna lam huih tawh Nangmah in Tarshih tembawte na susia ding hi.
I zaksa mah bangin i Pa’ khuapi, vanglianpen Yahweh’ khuapi sungah i mukhin hi. Yahweh in tua khuapi kipsak tawntung ding hi! Selah.
Yahweh aw, na munsiangtho sungah nangma hehpih-itna thu ka ngaihsunsun uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Nangma Min a om mah bangin leitung mongte dong ah nangmah phatna om hi! Na taklam khut in thumaanna tawh kidim hi!
Nangma thukhennate hangin Zion Mual nuam a, Yahdah’ tanute a kipaak uh hi.
Zion ah pai kawikawi inla, amah kiimvelin, a tausangte sim in.
Hong pai lai ding khangsawnte tungah na genkik theih nadingun a kulhpite limtakin ciamteh unla, a kumpi-innte sittel un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen a tawntungin eite Vantung Pa ahi hi! Yahweh aw, a tawp dongin kote lamlakpa nong hi ding hi!

headings.text: Khuamial in Thutheihna Neilo Mihaute’ Thu Gen

verses.text: Minam khempeuh aw, hih thu za un! Leitunga a tengte khempeuh aw, limtakin ngai un!
A ngiam a sang, a zawng a haute aw a kibangin ngai un!
Ka kamte un pilna thugen ding a, ka lungsim lungngaihngaihna in thu theihtelna gen ding hi.
A theih hak thugentehna lamah na bilte hoisak un. Lyre khausai tawh kopin a telhak thu kong genkhia ding uh hi.
Haksat nite ahi a, ei hong umcih a hong gensiate’ siatna ahi a,
a hauhna uh suangin, a neihsa tampite a kiphatsakpih mite ahi zongin bang hangin kihta ding i hi hiam?
Mihing in ama sanggampa nangawn tankhia zo lo ahih leh, ama kitat nadingin Yahweh tungah bang kitatna pia-in—
(Bang hang hiam cihleh amau nuntakna tat nading manh tam a, a tawntungin kitanzo ngei lo hi.)—
a tawntungin a nuntak theih nading leh kisiatna a tuah khak loh nadingin bang tawh kitan thei ding ahi hiam?
Amah in mipilte zong a sih pelmawh nading thu a thei hi. Mihaite zong kisia a, a nih tuakin a neihsa uh midangte tungah tung hi.
Amaute in a lungsim tawng ah amau innte kip paisuak tawntung ding a, amau tenna munte a khang khangin kipsuak dingin ngaihsun uh a, amau leitangte zong amau min a puasak uh hi.
Ahi zongin pahtawina leh hauhna a neih hangin mihing kip paisuak lo a, a si thei ganhingte tawh a kibang lel hi.
Hih in amau thubul hi a, mihaute leh minoptat mite’ mong in hih bang ahi hi. Amau thu a zui mite in amau kam pana thu tawh hi kisa-in nuamsa ding uh hi. Selah.

Amaute, han ah tuu bangin kinotmang hi. Sihna pen amaute tuu banga a cingpa hi a, thumaanna in phalvak hun ah amaute uk pak bek ding hi. Hankuk sungah amau hoihna beitum ding a, amau tenna pan gamla pek ah a om ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in hankhuk’ vangliatna panin eite hong tankhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in eite hong sang ding hi! Selah.
Mi khatpeuh a hauh ciang ahi zongin, a innkuan minthanna a khan ciang ahi zongin lau kei in;
bang hang hiam cihleh amah a sih ciangin bangmah keng tuan lo ding a, a minthanna in amah zuisuk lo ding hi.
Amah a nuntak lai-in thupha ngah a kisak hangin, (nang in limtakin na nasep leh, midangte in zong nang hong phat ding uh hi)
a pate’ khang mah zom ding a, cikmahin khuavak mu kha lo ding hi.
Thutheihna bangmah nei lo napi-in hauhna tampi leh pahtawina a ngah mipa pen ganhingte mah bang lel ding a, amah kisia ding hi.
Vanglianpen Pa Yahweh pau a, nisuahna panin nitumna dong leitung a kaikhawm hi.
Hoih kicinna Zion panin Yahweh hong taangkhia khin hi.
I Pa hong pai ding a, Amah dai omlo ding hi! Ama mai-ah meikuang in kangtum ding a, Ama kiimkot ah huihpi kitom ding hi.
Amah in a mite a thukhen theih nadingin tunglam panin vantungte leh leitung sam hi.
Yahweh in, “Biakpiakna ah Ka thuciamna a thukim ka misiangthote, Ka kiangah hong khawm un!” a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, Nang Thukhenpa na hih manin vantungte in Na thumaanna tangko ding hi! Selah.
Yahweh in, “Ka mite aw, za un; thu kong gen ding hi! Israyl aw za un, note lang khatah teci ka pang ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh note’ Pa ka hi hi!
Ka mai-a om ngitnget na biakpiaknate ahi a, na meihal biaknate uh hang ahi zongin note kong mawhsak kei ding hi.
Na inn panun bawngtal ahi a, na ganbuk pan uh-a keeltal ahi zongin ka kisam kei hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh gamlaka gamsa khempeuh pen Kei aa ahi hi. Mual tul tampite tunga ganhingte keima aa ahi hi.
Mualtungte-a vasa khempeuh ka thei a, gamsung ganhingte Keima aa ahi hi.
Ka gil a kial hileh zong note kong gen kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh leitung leh a sunga om khempeuh Keima aa ahi hi.
Bawngtal’ sa ne-in, keelte’ sisan dawn peuhmah ding ka hi hiam?
Yahweh tungah lungdam piakna pia unla, Sangpenpa tungah na thuciamnate uh bawl un!

Na haksat hun ciangun Kei hong sam un; note kong honkhia ding a, note in Kei nong thangsak ding uh hi” a ci hi. 16-17 Ahih hangin migilote tungah Yahweh in hi bangin ci hi: note in Kong thuhilhna mudahin, Ka kammalte na nunglam uh ah paai khin na hih nungsangun Ka ngeina kipte na genkhiat theih nading uh ahi a, na kam uh tawh Ka thuciamna na gen theih nadingun bang thu nei na hi uh hiam?
Guta khat mu le uhcin ama lawm na hi pah uh a, numei-pasal mawhna a bawl khat mu le uhcin, na kihel suk pah uh hi.
Na kam uh, siatna na uksak uh a, na leii uh tawh zuaugenna ngen na gan uh hi.
Na sanggampa gensia-in na tu a, na nu’ tapa na ko hi!
Nangmah in hih nate na hih a, ahih hangin bangmah hong cih loin dai takin ka om hi. Hih thu hangin nang kong taii ding a, na maitang mah ah nang kong mawhsak ding hi.
Oh, tu-in hih thu ngaihsun un, no Yahweh a mangngilhte aw, tua bang hi keileh note kong balzan ding a, hong honkhia ding kuamah omlo ding hi:
Phatna biakpiakna hong pia mi peuhmah in Kei hong pahtawi hi a, ka thu a mang mipa tungah Yahweh’ hotkhiatna ka lak ding hi, a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, na hehpih-itna tawh kizui-in kote hong hehpih inla, na hehpihna a dimlet tawh kizui-in ka thupalsatnate uh hong phiat khiatsak in.
Ka khialhna panun kote hong sawpsiang kiuhkeuh inla, ka mawhna panun hong siangsak in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka thupalsatnate ka thei uh a, ko mai-ah ka mawhna uh om ngitnget hi.
Nangma tung nangawn ah kong mawh khin uh a, na muhna ah a sia-in ka gamta khin hi, tua ahih ciangin na thu genna ah nang na tang a, na thukhenna ah paubanna om lo hi.
En in, khialsa-in i suak a, mawhna sungah i nute in hong paii hi.
En in, Nang in sungtawng ah thuman na lunggulh a, lungsim tawng ah kote ciimna hong theisak in.
Puknah tawh nong nul ciangin ka siang ding uh hi. Kote nong sil ciangin vuk sangin ka ngozaw ding hi.
Nangmah in lungnopna leh kipaakna nong za theisak ding hi; tua ahih ciangin na kuaihtansa guhte lungdam uh hen.
Ka mawhnate uh kimuhmawh bawl inla, ka khialnate khempeuh uh hong phiatsak in!
Yahweh aw, kote sungah lungsim siangtho hong piangsak inla, a hoih ngaihsutna kote sungah hong guan in.
Na omna panin kote hong paai khia kei inla, ko kiang panin Na Kha Siangtho la kei in!
Na hotkhiatna hanga lungnopna hong ngahsakkik inla, utna lungsim tawh kei hong dingkipsak in.
Tua ciangin thupalsatte tungah Na lampite ka hilh ding uh a, tua ciangin Nang lamah mawhneite hong kikhel ding uh hi.
Kote honkhia Pa, Yahweh aw, sisan suah mawhna panin kote hong honkhia in, tua ciangin ka mukte un Nangma thumaanna la ka sa ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, ka mukte uh nong honsak ding a, tua ciangin ka kamte un Nangmah phatna genkhia ding hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in biakpiakna a lunggulh na hi kei hi; tua bang hi keileh kong pia ding uh hi. Meihal biakpiakna ah zong na nuam kei hi.
Yahweh’ san theih biakpiakna in lungsim kitamzan ahi hi. Yahweh aw, lungsim tamkham-in kisikna na simmawh kei ding hi.
Na lungkimna pha tawh Zion ah a pha bawl in! Nangmah in Yerusalem kulhte hong ciangkik in!
Tua ciangin a thumaan biakpiaknate tawh na lung a kim ding hi. Mei sungah a kangtum meihal biaknate ah Na nuam ding hi. Tua ciangin na biaknatau tungah bawngtalte hong kipia ding hi.

headings.text: Kong Phat Tawntung Ding Uh Hi

verses.text: Mi thahat pa aw, bang hangin na siatna kiphatsakpih na hi hiam? Vanglianpenpa’ hehpihna tawp lo hi.
Zuau a phuakphuak, na leii in mul kiatna tempa hiam bangin siatna bek sawmsim hi.
Nangmah in thumaanna sangin siatna na deihzaw hi. Nangmah in a man thu sangin zuau thu na deihzaw hi. Selah.
A zuaukhem leii aw, a siasak thei kammal khempeuh na deih hi.
Tua mah bangin Yahweh in a tawntungin nang hong susia ding hi. Amah in nang hong paikhiatpih-in, na puanbuk sung panin hong kaikhia ding a, na tenna leitang panin hong zunglot ding hi! Selah.
Thumaan mite in nang hong mu-in, Yahweh tungah zahtakna a pia ding uh hi! Thumaan mite in nang hong zahpih nuihsanin,
“Ama thahatna Yahweh hisak loin, ama hauhna tampite a suang, gitlohna ah a thahat mipa en un,” hong ci ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin eite i hih leh, Yahweh’ Inn-a olive kung hingte tawh i kibang hi. Yahweh aw, a tawntungin Nangma itna kip ka muang uh hi!

Hih bangin hih khin na hih manin a tawntungin Nang kong phat ding uh hi! Nangma Min tawh ka lamen ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma Min a thumaan hi! Na misiangthote omna ah Nang kong phat tawntung ding uh hi!

headings.text: Na Mi Saltangte Na Ciahkiksak Ciang

verses.text: Mihai mi in a lungsim sungah, “Vantung Pa cih bang omlo hi,” a ci hi. Amaute kisia uh a, a kihhuai mawhna a bawl uh hi. Thummaanin a gamta kuamah a om kei hi!
Yahweh in Amah a zong, thuneihna a nei khatpeuh a om hiam cih a theih nadingin vantung panin mihing’ tate a ensuk hi.
Amaute a vekpi-in pukkhin uh a, a kibangin kisia kim uh hi. Amaute thumaanin a gamta om lo uh hi; om kei, khat beek zong om kei!
Yahweh a sam lo, an nek bangin Ka mite a netum siatna bawlte in thu teltheihna nei lo ahi uh hiam?

Launa a om lohna mun ah amaute launa in tuamcip hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ei hong bawlsiate’ guhte thehthang hi! Yahweh aw, Nangmah in amaute nial na hih manin amaute na maizum-in na koih hi.
Na mi saltangte na ciahkiksak ciangin Zion panin Israyl-te’ hotkhiatna hong paikhia veh e! Tua ciangin Yaaqob nuamin, Israyl kipaak ding hi.

headings.text: En un, Yahweh in Ei Hong Huhpa Hi!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Na Min tawh kote hong hon inla, Na thahatna tawh kote mawhbang lohna hong kilangsak in!
Yahweh aw, kong thungetna uh hong za inla, ka kam uh pana kammalte limtakin hong ngaihsak in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh kote langpangin ka theihloh mite kipankhin uh a, mi bawlsiate in ka nuntakna uh la dingin hong zong uh hi! Yahweh aw, amaute in amau omna ah nang hong thudon lo uh hi.
En un, Yahweh pen i huhpa ahi hi! Yahweh pen eite hong kipletpa ahi hi!
I galte tungah siatna lehtun tahen! Nangma thu a man sungah amaute susia in!
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, kote in Nangma tungah phatna biakpiaknate suakta takin kong pia ding uh hi! Yahweh aw, Nangmah thumaan na hih manin Na Min ka phat ding uh hi.
Haksatna khempeuh panin kote nong honkhiakhin a, ka mitte un gualzawhna tawh ka galte uh a en hi.

headings.text: Na Lunghihmawhna Teng Yahweh Suan In!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, kote thungetna na bil hong ngat inla, kong thuumna panun kibu kei in.
Ko lam hong nga inla, hong dawng in. Ka diksak lohna teng uh Nang kong gen ding uh a,
ka galte uh aw leh migilote’ hong bawlsiatna uh hangin ngaih takin ka tau ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in ko tungah buai-na hong tun uh a, hehna tawh kote hong mudah uh hi.
Kote sungah ka lungsim uh na mahmah a, sih zah dong ding launate ko tungah hong tung zo hi.
Kote sungah launa leh liinna hong lut a, kihtakna in kote hong vukcip hi.
Kote in, “Vakhu bangin kha nei leng maw! Ka gamla lenkhiat ding a, nuam takin ka om hit-hiat ding hi!
Hi taktak hi, gamla pek ah i paimang ding a, gamlak ah i om ding hi. Selah.
Huihpi leh husiate panin manlangin i suakta khia ding hi,” ka ci uh hi.
Yahweh aw, susia inla, a pau uh kilamdang sak in! Kote in khuapi sungah ngongtatna leh kam kiselna ka mukhin uh hi!
Amaute in sun leh zanin kulhpi tung panin khuapi kiimkot uh a, khuapi laizangah siatna leh buai-na om hi.
A lakah kisiatna om a, kongzingte ah kikhemna leh kineihna veng lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh kote hong ko gawp ka galte uh hi lo hi; hileh ka thuak zo ding uh hi. Kote langa a kiliansak, ko hong mudahte hi lo hi; hileh ama kiang panin ka kibu ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka kikimpih, ka kikholhpih, ka lawm theih mahmah nang na hi hi!
Kam khum tawh thu i kikum khawmkhawm ngei a, Yahweh’ Inn ah mihonpi tawh i ton khawmkhawm hi.
Amau’ tenna tul henla, amaute manlang takin Sheol; hankhuk, ah tuaksuk uh hen! Bang hang hiam cihleh amau’ tenna ah siatna om a, amau lungtangte ah siatna a om hi!
Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, Yahweh aw, Nang kong sam ding uh a, Nangmah in kote nong hon ding hi!
Nitak leh zingsang leh sun hun ah thungenin nakpi-in ka kiko ding uh a, Nangmah in ka awte uh nong za ding hi!
Kote hong langpan galkidona panin nuamtakin ka nuntaknate uh nong tan hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote langah tampi a pha uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in na za ding a, amaute na thuaksak ding hi. Yahweh aw, tangtawng pek panin a om gige Nangmah in, kikhelna a nei lo, Nang hong zahtak lo mite sunga tua mite na thuk ding hi. Selah.
Amah in a kilempih mite langpanin a khutte zankhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a thuciamna simmawh bawlin a palsat hi.

Thawhbat bangin a kam pana kammalte neel dakdak a, ahih hangin a lungsim sungah kigalneihna a om hi. A kammalte sathau sangin neel zaw a, ahih hangin amaute pen a satmang ding leh a susia ding namsau dawhsa ahi uh hi!
Yahweh tungah na lunghihmawhna teng nga in, Ama’n puakpih ding hi. Amah in thumaan mite a puk ding cikmahin phal lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, Nangmah in suksiatna dum sungah amaute na puaksuk ding hi! Sisan suahte leh zuaukhem mite amau nuntak ding zah lang nungta lo ding hi! Ahih hangin kote in Nang kong muang ding uh hi!

headings.text: Mihing In Bang Hong Cih Zo Ding Hiam?

verses.text: Yahweh aw, mihing in kote hong susia nuamin naklah liangin hong delh ahih manin kote tungah hehpih in. Sun tawntungin hong do niloh-in, mihing in kote hong nuainet uh hi.
Ka galte un sun tawntungin kote hong nawknawk uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Sangpenpa aw, kote hong netum nuamte tampi pha uh hi.
Kote ka lau ni-in, nang kong muang uh hi.

Yahweh aw, Nangma sungah Na Thukham ka phat uh hi! Yahweh aw, Nangma sungah kote ka lungmuang uh hi! Bangmah ka kihta kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh cilesa lel in kote tungah bang hong cih thei ding ahi hiam?
Sun tawntungin amaute in ka kammalte uh lehlak uh a, kote tunga a ngaihsutna uh siatna vive ahi hi.
Amaute kikaikhawm-in, hong buk uh a, ka nuntakna a lak theih nadingin a buk bangin ka kalsuanna hong encik gige uh hi.
Amau khialhna panin kote hong honkhia in! Yahweh aw, Na hehna sungah minamte phum in!
Ka kahla uh gelh inla, savun tungah ka khituite uh gual inla, Na laibu tungah ka haksatna gual in.
Tua ciangin kote in Nang kong sap ni-in ka galte uh lehtai ding uh hi. Hih thu ka thei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen eite aa dingin om hi!
Yahweh aw, nang sungah Na Thukham ka phat uh hi! Yahweh aw, Nangma sungah Na thu ka phat uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Nang sungah muanna kong koih uh hi! Ka kihta kei ding uh hi! Mihing in kote tungah bang hong cih zo ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh aw, ko tungah nong ciamnate om a, Nangma tungah lungdampiakna kong pia ding uh hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in sihna panin kote nong honkhia hi! Puk nading panin ka khete nong hutsak ding hi; tua ciangin Yahweh aw, nangma mai panin nuntakna khuavak sungah kote ka kalsuan thei ding uh hi!
Hong hehpih in, Yahweh aw, hong hehpih in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang kong muang uh hi; hih siatnate kote hong khenkhit matengin Nangma kha liim sungah bukna kong zong ding uh hi.
Kote aa dingin hong zawhsak kote Vanglianpenpa, Sangpen Yahweh aw, nang tungah kong kiko ding uh hi.
Nangmah in vantung panin na sawl ding a, hong gensiate kiang panin kote nong hon ding hi. Selah. Yahweh aw, nangmah in Na hehpihna leh Na thuman nong sawl ding hi!
Humpinelkaite lakah ka om uh hi! Mei a kuangsak mihing’ tapate lakah ka lum uh a, amau hate in teipi leh thaltangte hi a, amau leii in namsau hiam khat ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, vantungte tungah sangto in! Leitung khempeuh tungah na minthang hen!
Amaute in ka khe uh ngenthang hong siah uh a, kote lungkhamin ka awng uh hi. Kote mai-ah amaute in dum to uh a, ahih hangin amau mah a sungah kia uh hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, kote ka lung muang uh hi! Ka lungkip uh hi! Kote in la sa-in Nangma tungah phatna kong pia uh hi!
Ka tho ding hi! Harp leh lyre khausaite aw khanglo un! Phalvak hun ah i khanglo ding hi!
Yahweh aw, mite lakah nang kong phat ding uh hi. Minamte lakah Nangmah phatna ka sa ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma hehpih-itna lianpi in vantungte dong tung a, Nangma thuman lianpi meiite sung dong tung hi!
Yahweh aw, vantungte tungah sangto in! Leitung khempeuh tungah na minthang hen!

headings.text: Thumaan Mite aa dingin Thaman Om!

verses.text: No thudotpite tawh, thumaan takin thugen na hi uh hiam? No ukpite aw, tang takin thukhen na hi uh hiam?
Hi peuhmah lo hi, na lungsim-un siatna na bawl a, gam sungah nomau khut tawh ngongtatna na tehkhia uh hi.
Migilote, naubu sung mah panin tuampian diak pah a, amaute a suah phet mahin lamkhial pahin, zuauthu gen uh hi.
Amau gu pen gul’ gupha tawh kibang a, mualtan bengngong khuaza lo bang ahi uh hi;
tuate in a khiimte’ aw hitaleh, a zol siamte’ aw hitaleh ngai se-lo ding uh a, ahi zongin amaute kiva mahmah hi.
Yahweh aw, a kam sunga a ha-te suktansak in! Yahweh aw, humpinelkai khanglai’ hapak kitamzansak in.
Tui luangluangte bangin amaute kiamtum henla, a thal uh a kek ciangin a thaltangte a kisuktansak bang lel tahen!
Amaute, ni tang nuai-a a nai-a bei toktal bang uh hen! Nupinu’ sung pana a hun cing nailo-a suak bangin amaute in ni mu kei uh hen!
Na beelte in lingkung kuang sa a theih ma-in, Yahweh in nang hong muutkhia ding hi!
Ama kihotkhiatna a muhkhitna hangin thuman mipa kipak ding a, amah in migilote’ sisan tawh a khe sil ding hi!
Tua ciangin mipa in, “Thumaan mite aa dingin thaman om takpi a, leitung thu a khen Pa khat om takpi hi,” ci ding hi.

headings.text: Ka Galte kiang pan Hong Hon In!

verses.text: Ka galte uh kiang panin kote hong honkhia in, kote Pa aw! Ko hong langpan mite langpan in!
Mawhna gamtata mite kiang panin kote hong honkhia inla, sisan suahsuah mite kiang panin kote hong hon in!
En in, amaute in ka nuntakna uh thah dingin hong bukin, a thahat mihon in kote hong langpan uh a, ka thupalsatna uh hang hi loin, ka mawhnate uh hang zong ahi kei hi, Yahweh aw!
Ko lam ah bangmah khialhna om lopi-in amaute in ko langah mun la-in mainawtin hong tai uh hi.
Israyl’ Pa, a honpite’ Vanglianpen, Nangmah, Yahweh! Minamte khempeuh a dantat dingin tho inla, migilo thupalsatte hehpih kei in! Selah.
Nitak ciangin amaute ciahin, ui bangin kuu uh a, khua sung teng a gemgem uh hi.
Amau kam panin a luangkhiate: amau muk pana namsau dawkkhiate mu in, amaute in, ‘Kua’n hong za laizang ding ahi hiam?’ a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nangmah in amaute na nuihsan lel ding hi! Nangmah in minamte na zahpih lel ding hi!
Kote Thahatna aw, nang kong ngak uh hi! Yahweh aw, nang pen kote kidalna na hi hi!
Yahweh aw, nangmah kote mai-ah pai inla, lungnopna leh gualzawhna tawh ka galte uh hong ensak in.
Yahweh aw, amaute that in; tua bang hi keileh mipite lung hianghiang ding uh hi. kote kidalna lum Yahweh aw, na vangliatna tawh amaute kizial mangsak inla, amaute puksak in.
Amau kam pana mawhnate, amau muk pana kammalte hangin, amau kiphatsakna ah amau mah awksak in! Amaute in hamsiatna zangin zuauthu genkhin uh ahih manin,
hehna tawh amaute beitumsak in! Them zong a om nawn loh dongin amaute beimangsak in! Tua ciangin Yaaqob tungah leimongte dongin Yahweh in a uk lam amaute in thei ta uh hen! Selah.
Nitak ciangin amaute ciahin, ui bangin kuu uh a, khua sung teng a gemgem uh hi.
An zongin amaute vaksuk vakto uh a, a kham zawh kei uh leh hum-ham uh hi.

Ahih hangin kote in Na thahatna leh na vangliatna la ka sak ding uh hi! Zingsang simin Nangma hehpihna leh hehpih-itna thu ngaih takin kong sak taktak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka haksat hunin nang in kote kidalna leh ka bukna uh nong hi ngitnget hi.
Kote Thahatna aw, nang tungah phatna late kong sa uh hi! Yahweh aw, nang in kote kidalna na hi hi! Yahweh aw, nang pen kote hong hehpih ka Pa uh na hi hi!
Yahweh aw, ko tungah nong heh a, kote nong nial hi. Ko tungah nong heh a, ko kiang panin na kiheikhia hi. Tu-in ka ngei uh hong bangsakkik in.
Nangmah in lei na liingsak a, lei na khaangkhamsak khin hi. Liingliing ahih ciangin a khaannate hoihkiksak in.
Nangmah in Na mite haksatna na thuaksak khin a, apkhapna leenggahzu kote nong dawnsak khin hi.
Ahih hangin Nangma thuman hangin a kitawisan theih nadingin nang hong zahtak mite tungah dialkhai na pia khin hi. Selah.
Na itte a suahtak theih nadingin, Na taklam khut tawh hon inla, kote hong dawng in!
Yahweh in a munsiangtho panin thu gen a, “Ka gualzo ding hi! Shechem ka khenkhia ding a, Succoth Kuam ka tehkhia ding hi!
Gilead pen Kei aa hi a, Menasheh kei aa ahi hi! Ephraim in Ka lutang-a sik lukhu; thahatna, ahi hi! Yahdah pen Ka Thukhampiapa; kumpi-ciangkhut, ahi hi.
Moab pen Ka kisilna tuikuangpi hi a, Edom’ ngawng tungah Ka khedap ka koih ding hi! Philistia tungah gualzo-in ka kiko ding hi!” a ci hi.
Kua in khuapi muanhuai sungah eite hong paipih ding ahi hiam? Kua in Edom ah eite hong makaih ding ahi hiam?
Kote a hong nialkhinpa Yahweh aw, nang hih ding hi lo na hi hiam? Ka galkapte uh tawh hong kuan nawn lo Yahweh aw, nang hih ding hilo na hi hiam?
Mihing hotkhiatna in a mawknapi ahih manin ka galte uh langah kote hong huh in!
Yahweh tawh gualzawhna ka ngah ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, ka galte uh hong sikcipsak dingpa nang na hi hi.
Yahweh kote Pa aw, ka kikona uh hong za inla, ka thungetna uh hong ngai in!
Leitung mongte panin nang tungah kong kiko uh hi! Ka lungsim uh a neu ciangin ko sangin a sangzaw Suangpi ah kote hong paipih in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen ko aa dingin ka bukna uh leh ka galte omna panin ka tausang muanhuai uh na hi hi.
Nangma buk sungah ka teng tawntung ding uh hi! Na khate’ kepcingna ka muang ding uh hi! Selah.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nangmah in ka kiciamnate uh na za khin hi. Na Min hong zahtakte’ luahna kote nong pia khin hi.
Kumpipa’ nuntak nite behlap in. Mong neilo khang tawntungin amah nungtasak in!
Nangma omna-a kumpi-tokhom ah a tawntungin amah tu ding hi. Yahweh aw, hehpihna leh thumanna tawh hong panpih inla, tuate in kote hong dal tahen!
Tua ahih ciangin nisimin ka ciamna bangun gamta-in a tawntungin Nangma Min phatnate ka sasa ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Nangma sung bekah ka lungsim un daihna a mu hi! Nangma sung bekah kote kihotkhiatna om hi!
Nangmah bek ka Suangpi, ka hotkiatna leh ka bukna uh na hi hi. Kote munkip panin ka kiliing ngawh kei ding uh hi.
Amaute in sanggampa tungah siatna ding bang tanvei sawmsim ding uh ahi hiam? Kulh awnsa leh dai kipuk dek a bang lel mipa, amaute in bang tanvei va hihgawp ding uh ahi hiam?
Amaute in ama za-liata panin sukniam ding bek sawm uh a, a manlo thu leh zuauthu ah nuamsa uh hi! A kam uh tawh amaute in phatkhem uh a, ahih hangin a sungtawng uh ah samsia uh hi! Selah.
Yahweh aw, Nangma sung bek ah ka lungsim un daihna mu hi. Ka lamet uh nangmah ahi hi.
Nangmah bek ka Suangpi leh ka kihotkhiatna uh na hi hi. Nang pen ka kidalna uh na hi a, kote ka liing kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka suahtakna leh ka minphatna uh Nang na hi hi. Yahweh aw, ka thahatna leh ka bukna’ Suangpi pen Nangmah na hi hi!
No mite aw, hun khempeuh ah Yahweh muang un! Ama kiangah na lungsim buakhia un! Yahweh pen eite aa dingin bukna ahi hi! Selah.
A dinmun niam mite husan khat bek hi lel a, a dinmun sang mite zuaupi hi lel hi. Amaute tawi kiteh leh, amaute a mawknapi-in kiseh lel ding hi.
Zawhthawh thu tawh lakna muan-in nei kei inla, suhgawpnate lamet-in nei kei in. Na hauhnate a khan ciangin tuate tungah na lungsim koih kei in!
1 Yahweh in khatvei hong genkhin a, eite in nihvei i zakhin hi; Thahatna Yahweh aa ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, hehpihna in nang aa ahi hi! Mi khempeuh ama sepna tawh kizui-in thaman na pia ding hi!

headings.text: Na Min tawh Khut Ka Laam Uh Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, kote Pa na hi hi! A tuung theithei-in nang kong zong hi! Ka lungsim un nang kong lunggulh mahmah uh a, tui om lohna gamkeu bangin ka pumpi in nang hong deih mahmah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Na vangliatna leh Na minthanna ka muh theih nadingun na munsiangtho sungah nang kong en gige ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma itna kip pen nuntakna sangin hoihzaw a, tua ahih ciangin ka mukte tawh Nang kong phat ding uh hi!
Tua ahih ciangin ka nuntak sung tengun Nang kong phat ding uh a, Nangma Min tawh khut ka lamto ding uh hi!
A ciik leh a thau ne bangin ka lungsim uh tai ding a, kote kam in lungdamna muk tawh nang hong phat ding hi.
Ka lupna tungah Nang kong phawk uh ciangin zan vil sung tawntung Nang kong ngaihsunsun uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen kote huhpa nong hi den a, Nangma kha liim sungah kote’n nuam ka sa ding uh hi.
Nangma tungah kong bel tentan uh a, Na taklam khut in kote hong lenkip hi.
Ko nuntakna thah dingin a hong zongte kisusia ding hi! Amaute lei thupite sungah pai ding uh hi!
Amaute namsau vangliatna tawh suk dingin kipaai mang ding a, uihaite’ an suak ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh sungah Kumpipa lungdam ding hi! Yahweh’ Min tawh a thuciam khempeuhte minthang ding uh a, zuauthu gente’ kamte kihubit ding hi.
Yahweh aw, kote kikona aw hong za in. Gal launa panin ka nuntakna hong dal in.
Migilote kikupsimna leh mawhna a bawlbawl mite’ langdona panin kote hong sel in;
amaute pen a leii uh namsau bangin taat-hiam, a thalte uk kekin, a gu nei kammalte tawh thaltang bangin a kapte ahi uh hi.
Amaute in a buksimna uh panin mawhbang lo mite kapsim uh a, lau het loin thahatin amah kap uh hi.
Amaute a thusia geelnate uh tawh khat le khat kithapia uh a, amaute in thang siah sim ding genin, ‘Kua in ei hong mu ding hiam?’ a ci uh hi.
Amaute in gamtat hoih loh ding sawmin, ‘Thusim cingtak khat kician takin i hih khin hi!’ a ci uh hi. A thutang lo sungtawng ngaihsutna leh mihing lungsim pen thutang lo hi!
Ahih hangin Yahweh in thaltang tawh amaute thakhatin kap ding a, liamna pen amau aa hi ding hi.
Yahweh in amau leii amau tung mah ah hei ding a, amau mawhsakna mah tawh a puk ding uh hi! Amau a mu khempeuh in pelh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihing khempeuh in lamsakna tawh dingin zahtak ding uh hi! Yahweh aw, amaute in na nasepte tangko ding uh a, hih bangin a bawlpa Nang na hihna hong tel ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, nangma sungah thuman mite kipakin, nang hong muang ding uh a, thutang mi khempeuh in nang hong minthangsakin hong phat ding uh hi!

headings.text: Na Teel Mite Thupha Ngah Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Zion ah phatna in nang hong nawk a, nang tung ah ka thuciamna uh kong bawl ding uh hi.
Thungetna a dawngpa aw, Nang kiangah mi khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi!
Ka khialhnate uh simzawh hilo a, ahih hangin ka thupalsatnate aa dingin kithoih nading nong sik hi.
Na huangte sungah teng dingin na neihsakte, Na teel mite thuphangah ahi hi! Na Inn, na munsiangtho-a nopsaknate tawh ka lungkim ding uh hi.
Yahweh kote Honpa aw, a lipkhaphuai a thumaan sepkhiatnate tawh kote nong dawng ding a, leitung mong khempeuh leh tuipi gamlapente dong ah Nang pen a muanhuaipa na hi hi!
Vangliatna tawh kidimin na thahatna tawh mualte na kipsak hi!
Nangmah in tuipite hawkna, tuihual ginngaih leh minamte’ gamlumna na daisak hi!
Gamla peka a tengte in Na hihna limte kihta uh a, zingsang phalvaknate leh nitak khuamuinate ah nopsakna late na gingsak hi.
Nangmah in leitung donin tui na pia a, na hausak hi. Yahweh’ gun tui tawh kidim a, mite an na sik nadingin na sehsa ahi hi.
Lo leisaite na kawtsak a, a vuumte na maihtam hi. Khuapi gawh tawh na nipsak a, ankungte na pungsak hi.
Nangmah in kum na guahna khusak a, na zawi ah lawhcinna a dimletin a taak hi.
Gamlak lonona ah kia a, mualneute lungdamna tawh a kidim hi.
Lono munte tuuhon in tuam a, kuamte zong an in a tuam hi. Amaute nuamsa-in awngin la a sa uh hi.

headings.text: Yahweh tungah Lungdamna tawh Awng Un!

verses.text: Leitung khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah lungdamna aw ging phasak un!
Ama Min pahtawina la sa un! Yahweh pahtawi un! Yahweh phat un!
Yahweh kiangah, ‘Na nasepte dipkuat-huai mahmah hi! Na vang liat mahmahna tungtawnin nang tungah na galte hong ki pumpiak uh hi!
Leitung khempeuh in nang hong bia-in nangmah phatna la hong sak uh hi! Amaute in Nangma Min phatnate sa uh hi, Yahweh aw! Selah.
Hong pai unla, mihing’ tapate kianga a kihtak-huai nasep, Yahweh’ nasepnate mu un.
Amah in tuipi pen leikeu suaksak a, amaute in a khe-un gun a kan uh hi. Hong pai un, Yahweh sungah lungdam ni!
Amah in a vangliatna tawh a tawntungin uk hi. A mitte in minamte gen gige hi; tua bang hi keileh a lehgamtatte amau leh amau kiliansak uh hi. Seleh,’ ci un.
No minamte aw, Yahweh i Pa phat un! Amah phatna aw kizasak un;
Amah pen a nungtate lakah eite hong koihin, i khete a puk ding hong phallopa ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nangmah in kote nong sin zo hi. Ngun a kihalsiang bangin kote nong siangsak khin hi.
Nangmah in kote ngenthang ah nong awksak a, kote kawng ah vangik nong koih hi.
Kote lu tungah mite a tuang dingin na phalzo a, kote in meikuang sung tui sung ka nawk uh hi; ahih hangin tu-in nangmah in hauhletna ah kote nong tungsak hi!
Meihal biaknate tawh Nangma Inn sungah ka pai ding uh hi. Nang tungah ka thuciamnate uh kong tantung ding uh hi;
tuate pen ka lungkham lai-un ka mukte genkhiat leh ka kamte uh paukhiat ahi hi.
Kote in tuutal biakna’ khu namtui tawh ganhing’ thau meihal biakpiakna kong pia ding uh hi. Bawngtalte leh keeltalte tawh biakna kong bawl ding uh hi. Selah.
Yahweh a zahtak note khempeuh, hong pai unla, za un! Yahweh in eite aa dingin a hihsakte i tangko ding hi.
Ama tungah i kamin i kiko a, Amah kithupi gen a, Ama tunga phatna sangpite pen i leii tungah om hi.
I lungsim sungah mawhna a pakta hileng, Yahweh in eite thu hong ngai het lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin Yahweh in hongza khin taktak hi! Amah in eite’ thungetna awging hong za khin hi.
Ka thungetnate uh hong heikhiatsak loin, kote kiang panin na itna kip a heikhia lo, Yahweh aw, phatna ngah ta in!
Yahweh aw, kote hong hehpih inla, thupha hong pia in; kote tungah na maipha hong tangsak in. Selah.
Nangma zia le tong leitung ah kithei tahen! Minam khempeuhte lak ah Nangma hotkhiatna kithei tahen!
Yahweh aw, mite in nang hong phat uh hen! Minamte in nang hong phat uh hen!
Nangmah in thumaan takin mite’ thu khenin, leitung minamte uk ding na hih manin minamte kipaak uh henla, nuamna la sa uh hen! Selah.
Yahweh aw, mite in nang hong phat uh hen! Khat leh a vekpi, minamte in nang hong phat uh hen!
Leitung in a hauhna gahkhia henla, Yahweh i Pa in eite thupha hong pia hen!
Yahweh aw, nangmah in kote thupha hong pia inla, leitung mongte khempeuh in Nang hong zahtak uh hen!

headings.text: Sihna panin Suahtakna Yahweh kiang pan!

verses.text: Yahweh tho hen! Yahweh’ galte kithehthang hen! Yahweh aw, na mai-ah na galte taikek hen!
Meikhu a vengmang mah bangin amaute notkhia mang in! Mei sungah khuainun a tui mah bangin nangma omna ah migilote mangthang hen!
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, thumaan mite nuamin kipak henla, Nangma omna ah amaute nuamsa uh hen! Hi hi, amaute in nakpi-in nuamsa uh hen!
Yahweh tungah la sa un; Ama Min phatna late sa un! Yahweh ahi Ama Min tawh meiite’ tung a tuang eite Pa phat unla, Ama mai-ah lungdam un!
Pa nei lote’ Pa, meigongte a hupa pen Ama tenna siangtho sunga om Yahweh ahi hi.
Yahweh in a tang om te innkuan guan hi. Amah in thongkiate lungdamna ah a paipih a, ahi zongin mi lehdote keugaw gam ah a teng hi.
Yahweh aw, Na mite mai-ah na kuankhia-in, gamlak nawkin na pai ciangin; Selah.
lei liing a, vantungte in zong Na omna mun ah guahtui taaksak hi; Israyl’ Pa Yahweh aw, Na omna ah Sinai mual nangawn zong liing hi!
Yahweh aw, nangmah in guah tampi na zusak a, a vulsa na gamh na nosuaksak hi.
Na tuuhonte tua sungah na tengsak hi. Yahweh aw, nangmah in mizawngte aa dingin na kicinna panin na sik hi.
Yahweh in thu pia hi. Hih thu a phuangkhiate mihon tam mahmah hi.
Galkap honte’ kumpite taikek uh hen. Amaute taikek uh a, ahih hangin Inn-a omlai mite in van kisutte hawm ding uh hi.
Gamgi ah nuamtakin na lup ciangin, ngun tawh a kituam vakhu’ khate leh kham tawh a zem a multe na bang ding uh hi.
Vanglianpenpa in tua mun panin kumpite a thehthang ciangin Zalmonmual tunga vuk kia tawh kibang ding hi.
Bashan Mual pen thahat a, Bashan’ mualte pen mualkuipi vive ahi hi; ahi zongin Bashan Mual pen Yahweh Mual ahi hiam?
Mualkuipite aw, Yahweh in a ukna mun dinga a teel, Yahweh a ten tawntung nading mun ahi Yahweh Mual bang hangin hazatna tawh en na hi uh hiam?
Yahweh’ sakollengte tul sawm tampi hi a, vantung mite a tultul tampite ahi hi. Siangtho Mun ah Sinai-a mah bangin amaute lakah Yahweh a om hi.
A sangna ah na kahto khin a, gal honpite sal-in na la khin hi! Tua lai-ah Yahweh i Pa a ten theih nadingin mite tung panin letsongte na ngahkhin a, a lehdote kiang nangawn panin na ngah hi.
Eite’vangik nisimin hong puaksak i honpa Yahweh kiphat tahen. Selah.
Eite Pa pen a honkhia Pa khat ahi hi! Sihna pana suahtakna Yahweh i Pa kiang panin hong pai ahi hi.
Yahweh in a galte lutang, a mawhna uh a zom suaksuak mite’ sampha neunau luvunte suzan taktak ding hi!
Yahweh in, “Bashan panin note kong lakhia kik ding hi! Tuipi a thupite sung panin kong lakik ding hi:
tua hileh na galte uh sisan ah na khe na diah thei ding uh a, uite’ leii in a liah theihzah a liak ding uh hi!” a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, amaute in a hona na paina, munsiangtho sungah ka Kumpipa, ka Pa a honpi-a a paina mukhin uh hi.
Lasiamte a mai-a pai uh a, tumging tumte a nungah pai-in, a lai-ah khuang tum numeite a om uh hi.
Mipi kikhopna ah Yahweh phat unla, Israyl mihon kikhopna ah Yahweh phat un.
Amaute a makaih Benyamin kiukeu tua lai-ah om a, Yahdah uliante’ mihonpite zong a om hi! Zebulun leh Naphtali-te’ makaipite zong a om hi!
Yahweh in na thahatna thupia khin hi! Yahweh aw, kote in ka lungdampih un hotkhiatna kilatsakna tawh Na vangliatna lakkhia in!
Yerusalem tungah na mun siangtho a omna hangin kumpite in nang tungah letsongte hong paipih ding uh hi.
Ngun a lunggulh minamte a tuancil, gal kidona nuam a sa mite a thehthangpa aw, pumpeng laka gamsa, minamte’ bawngno laka bawngtal honpite taigawp in.
Egypt panin uliante hong pai ding uh hi. Yahweh aw, Ethiopia in Nang tungah a khut hong zan dek ta hi.
Leitung kumpigamte aw, Yahweh tungah la sa un! Yahweh tungah phatna la sa un! Selah.
Tangtawnga vantungte tungah a tungpa, vanglian awging tawh van a gingsakpa tungah la sa un!
Yahweh’ thahatna tangko unla, ama thupitna pen Israyl tungah om a, a vangliatna pen vantungte ah a om hi!
Yahweh aw, na munsiangtho ah na lipkhaphuai hi! Israyl’ Pa Yahweh aw, na mite tungah thahatna leh vangliatna pia in! Yahweh aw, hong kiphat hen!
Yahweh aw, kote hong hon in! Bang hang hiam cihleh kote tung, ka nuntakna mahmah uh tuite in hong tuum ta hi.
Dinkip nading mun om lohna mun thukpi buannawng sungah ka tumkhin uh hi. tui thukpite sung ka tungkhin uh a, tuikhang in kote hong khuhcip khin hi.
Ka kahna-un ka tawl uh hi. Ka gawlgui uh keu ta hi; Pa aw, nang kong ngakngakna-un ka mitte maang ta hi.
Ka lu tunga samzangte sangin thu om lopi-in Kei hong mudahte tamzaw hi. Kei hong susiate, a zuau ka galte tha khauh uh hi. Bangmah ka guk lohpi-in a lohkik pelmawh ding ka hi hi.
Yahweh aw, ka haina uh na thei hi. Nang kiang panin ka thupalsatnate uh ki-imcip lo hi.
Kote Vanglianpen Pa Yahweh aw, nang hong lamen mite in kote hangin zahhuaisak kei in. Israyl’ Pa aw, nang hong zong mite in kote hangin mindaisak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma hangin kona ka thuak a, maizumna in ka maitang hong tuam khin hi.
Ka sanggam pasalte lakah mi dang ka suak a, ka nu’ tapate lakah khualmi ka suak hi;
ahang in Nangma Inn aa dingin ka aam luatna in kei hong netum a, nangmah hong kote konate keima tungah hong tung khin hi.
Kapin an ka tan uh ciangin, kona ka thuak zo pelmawh ding uh hi.
Puanhampi ka silh uh ciangin mite’ khel gentehna ka suak uh hi.
Kongpi-a tute in eite hong gensia uh a, zukhamte’ la i suak hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, a hun hoih ciangin nangma tungah thu kong ngen uh hi. Yahweh aw, na itna kip a honpite tawh Na hotkhiatna thuman ah kote hong dawng in.
Buannawng panin kote hong honkhia inla, ka tum ding uh hong phal kei in; ko hong mudah mite—tua tui thukpite—kiang panin kote hong honkhia in.
Tuikhang in kote hong khuhcip ding hong phal kei inla, tui thukpi in hong nawmvalh ding hong phal kei in. Dum in ka tungah a kam hong cipsan ding phal kei in.
Yahweh aw, hong za in; bang hang hiam cihleh nangma itna kip lian mahmah hi! Nangma hehpihna honpi tawh kizui-in ko lamah hong kihei in!
Kote lungkham ka hih manun na nasemte kiang panin Na maitang seel kei in! A manlangin hong dawng in!
Hong lam hong neh inla, hong tan in! Ka galte uh hangin kote hong hon in!
Hong kizahkona, ka mindaina uh leh ka maizumna uh na thei hi; Na mai-ah ka galte khempeuh om uh hi.

Zahkona in ka lungsim uh hong tamkhamsak a, huh ding nei loin hong nusia hi. Kote in hong hehpih ding khatpeuh ka ngak uh a, ahih hangin kuamah a om kei hi. Hong hehnem ding ka zon uh a, ahih hangin tua bang mi ka mu kei uh hi.
Amaute in Ka an dingin sinkha hong pia uh a, Ka dangtak hun ah dawn dingin leenggahzu thuk Kei hong pia uh hi.
Amau sabuai amau mai-ah thangzak suaksak inla, lungmuangin a kingaihsut hun a, tua sabuai tehlop thang suaksak in!
Amaute in a muh theih loh nadingun amau mitte mialsak inla, amau kawngte linglingsak in.
Amaute tungah na thangpaihna sungsuk in! Na hehna so in amaute lencipsak in!
Amau tenna mun gamkeu suak henla, amau puanbuk sungah khat zong teng kei tahen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in na liamsak mite bawlsia uh a, na natsak mite’ dahna gengenin a dahsak semsem uh hi!
Amau khialhna ah khialhna behlap inla, Na thumaanna sungah amaute lutsak kei in!
Nuntakna Laibu sung panin amaute phiatkhia inla, thumaam mite tawh ciamteh khawm kei in!
Ahih hangin kote ka kiniamkhiat uh a, ka kisik uh hi! Yahweh aw, Na hotkhiatna in kote hong dalsak in.
Yahweh aw, la tawh Nangma Min ka phat ding uh hi. Lungdamkohna tawh Nangmah kong liansak ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, hih banga hihnate in kii leh khecin a kimin a nei bawngtal ahih keileh bawngtalno khat tawh biakpiakna sangin nang hong lungdamsakzaw ding hi.
Mi kiniamkhiatte in mu-in lungdam ding uh hi! No Yahweh a zongte aw, na lungtang uh thadim ding hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in mizawngte’ aw za a, Ama koltangte simmawh lo hi.
Yahweh aw, vantung leh leitung in nang hong phat hen! Tuipite leh a sunga a gamtang khempeuh in hong phat uh hen!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Zion honkhia ding a, Yahdah khuapite lamkik ding hi! Tuate sungah amaute tengin a tangpah ding uh hi!
Na nasemte’ suante in tua leitang luahin, Na Min a itte tua lai-ah teng ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, kote hong honkhia meng in! Yahweh aw, kote hong huh meng in!
Ka nuntakna uh thah dingin hong zong mite maizumin lungmangsak in! Ka puk ding a deihte khempeuh zahla-in kilehkiksak in!
Kote tungah, “Ha, Ha,” hong cihsan mite, a zumhuai amau kosiatna hangin kiheikiksak in!
Ahih hangin Nang hong zong mi khempeuh Nang sungah lungdamin kipaak uh hen! Na hotkhiatna a it mite in, ‘Yahweh kitawisang hen!’ ci den uh hen.
Ahih hangin kote pen genthei-in a mi cimawh ka hi uh hi! Yahweh aw, ko kiangah hong manlang in! Nang pen kote hong huhpa leh kote honpa na hi hi! Yahweh aw, hong zekai kei in!
Yahweh aw, Nangmah kong muang uh hi! Kote hong zahhuaisak ngei kei in!
Na thumaanna tawh kote hong hon inla, hong suaktasak in! Kote na bil hong ngat inla, hong hu in!
Kote tenna munkip hong hi in; tua lai-ah ka om tawldam tawntung thei ding uh hi. Ko hong hu dingin thu na piakhin hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen ka Suangpi leh ka kulhpi uh na hi hi.
Kote Pa aw, migilote’ khut sung pan, siatna bekbek a bawlte kiang pan leh mi ngongtatte kiang panin kote hong hon in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kote Pa aw, Nang pen ka khangno huna kipanin kote lamet leh kote muanpa na hi hi.
Ka suah-a kipanun nang tungah kong kinga uh hi; Nang pen ka nu’ gil sung panin hong lakhiapa na hi hi. Nang kong phat ngitnget ding uh hi!
Mi tampi aa dingin siahil bang ka hi uh a, ahih hangin nangmah in kote belh muanhuai na hi hi.
Ka kam uh nangmah phatna tawh kidim a, sun tawntungin nangma thupitna ka gengen uh hi.
Ka teek uh ciangin kote hong lawnkhia kei inla, ka tha uh a kiat ciangin hong nusia kei in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka galte in kote hong gensia uh a, ka nuntakna uh that nuamin hong buk mite kikhum khawmin,
“Yahweh in amaute nusia khin hi! Amaute a hu ding kuamah omlo ahih manin delhin va man ni,” ci uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ko kiang panin gamla om kei in! Kote Pa aw, hong huh meng in!
Ka nuntakna uh hong sunuam ka langte uh zahhuai-in beimangsak in! Ko hong nasak nuam vanvante zahkona leh mindaina tawh tuamcip in!
Ahih hangin kote in nang kong lemen-en ding uh a, kong phat semsem lai ding uh hi!
Na thumaanna leh na hotkhiatnate sim zawh hi lo ahih manin sun tawntungin ka gengen ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, na thahatna tawh ka mainawt ding uh a, Nangma thumaanna, Nangma thu bek ka gen ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka khangno hun-a kipanin kote nong hilh a, tua huna kipanin nangma sep na lamdangte ka gengen uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Na hatna hih khang mite tungah genin, hong piang lai ding mite khempeuh tungah Na vangliatna ka genkhit matengun teek-a ka sam uh a kang hun ciang dong nangawnin kote hong nusia kei in.
Yahweh aw, na thumaanna in vantungte dong ban hi! Yahweh aw, na lianpite a bawl Nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?
Gimna lianpipite hong tuaksakpa Nangmah hong pai-in kote nong nungtasak ding hi! Nangmah hong pai-in leitung mun thukpite sung panin nong lakhia to ding hi.
Ka thupitna uh nong khangsak ding a, khatvei nong hehnem lai ding hi.
Nangma cihtakna hangin harp khausai tawh nang kong phat ding uh hi! Israyl’ Siangthopa aw, Nangma tungah lyre khausai tawh la ka sa ding uh hi!
Nangma tungah tumging ka tum uh ciangin ka mukte uh nuamna tawh kiko ding a, nangma tatsa kote in phatna ka sa ding uh hi.
Sun tawntungin ka leii un nangma thumaanna gen ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote siatna ding a zongte amkhamin maizum uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Kumpipa tungah na thutangte pia inla, Kumpipa’ tapate tungah na thumaan hilh in.
Amah in na mite thumaan-in thukhen ding a, na mi cimawhte thutangin thukhen ding hi.
Tua ciangin mualliante leh mualneute in thumaanna tawh na mite aa dingin nopna puak ding hi.
Amah in mite lakah a hingimte thutanna puak ding a, mi cimawhte hu-in, mi nengniamte suzan ding hi.
Ni leh kha a omlai teng, a khang a khangin Amah kizahtak ding hi.
Pawn lak lopa tunga guah zu leh leitung tui a pia guahmal bangin Amah hong paisuk ding hi.
Ama uk hun sungin thumaan mite thamalh ding a, khapi a khawl mateng nopna dim ding hi.
Amah in tuipi khat pan tuipi khat, Euphrates Gunpi pan leitung mongte dong uk ding hi.
Gamlak-a a teng mite Ama mai-ah kun ding uh a, a galte in leivui liak ding uh hi.
Tarshish kumpite leh tuikulh neu-a kumpite in siah puak ding uh hi. Sheba leh Seba kumpite in letsongte pia ding hi.
Hi hi, Ama mai-ah kumpite khempeuh boksuk ding uh a, minam khempeuh in Ama na sem ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in a kikokhia mi cimawhte leh a huh ding omlo mi gentheite honkhia ding hi.
Amah in mi zawngte leh mi cimawhte hehpihna tawh hawi ding a, Amah in mi cimawhte’ nuntakna hon ding hi.
Amah in khemna leh ngongtatna panin amau nuntaknate tan ding a, Ama mit ah amau sisan manpha a sa ding hi!
Amah khansau ding a, Sheba-a khamte Amah kipia ding hi! Ama tungtawnin thungetna kibawl ngitnget ding a, nisimin Amah kiphat ding hi!
Gamsung khempeuh mualtung dawn dong ah Ama teelsate dim metmat ding a, amaute in hih thu tangtungsak ding uh hi. Amaute, Lebanon-a singgah bangin gahpha-in, gamlak lopa bangin khanpha ding hi.
Ama Min kip tawntung ding hi! Ama Min, ni a omlai teng om ding hi! Ama sungah mi khempeuh in thupha ngah ding a, minam khempeuh in Amah thupha hi, ci ding uh hi!
Amah bek in a lamdang nate a sem, Israyl’ Vantung Pa, i Pa Yahweh kiphat tahen!
A minthang Nangma Min kiphat tawntung hen! Leitung buppi Nangma minthanna tawh kidim tahen! Hi tahen, tua bangin piang tahen! Halleluyah!
Yishai’ tapa David’ thungetnate a khupna ahi hi.

headings.text: Paktat Nuamin Hong Nusiate Na Susia

verses.text: Israyl aw, lungsim siangtho mite tungah Yahweh hoih mahmah hi!
Ahih hangin eite i hih leh, i khete taldek zo a, i tuk dekdek hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh migilote’ daupaina i muh ciangin mi kiphasakte i engkha hi.
Amaute aa dingin a sih uh ciang kisan valval kul loin, a thahat suak ding tawh kibang uh hi.
Mi kim ciat’ thuak haksatnate amaute in a thuak kha lo tawh kibang uh a, haksatna a zo mite bangin nuntak haksatnate a thuak kha lo a bang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khi bangin kiphatsakna awk uh a, puan bangin ngongtatna a silh uh hi.
Amau mitte thau-in a lawt mah bangin, amau lungsim ngaihsut siatna in ciangtan nei lo hi.
Amaute in galbawlna tawh zahpih-in pau uh a, kiphatsakin mi a nengniam uh hi.
Amaute in a kam uh vantungte gensiatna-in zang uh a, a leii uh leitung citeng ah a tai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na mite kihei khia-in, hai dim-a om tuite dawnkang uh hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in, “Yahweh in bangci theih ding ahi hiam? Sangpen Pa in theihtheihna nei ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
En in! Tua bang mite pen a siangtho lo mite hi uh a, tua hi napi-in amaute lungmuang takin omin, a hauhna uh khang semsem lai hi.
A taktakin eite in i kiphatsakna lungsimte i siangsak khin a, i khutte mawhpengna-in i sil khin hi;
ahih hangin sun tawntungin natna i thuak a, zingsang simin hong kithuhilh ngitget hi.
Eite in, “Hih bangin ci ni,” ci hi le hang, en in, Na tate khang mite tungah a citak lo ka hi khin ding uh hi.
Hih khempeuh theihtel ka sawm ciangin Yahweh’ munsiangtho sungah ka lut matengun ka lungsim sung uh ah hih thutan lohna sanhak ka sa uh hi;
tua khit ciangin kote in amau thu tawpna ka tel uh hi.
Nangmah in amaute a nalna munte ah na koih takpi ding hi; Nangmah in suksiatna sungah amaute na lawn ding hi.
Aw, tomno sungin amaute kisusia veh e! Amaute lau-na tawh beitum kiuhkeuh ding uh hi.
Mi khat a khanlawh khit cianga a mangmatsa khat bangin Yahweh aw, na thawh ciangin amau gamtat luhek na thupisim kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin ka lung uh khamin, ka lungsim hong nat luat ciangin,
bangmah thei loin ka hai taktak uh hi! Nangma mai-a gamsate tawh ka kibang uh hi.
Ahih hangin Nang tawh kong om ngitnget ding uh hi. Nangmah in ka khut taklam-un nong len hi.
Nangma thugenna tawh kote lam nong lak ding a, tua khit ciangin Nangma minthanna sungah kote nong sang ding hi!
Vantung ah Nang lo kua nei ka hi uh hiam? Nangmah kong nei uh a, leitung ah lunggulh khatpeuh ka nei kei uh hi.
Yahweh aw, lungsim leh ka pumpi zawngkhal kha thei ding a, ahih hangin ka lungsim hatna leh kote sehtanh in a tawntungin Nangmah na hi hi, Yahweh aw.
En in, bang hang hiam cihleh Nang kiang panin a kigamla mite kisia ding uh hi! Paktatna hangin Nang hong nusiate khempeuh na susia khin hi!
Ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh, Yahweh tawh kinai ding hoih hi! Yahweh kote Pa aw, Nangma nasepnate khempeuh ka genkhiat theih nadingun Nangma sungah ka muanna uh kong koih uh hi.
Yahweh aw, bang hangin a tawntungin kote hong nial na hi hiam? Bang hangin na lonona muna na tuute, na hehna’ mei-am tawh bii na hi hiam?
Tanglai-in na leisa na mihonte, na tatsa na luah minam, na tenna hih Zion Mual ah phawk in.
A sia densa mun ah hong kalsuan in. Na munsiangtho sunga na khempeuh gal in susia khin hi!
Ko tawh na kituahna mun laizangah na galte awnggawp uh hi; amaute in etsakna lim dingin limpi suang uh hi.
Amaute pen sing phatna lakah pai-in heipi tawh sing a ban phuk mite bangin gamta uh hi.
Amaute in a lungsim sung uh ah, “Amaute susia beisiang ni!” ci-in ngaihsun uh hi! Amaute in gam sunga Yahweh’ mite kituahna munte khempeuh haltum uh hi.
Kote aa dingin lim lamdang ka mu kei uh a, tu-in kamsang khat zong a om kei hi. Kote tunga hong piang thu bang tan sauvei ding hiam cih a thei khat zong om lo hi.
Yahweh aw, langpangte in bang tanvei hong kosia lai ding uh ahi hiam? Galte in bang tanvei Na Min simmawh bawl lai ding uh ahi hiam? A tawntungin ding ahi hiam?
Bang hangin Na khut dok kikin, Na taklam khut na ang ah koih na hi hiam? Na ang sung panin Na khut lakhia inla, amaute susia in!
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, tanglai pek panin Nang pen kote Kumpipa na hi hi. Nangmah in leitung laizangah hotkhiatna na puak hi.
Na thahatna tawh tuipi na khen hi. Nangmah in tuite sunga tuipi gulte lutang na sukham hi.
Nangmah in Leviathan’ lutangte na suzan a, gamlak-a teng gamsate aa dingin an-in na pia hi.
Tuinakte leh tuikhang a khahkhiapa Nang na hi hi; a luang tawntung gunte a kangsak Nang na hi hi.
Sun nang aa hi a, zan zong nang aa ahi hi; kha leh ni a omsakpa Nang na hi hi.
Leitung gamgite khempeuh a khung zong Nang na hi hi. Phalbi hun leh khuakhal hun a bawl Nang na hi hi.
Hih thu phawk in: Yahweh aw, galte in Nang hong kosia uh hi! Mi haite in Nangma Min simmawh uh hi!
Aw, migilo honpite kiangah na vakhute’ nuntakna pia kei inla, a zawng Na mi honpi mangngilh suak kei in!
Na thuciamna hong phawk in; bang hang hiam cihleh mi ngongtatte tenna-in leitung a mialna munte dim ta hi.
A kinengniamte maizum-in tusak kei inla, mizawngte leh mi cimawhte in Na Min hong phat ta uh hen!
Yahweh aw, tho in, nangma thu ah pang in! Nisimin mihaite in hong nak simmawhna phawk gige in!
Na galte awging don lo kei in! Nang hong langpang mite gamlumna ngaih semsem hi.
Yahweh aw, nang tungah lungdamnate kong ko uh hi! Ka lungdam uh hi! Yahweh kote Pa aw, Na na sep na lamdangte in Nangma Min hong nai-na genkhia uh hi!
Yahweh in, ‘A kiseh hun ka teel a, thutang takin thukhen ding Kei ka hi hi.
Leitung liingin a sunga teng khempeuh a hoi mang ciangin, a khuampite kiptakin a lenpa Kei ka hi hi. Selah.
Mihaite tungah, “Hai gamtat nawn kei un! Migilote aw, na ki uh suang zel kei un!
A sang ah na ki liik kei un! Kiphatsak pau kei un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh nisuahna lam pan ahi a, nitumna lam pan ahi a, leitaw lam pan ahi zongin laptohna hong pai lo hi,’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh pen Thukhenpa hi a, Amah in khat niamkhiatin, adang khat tawisang hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ khut sungah hai khat om a, a namtuite tawh a kihel Yahweh’ sinsona leenggahzu’ phuan tua hai ah a dim hi. Hih panin Amah in sungkhia a, leitunga migilote in a tawdat dong takin a liaktum ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin kote in ka pulak tawntung ding uh in:—Yaaqob’ Pa, Nangma tungah phatnate ka sa ding uh hi—
Yahweh aw, nangmah in, ‘migilote’ kite khempeuh ka sutan ding a, ahih hangin thumaan mite kite kitawisangin ding hi,’ na cihna thu ka pulak ding uh hi.

headings.text: Yahdah Gam ah Na Min Kithei

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Yahdah gam sungah Na Min kithei a, Israyl gam sungah Na Min kitawisang hi!
Salem ah na biakbuk om a, Na tenna mun in Zion sung ahi hi.
Tua lai-ah Nangmah in thalpeu pana thaltangte, lumte, namsaute leh galdona vanzatte na suzan hi.
Nang pen sa tampi omna mualliante sangin thupi suahzaw-in na hoihzaw hi.
Lungtangphate neihsa kisut a, galhangte ihmucip uh a, mi thahatte khat beek in zong a khut uh a zangkha kei uh hi.
Yaaqob’ Pa Yahweh aw, na thuhilhna tawh sakol leh sakolleeng a nihin khawlcip hi.
Zahtak ding nangmah bek na hi a, na heh ciangin nang langah kua ding zo ding ahi hiam?
Nangmah in vantung panin na thukhenna na kizasak a,
thukhen ding leh leitunga a kinengniamte khempeuh a hon dingin na thawh ciangin leitung in Nang hong zahtakin, dai khipkhep hi. Selah.
Migilote tungah Na hehna hangin amaute in Nang hong phat taktak ding uh hi. Na hehna panin a suaktate Na kiimkot ah kikhawm ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh tungah kiciam unla, tangtun un! Yahweh aw, Na kiima omte khempeuh in Nang tungah letsongte hong paipih uh hen, a kizahtak Vanglian Pa aw!
Nangmah in gam-ukte’ lungsim na sukham a, leitung kumpite in Nang hong zahtak uh hi!
Huhna ngenin Nang tungah kong kiko uh hi. Yahweh aw, nang tungah ka awte uh tawh kong kiko uh hi. Na bil hong ngat inla, kote’ thu hong ngai in.
Ka lungkham uh ciangin Nang kong zong uh hi. Zanin khawl loin ka khutte uh ka zankhia uh a, hehnepna ka ngah kei uh hi.
Yahweh aw, kote in nang hong phawkin, ka tau uh hi. Nang thu ka ngaihsun uh a, ka lunggim uh hi. Selah.
Ka mitte uh mitsi thei lo a, lungkham lua-in ka pau thei kei uh hi.
Hun luite, sawt pek lai-a kumte ka ngaihsun uh hi.
Ka late uh zanin ka phawk hi. Hih thu ka lungsimin geelgeelin, hoih takin ka lungngaih ciangin:
“Yahweh aw, Nang a tawntungin kote hong nial ding na hi hiam? Kote hong angvan nawn lo ding na hi hiam?
Nangma hehpihna a tawntungin tawpcipsak ta na hi hiam? Khang tawntung ah Na ciamna kipelh ta ding ahi hiam?
Hehpihna na neih ding mangngilh khin ta na hi hiam? Na hehna tawh Na hehpih-itna humcip khin ta na hi hiam?” ka ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kote in, “Hih in kote thuakna ahi hi; ahih hangin Sangpen Pa taklam khut seplai kumte ka phawk ding uh hi,” ka ci uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Na nasepte ka phawk ding uh hi. Tanglai-a na bawl na lamdangte ka phawk taktak ding uh hi.
Nangma nasepte khempeuh zong ka lungngaingai ding uh a, na sepkhiatte ka ngaihsutpi uh hi ding hi.
Yahweh aw, na lampi a siangtho hi. Yahweh kote Pa aw, nang bangin a lian bang pasian (el) om ahi hiam?
Nang pen na lamdangte a bawl kote Pa na hi hi! Minamte lakah Na thahatna na kilangsak khin hi.
Na taklam khut tawh na mite: Yaaqob leh Yahseph-te’ tapate na tan khin hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, tuite in Nang hong mu uh hi! Tuite in Nang hong mu-in amaute lau uh hi! Tui thukpite kilok hi!
Meiite in tui sungkhia uh a, vante in aw gingsak uh hi! Hi hi, Na thaltangte leng hi!
Pingpei sungah na vanging om a, khuaphialepte in leitung taan hi. Tua ciangin leitung liingin kising hi.
Na lampi in tuipi tawn a, na khelam in tui tamna ah makaih hi, ahih hangin Na khekhapte a kimu kei hi.
Nangmah in Na mite tuuhon bangin Mosheh leh Aaron’ khutin na makaih hi.
Ka mite aw, Ka Thukham ngai un! Ka kam pana kammalte na bil uh ngat un, Yahweh i Pa in ci hi!
Thugentehna tawh Ka kam ka ka ding a, tangtawng hunte panin a theihhak thute ka genkhia ding hi.
Tuate pen na zaksa leh na theihsa uh hi a, i pate in hong gensa ahi hi!
I tate tungah tua thute i im kei ding a, hong pai lai ding khangte tungah a phattak Yahweh thu, Ama thahatna leh Ama bawl na lamdangte i gen ding hi.
Amah in Yaaqob sungah teci khat koih-in, Israyl sungah Thukham khat kipsak a, tua in a pu a pate un a tate uh tungah a theihsak pelmawh dingun Amah in a pu a pate uh tungah a thupiak ahi hi;
Tua hileh a piang lai ding khang mite in tuate a thei ding uh a, a suak lai ding tate nangawn zong kipanin, amau tate tungah a gensawn theih nading uh ahi hi;
Tua hileh amaute in Yahweh sungah lametna nei-in, Vantung Pa nasepnate cik mahin mangngilh lo ding uh hi: tua in Ama Thukhamte a tawntungin a zuih kip theih nading uh leh,
a pu a pate uh bangin a lungkhauh a lehdo khang mi a suah loh nading, a lungsimte a puah lo, Yahweh tungah a lungsim thuman lote ahih loh nading uh ahi hi.
Ephraim mite galvan tawh kithawi-in thalte a puak uh hangin gal kido ni-in a nungkik uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ thuciamna zui loin, Ama Thukham sungah kalsuan nuam lo uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ nasepnate leh amaute tunga a lahsa na lamdangte mangngilh uh hi!
Yahweh in Egypt gam sung, Zoan gamlak ah a pu a pate uh muhin na lamdang bawl a—
Amah in tuipi khenkhia-in, amaute a kantansak hi; Amah in kulhpi khat bangin tuite kiciangin a dingsak hi.
Amah in sunin meii tawh amaute makaihin, zanin meikuang taang tawh a makaih hi.
Amah in gamlak ah suangpite kitamsak a, tui thukpite bangin a tamin tuite a pia hi.
Amah in suangpi panin zong luite luangkhiasak a, gun bangin tuite a luangsuksak hi.
Tua hi napi-in amaute in gam sungah Sangpen Pa lehdo, Ama tungah amaute mawh lai veve uh hi.
Amau lunggulhna a daih nadingin an kalhna tawh amaute in a lungsim sung uh ah Yahweh ze-et uh hi.
Hi hi, amaute in Yahweh gensia-in, “Vanglianpenpa in gamlak ah sabuai hong lui thei ding ahi hiam?
Amah in suangpi satin, tuite luang buahbuah a, luite a dimletin a luan hangin, Amah in a mite aa dingin an zong hong pia-in sa hong sik thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in amaute thu za-in, heh mahmah hi; Yaaqob tungah Ama meikuang kuang a, a hehna in Israyl kang hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ama sungah upna nei lo uh a, Ama hotkhiatna a muang kei uh hi!
Tua hi napi-in Amah in tunglam vanpite thupia-in, vantung kongkhakte a hon hi.
Amah in nek dingin amaute tungah manna zusak a, amaute vantung an a pia hi.
Mite in vantungmite’ an ne uh a, Amah in amaute an tampi a puak hi.
Amah in vantungte panin nisuahna huih nungsak hi; Amah in a vangliatna tawh leitaw lam huih a pi hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in leivui bangin amaute tungah sa zusak a, tuipi-a sehnelte bangin a lengthei vasate a zusak hi.
Amah in amau giahphual laizang leh amau omna kiimkot khempeuh ah a kiasak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in ne-in a gilvah mahmah uh hi; Amah in amau duh mahmah a puak hi.
Ahih hangin amau duh mahmah an a heisan ma uh, amau kam sungah a om laitakpi mahin,
amau tungah Yahweh’ hehna hong tung hi. Amah in amaute’ mi thakhauhpente thatin, Israyl tangvalte a vattuk hi.
Hihte khempeuh hisak napi-in amaute in mawhna bawl veve uh a, a lamdang Ama nasepte um tuan lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Amah in a nite uh a mawknapi-in beisak a, a kumte lauhuaipi-in a beisak hi.
Amah in amaute a thah ciangin, amaute in Amah zong ding uh a, amaute kisikin, limtakin Yahweh zong ding uh hi.
Yahweh pen a Suangpi uh ahihna leh, Sangpen Pa pen amaute a Tanpa ahihna phawk ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in a kam uh tawh Amah pumphat uh a, Amah tungah a leii uh tawh zuau gen uh hi.
Bang hang haim cihleh Amah tungah a lungsim uh thutak lo a, Ama thuciamna ah a kip kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Hehpih heipa Yahweh in amau’ khialhna maisak a, amaute a susia kei hi. Hi hi, Amah in tamveipi a hehna dokkik a, a sinsona khempeuh a phongkhia kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in amaute pen paikhia-in hong kilehkik lo husan khat bang cilesa ahih lelna a phawk hi.
Amaute in gam lakah Amah lehdo pahpahin, sehnel gam ah Amah dahsak ngitnget uh hi!
Hi hi, amaute in Yahweh ze-et kikkik uh a, Israyl’ Siangthopa phinphin uh hi.

Galte kiang panin a tatkhiat ni, Egypt gam ah Ama lim lamdangte bawlin, Zoan gamlak ah Ama na lamdangte a bawl lai, Egypt-te in a dawn theih loh nadingin amau gunte leh luite sisan suaksak lai-a, Ama vangliatna phawk nawn lo uh hi.
Amah in amaute a netum dingin tho honpi leh a susia dingin uiphukte a sawl hi.
Amah in amau ankungte kauphe pia a, amau ankung gahte kaukhuphon a pia hi.
Amah in gial tawh a leengguite sisak a, a theitheekte uh vuk khal tawh a sisak hi.
Amah in a ganhonte uh gialpi ah kahin, a gankhawite uh keektangte lakah a nusia hi.
Amah in amaute lakah a susiamang vantungmi hon khat sawlin Ama hehna kuang, sinsona, thangpaihna, gimnate, amaute tungah a sawl hi.
Amah in Ama hehna zuih ding zawi khat bawlkholin, sihna panin amaute khah lo a, pulnatna ah amau nuntakna a pia hi.
Amah in Egypt gama taciil khempeuh, Ham’ puanbukte sunga pasal picing tacilte a susia hi.
Ahih hangin Amah in a mite tuuhon bangin paikhiatpih a, gamlak ah tuu bangin amaute a makaih hi.
Amah in amaute muanhuai-na ah amaute paipih a, amaute a kihta kei uh hi; ahih hangin tuipi in amau galte uh a tumcip hi.
Amah in Ama gam siangtho gamgi, Ama khut taklam tawh a laksa mualtung ah amaute a paipih hi.
Amah in amaute mai panin minamte notkhia a, amau luah dingin a gam uh ailotna tawh sehsakin, Israyl minamte amau puanbuk sungah a tengsak hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Sangpen Pa Yahweh ze-etin no-in, Ama tecipannate a zui kei uh hi;
a pu a pate mah bangin amaute in lehdo-in a citak kei uh hi. Thal gina lo khat bangin amaute a kihuiheek uh hi.
Amaute in a mun sangte uh tawh Yahweh hehna dingin pan uh hi! Amau pasiante (elohim) tawh Ama hazat dingin a piangsak uh hi!
Yahweh amaute a zak ciangin, Amah heh mahmah hi! Amah in amaute nakpi-in a kih hi!
Yahweh in mite laka a phuh puanbuk Shiloh-a Ama tenna nusia hi.
Amah a thahatna thuciamna singkuang sal tangsakin, Ama hoihna thuciamna singkuang galte khut sungah a pia hi.
Amah in a mite namsau ah pia a, Ama luahte tungah Ama sinsona nga hi.
A tangvalte uh meikuang in kangtumin, a nungakte uh mo la a kisak kei hi.
A siampite uh namsau-in puk uh a, a meigongte un zong a kah kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin ihmutna panin a khanglo, leenggahzu tawh a gualnuam galhangpa bangin Yahweh khanglo a,
Amah in a galte vatkikin, tawntung maizumna tawh amaute a tuamcip hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in Yahseph puanbukte nial a, Amah in Ephraim a teel kei hi.
Ahih hangin Amah in a it Zion Mual, Yahdah minam a teel hi.
Amah in mualte bangin Ama munsiangtho sangpi-in lam a, Yahweh in a kipsak tawntung leitung bangin a khosak hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in a nasempa David teel a, tuu-huang panin a la hi;
Ama mite Yaaqob leh Ama luah Israyl tuu bangin a cing dingin tuupite a cinna panin amah a la hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in lungsim thutang takin tuucing khat bangin amaute cing a, a khut siam mahmahna tawh amaute a makaih hi.

headings.text: Nang Hong Theilo Minamte tungah Na Hehna Sungsuk In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, minamte in Nangma luahna gam sim uh hi! Amaute in Na munsiangtho ninsak uh a, Yerusalem a siasak khin uh hi!
Amaute in vantunga vasate an dingin Na nasemte luangte pua uh a, Na misiangte’ sa, leitung gamsate tungah a pia uh hi!
Amaute in Yerusalem kiimkot ah a sisan uh tui bangin luangsak uh a, amaute a vui ding kuamah a om kei hi!
Kote, ka vengte uh zahko, ka kiimkota omte zahpih leh ciamnuihna ka suak uh hi.
Yahweh aw, bang tanvei heh ding na hi hiam? A tawntung ding hiam? Bang tanvei Na hazatna mei bangin kuang ding ahi hiam?
Nang hong thei lo minamte tungah Na hehna sungsuk in! Na Min a sam lo kumpite tungah Na hehna sungsuk in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Yaaqob netum uh a, ama tenna mun a susia gawp hi!
Ka pu ka pate uh khialhnate, ko tungah hong suan kei in! Kote hong kiniam koih lua khin ahih manin kote hong dawn dingin Na hehpihna honpite hong paisak mengmeng in.
Kote hotkhiatna Pa aw, kote hong huh in! Nangma Min a than nadingin kote hong hon in! Nangma Min na khualna-in ka mawhnate uh aa dingin mawhmai nading hong sik in.
Bang hangin minamte in, “Amau Vanglianpa koi ah om hiam?” ci ding uh ahi hiam? Kote’ mit muhin Na nasemte’ sisan phu lakik in! Yahweh aw, Nang na hihna amaute kitheisak in!
Na thongkiate’ khuisatna, Na mai-ah hong tung henla, si dingin a kisehsa mite Na vangliatna a liat mahmahna tawh kituakin suaktasak in!
Yahweh aw, amaute in nang hong mawhsakin hong zahkona mah tawh a zah sagih vei val ka vengte uh ang sungah thukkik in!
Ahih hangin Na mite leh Na lonona-a na tuu ahi kote in Nang tungah lungdam kong ko tawntung ding uh hi! A khangkhangin Nangma phatna lakkhia-in, ka gengen ding uh hi!
Tuu bangin Yahseph a makaih, Israyl Tuucingpa aw, na bil hong ngat in! Cherub-te kikala a tupa aw, hong tangpha in!
Ephraim, Benyamin leh Manasheh-te omin Na tha sankhia inla, kote a hon dingin hong pai in!
Yahweh aw, ka ngei uh hong bangsak in! Ko tungah Na maipha hong taan in; tua ciangin kote ka suakta ding uh hi!
Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, Na mite thungetna tungah bang tanvei na hehna kuang ding ahi hiam?
Nangmah in an bangin khitui tawh nong vak a, dawn dingin khitui tampi na pia hi.
Nangmah in ka vengte uh thusim loh-in nong bawl a, ka galte uh amau lakah zahpihin hong nuihsan uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka ngei uh hong bangsak in! Ko tungah na maipha hong taan in; tua ciangin kote ka suakta ding uh hi!
Nangmah in Egypt panin leenggui khat na paikhiatpih hi. Nangmah in minamte notkhia-in, tua leenggui na suan hi.
A lampi na bawlsak a, amah in zungthuk kha-in gam sung teng a dim hi.
Ama liim in mualliante tuam a, tamtak sing liante bangin a hiangte a kizalkhia hi.
Israyl in a hiangte, Mediterranean Tuipi ah zaamkhiasak a, a dawnngekte in Euphrates Gun a zuan hi.
Tua lampi a nawk khempeuh in a gah a lawh theih nadingin bang hangin ama daigawl suksiatsak na hi hiam?
Gamlak-a om ngal in susia gawpin, zang sunga om gamsate in netum uh hi.
Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, kong thuum uh hi, hong kiheikik in; vantung panin hong en inla, hong mu in. Hih leenggui hong don in;
Nang aa dingin na khut taklam tawh na suansa leh na thahatsak a Hiang; Tapa, omsak lai in.
Tua pen mei tawh kihalin, kisatpuk hi. Hehin na tai-na tawh amaute kisia uh hen!
Na taklama Mipa tungah Na khut khak inla, Nang aa ding mahin Mihing’ Tapa thahatsak in.
Ahih hangin Nang kiang panin cik mahin ka kiheikhia kei ding uh hi. Nangmah in kote nuntakna nong ngahsak kik ding a, tua ciangin Na Min ka lo ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, ka ngei uh hong bangsak in! Ko tungah Na maipha hong taan in; tua ciangin ka suakta ding uh hi!

headings.text: I Pawi Ni, KhaLiik Hun ah Peengkul Muut Un!

verses.text: I Thahatpa Yahweh tungah nakpi-in la sa un! Yaaqob’ Pa tungah nuamin awng un!
La khat phuangin, khuangno tumin, a ngaih lyre khausai, harp tawh tumkhawm un.
Kha-det ah peengkul muut un! A thupi i Pawi ni, kha liik sung, a kiseh hun ah peengkul muut un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen Israyl-te aa dingin biakna ngeina kip khat hi a, Yaaqob’ Pa Thukham khat ahi hi.
Eite in i tel loh kampau i zakna mun Egypt leitang panin Amah a paikhiat ciangin Amah in teci khatin Yahseph sungah hih thu a kipsak hi.
Yahweh in, “Keimah in a liangko panin vangik ka hepkhiatsak a, ciangkhaite panin a khutte kisuaktasak hi.
Haksat hun ah na kiko a, Keimah in kong honkhia hi. A kilang lo vanging sung panin nang kong dawng hi. Meribah tui phualte ah nang kong sittel hi. Selah.
Ka mite aw, za un; note tungah vauhilhna hong pia hi! Israyl aw, ka thu hong ngai hi loh le cin!
Note lakah gamdang pasian (el) na nei kei ding uh a, a kikham god (el) khatpeuh zong na bia kei ding uh hi!
Kei pen Yahweh note Pa, Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi; na kam uh a golin ka un, Keimah in kong dimsak ding hi.
Ahih hangin Ka mite in Ka aw hong ngai nuam lo uh a, Israyl in Ka thu hong mang lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau lungsim khauhna bangin ka khahkhong a, amau ut bangin a gamta uh hi.
Ka mite in Ka thu hong mang hoh leh maw! Israyl in Ka lampite zui hoh leh maw!
Amau galte ka zawhsak pak ding a, amau galte langpangin ka khut ka liik ding hi.
Tua ciangin amau mai-ah Yahweh a mudahte lau-in toncip khin ding uh hi; ahih hangin minamte dantatna ding hun pen a tawntungin kikipsak hi.
Ahih hangin note pen mangbuh limcipen tawh hong kivak ding a, suangpi pana khuaizu tawh kong taisak khin ding hi,” a ci hi.
Pasiante (elohim) kikhopna sungah Yahweh hong ding a, Amah in pasiante (elohim) lakah thu a khen hi!
Yahweh in, “Bang tanvei thutang lote panpihin, mimawhte panpih lai ding na hi uh hiam?
Mi thanemte leh pa nei lote na panpih ding uh ahi hi! Mizawngte leh a kinengniamte’ thumanna na letkipsak ding uh ahi hi!
Mizawngte leh mi cimawhte hon unla, migilote khut panin amaute na hotkhia ding uh ahi hi.
Bangmah na thei kei a, bangmah na tel kei uh hi; khuamial sungah na vak kawikawi uh a, note hangin leitung bulpite khempeuh a kiliing gawp hi!
Kong cikhin hi: Note pen pasiante (elohim) na hi uh a, Sangpen Pa’ tapate na hi uh hi;
tua hi a, Adam bangin na si ding uh hi. Adang gam-ukte khempeuh mah bangin na puk ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, tho inla, leitung thukhen in! Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in minam khempeuh khauhtakin na mancip ding hi!
Yahweh aw, dai dide-in om kei in! Pa aw, lung nuamin tang loin om kei in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh en in, Na galte in gamlum ziazua-na piangsak uh a, Nang hong mudahte kiphasak uh hi.
Amaute in Na mite langpanin zuau siamna tawh gelsim uh a, itna tawh na kep mite langah sawmsim-in,
“Hong pai un, minam khat hihna panin amaute susia ni! Israyl’ min kiphawkkhasak nawn kei ni!” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in lungsim kikhatin sawmsim taktak uh a, amaute in Nangma langah kizopkhopna khat bawl uh hi:
Edom’ puanbukte leh Ishmayl mite’, Moab leh Hagar mite,
Gebal; Byblos, Ammon, Amalek leh Tyre-a tengte tawh Philistia-te,

Assyria in zong amaute pawlpih uh a, amaute in Lot’ suanlekhakte a thahatsak dingin a pawl uh hi. Selah. 9-10 En-Dor ah mangthangin, leilak ah nin bangin a suak Midian mite, Sisera leh Kishon Lui-a Yabin-te tunga na bawl bangin amaute bawl in!
A mi thupite uh Oreb leh Zeeb bangin bawl inla, a uliante uh Zebah leh Zalmunna bangin bawl in;
tua mite in, ‘Ei neih dingin Yahweh’ Innte sutkhia-in la ni!’ a cite ahi uh hi.
Kote Pa aw, huihpi mai-a pingpei let ninthem bangin amaute peimang in!
Meikuang in gamlak a kattum bang, meikuang in mualliante a kuansak bangin,
Na khuapi huih tawh amaute delh inla, na huihpi tawh amaute lausak in!
Amau maitangte maizumna tawh kidimsak in! Tua ciangin mite in Na Min hong kan ding uh hi, Yahweh aw!
A tawntungin amaute maimialin dipkua den tahen! Amaute mindai-in beimang hen!
Nangma Min khat bek in Yahweh hi a, leitung khempeuh ah Thuneipen Lutang na hihna mite theisak in.

headings.text: Na Inn sunga Tengte Thupha Ngah Hi

verses.text: Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, Na biakbuk it huai taktak hi.
Yahweh aw, Na huangte ka lungsim un lunggulh mahmah-in ka zawm zuzen uh hi! A nungta Pa aw, ka lungsim leh ka pumpi un Nangmah deih-in kong kiko uh hi.
Hi hi, ka Kumpi leh ka Pa, Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, Nangma biaknatau nai mun khat ah kawlgit in a inn ding mukhin a, phialphiah in a tano a sial nading bu a nei hi!
Na Inn-a teng mite thupha ngah ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Nangma Min hong phat tawntung thei ding uh hi! Selah.
Nangma sungah a thahat mipa in thupha ngah hi a, ama lungsim sungah Nangma phatna lampite a om hi.
Khitui kuampi kantanin, amaute in tua kuam luitui luanna mun suaksak uh a, guah masa in zong thupha tawh tua mun a dim hi.
Amaute a tha uh hat semsem hi; Amaute khempeuh, Yahwei’ mai Zion ah kilak uh hi.
A honpite’ Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, ka thungetna uh hong za in. Yaaqob’ Pa aw, na bil hong ngat in. Selah.
En in, kote lum Yahweh aw, Na sathau nilhsate’ maitang hong en in.
Mun danga ni tul khat om sangin Nangma huang sungah ni khat om hoihzaw hi. Migilote’ puanbuk sungah ka ten ding uh sangin Yahweh’ Inn-a kongcing ka utzaw uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kote Pa aw, nang pen khuavak leh lum na hi hi! Nangmah in hehpihna leh minthanna na piakhia hi! Thutang takin a kalsuan mite aa dingin na hoih bangmah a siit kei hi.
Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, Nang hong muang mipa thupha ngah ahi hi!
Yahweh aw, na leitang ah hehpihna na lak khin zo a, Yaaqob saltanna pan na ciahpihkik khin hi.
Nangmah in na mite’ khialhna na maisak khin a, kote mawhna khempeuh nong khuhsak khin hi. Selah.
Nangmah in na hehna khempeuh na paaikhia khin hi. Na heh mahmahna panin na kihei zo hi.
Kote hong hon Pa aw, ko tungah hong kiheikik inla, ko lama na hehna tawpsak in.
Hong heh tawntung ding na hi hiam? A khang a khangin na hehna paisuak ding ahi hiam?
Nangma sungah na mite a nopsak theih nadingin nang hong kihei-in nuntakna hong ngahsak kik lo ding na hi hiam?
Yahweh aw, hong hehpih inla, Na hotkhiatna hong ngahsak in!

Vanglian Yahweh aw, nong gen ding thu ka za ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Na mite tung leh Na misiangte tungah kilemna thu nong gen ding hi. Ahih hangin hai tatna ah ka kihei khak ding uh hong phal kei in.
Na gam sungah minthanna a om theih nadingin Nang hong zahtak mite kiang bek ah na hotkhiatna in a naih hi.
Hehpihna leh thuman kimu khawm uh a, thumaanna leh kilemna kinam uh hi.
Leitung panin thuman hong phulkhiading a, thumaanna in vantung panin ensuk ding hi.
Hi hi! Yahweh in phattuamna a nei nate hong pia ding a, i leitang in hauhna a piangsak ding hi.
Ama mai-ah thumaanna pai ding a, Ama khekhap omna lampi ah thumaanna in eite hong koih ding hi.
Yahweh aw, na bil hong ngat inla, kote hong dawng in; bang hang hiam cihleh kote mi genthei, mi cimawh ka hi uh hi!
Kote citak ka hih manun kote hong dal in! Yahweh kote Pa aw, nang hong muang na nasemte hong hon in!
Yahweh aw, sun tawntungin Nang tungah hong kiko ka hih manun kote hong hehpih in.
Yahweh aw, nangmah hong lunggulh ka hih manun Na nasemte hong kipaaksak in.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in lainatna nei-in mawh maisak dingin na om gige hi. Nang hong sam mite khempeuh tungah hehpihna tampi na nei hi.
Yahweh aw, ka thungetnate uh na bil hong ngat inla, kong thuumnate uh hong ngai in.
Ka haksat ni ciangun Nangmah in hong dawng ding na hih manin nangmah kong sam uh hi.
Yahweh aw, pasiante (elohim) lakah Nang tawh a kibang khat beek om lo a, Nangma bawl bangin kuamah in bawl thei lo hi.
Yahweh aw, na bawlsa minamte khempeuh hong pai-in nangma mai-ah hong bia ding uh a, Nangma Min pahtawi ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah lianin, a lamdang nate na bawl hi; Yahweh aw, Nangmah bek kote Pa na hi hi.
Yahweh aw, Na lampi hong hilh in; tua ciangin Nangma thuman sungah ka kalsuan ding uh hi! Na Min a zahtak dingin kote lungsim hong kikhatsak in!
Yahweh kote Pa aw, ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Nang kong phat ding uh hi! Nangma Min ka pahtawi tawntung ding uh hi!
Sheol; hankhuk, thukpite sung panin ka nuntakna uh nong honkhia na hih manin ko tunga nong hehpihna lian mahmah hi.
Yahweh aw, kote langah mi kiphasakte pang uh a, Nangmah hong thusim lo mi ngongtat honte in ka nuntakna uh hong sawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang pen lainatna leh hehpihna a dimin a nei, siatna sauveipi a thuakzo, itna a dimletin a nei, a thuman Pa na hi hi.
Ko lamah hong kihei inla, kote hong hehpih in! Na nasemte tungah Na thahatna hong guan in! Na inn-nasem numeite’ tapate tungah hotkhiatna hong pia in!
Ko aa dingin Na itna lim hong lak in; tua hileh ko hong mudahte in mu-in maizum ding uh hi; Ahang in Yahweh aw, nangmah in kote hong huhin nong hehnem khin hi!
A siangtho mualte ah Nangma bulkip a om hi.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in Yaaqob’ tenna munte khempeuh sangin Zion kongpite na itzaw hi.
Yahweh’ khuapi aw, na minthanna teng kigengen hi. Selah.

Yahweh in, “Kei hong thei mite lak ah Rahab; Egypt, leh Babylon ka ciamteh ding a, Philistia, Tyre leh Ethiopia-te nangawn zong—‘Hihte pen tua lai mah pana suak’ ka ci ding hi. Amaute gamdanga piang ahih uh hangin Yahweh lamah a kikhelte pen gam mi a suak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Zion thu tawh kisai-in ahih leh, “Hihte leh huate ama sung panin suak a, Sangpen Pa mahmah in amah kipsak ding hi,” ci-in kigen ding hi.
Yahweh in “Hihte pen Zion-a suak hi,” ci-in mi kiciaptehna sungah khum ding hi. Selah.
Lasiamte, tumtheih tumte leh a ngeithei mi khempeuh in nangma sungah lasa-in laam ding uh hi.
Kote kihotkhiatna Pa Yahweh aw, nangma mai-ah sun leh zanin kong kiko uh hi.
Ka thungetna uh Nang kiang hong tung hen. Ka kikona uh Na bil hong ngat in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka lungsim uh ah buai-na dim a, ka nuntakna uh hankhuk tawh kinai ta hi!
Kote, dum sunga a paisuk mite tawh kei hong kisim khawm ta a, tha nei lo mite tawh ka kibang uh hi.
Nangmah in na phawk khak nawn loh, Nangma khut panin na hepkhiat, hankhuk sunga a kisial a kithat lum mite bangin a sidek mite tawh hong kituam koih khawm hi.
Nangmah in dum tawngnung pen, a mialna, a thukpente sungah kote nong sial hi.
Na sinsona ko tungah gik mahmah a, na tuihualte khempeuh tawh kote nong nasak hi.
Nangmah in ko kiang panin a gamla ah ka kikholhpihte na kih a, amaute tungah a muhthadah-huai dingin nong bawl hi. Kote hong kikhum cip a, ka suakta zo kei uh hi.
Ka thuakna uh hangin ka mitte uh mial ta hi. Yahweh aw, nisimin nang kong sam uh a, nangma tungah khut kong lam uh hi.
Misite tungah Na nalamdangte lak na hi hiam? A sisate thoto-in, Nang hong phat ahi hiam? Selah.
Hankhuk sungah Na itna kip kigen ahi hiam? Abadon; Suksiatna, ah Na cihtakna kigen ahi hiam?
Khuamialna sungah Nangma nalamdangte kithei ahi hiam? Mangngilhna gam sungah Na thumaan nasepnate kithei ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nangma tungah kong kiko uh hi; zingsangin nangma mai-ah thu kong ngen uh hi.
Yahweh aw, bang hangin kote hong nolh na hi hiam? Ko kiang panin bang hangin na mai hong seel na hi hiam?
Ka khangno huna kipanin ka sih dektak hun dong gim ka thuak uh hi. Nangma lauhuaina ka thuak uh a, cih nading mel ka thei kei uh hi.
Na sinsona in kote hong nawkkhin hi. Na lauhuai-na in kote hong susia hi;
Amaute in tui khang bangin sun thapaai-in kote hong umcih uh a, kote hong tuamcip uh hi.
Nangmah in ko kiang panin gamla pi ah ka itte leh ka lawmte na koih hi; tua hi a, khuamial ka kithuahpih a suak hi.
Yahweh aw, na hehpihna thute a tawntungin la ka sak ding uh hi! Ka kamte uh tawh Na cihtaknate khangsawn khempeuh ka theisak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh kote in, “Na hehpihna kipkho tawntung hi. Vantungte sung mahmah ah Na thutakna na kipsak ding hi,” ka ci uh hi.
Yahweh in, “Ka teelpa tawh thuciamna khat ka bawl zo a, Ka nasempa David tungah ka ciam zo hi:
Na Suanpa a tawntungin Ka kipsak ding a, na kumpi-tokhom khang tawntungin ka kipsak ding hi,” a ci hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, vantungte ah amaute in Na ciamsa thu tangko uh a, na misiangte kikhopna ah Na thutakna genkhia uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh tawh tehpih theih ding vantungte ah kua om ahi hiam? A thahat’ tapate lakah Yahweh tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?
Misiangte kikhopna sungah Yahweh kizahtak mahmah hi. A kiimkot-a om khempeuh in nakpi-in Amah kihta uh hi.
A honpite’ Pa Yahweh aw, nang bangin a thahat kua om ahi hiam? Yahweh tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Ahih keileh Nangma thutakna bang a nei Na kiim nai-ah kua om ahi hiam?
Nangmah in tuipi khang na uk a, a tuihualte a saan ciangin na daisak hi.
Nangmah in a kithatsa luang hawm khat bangin Rahab; Egypt, na suzan a, Na thahat khut tawh Na galte na thehthang hi.
Vantungte Nang aa hi a, leitung zong Nangma aa ahi hi. Leitung leh a sunga om khempeuh Nangma phuhsa ahi hi.
Leilu leh leitaw na piangsak hi. Nangma Min tawh Tabor leh Hermon mual nuamsa uh hi.
Nangmah in na khut na thahatsak a, Nangma khut khauh-in, na taklam khut a kitawisang hi.
