Thutanna leh thumaanna pen Nangma kumpi-tokhom bulpi ahi hi. Itna kip leh thu man tawh na masuan hi.
Yahweh aw, peengkul awging a teel mite thupha ngah hi a, Nangma omna khuavak ah ka kalsuan uh hi.
Kote in Nangma Min tawh sun tawntung nuamsa-in, Nangma thumaanna tawh kote hong kitawisang hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen kote thahatna bulpi na hi a, Nangma pahtawina hangin ka kite uh hong kitawisang hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nang pen kote hong dalpa na hi hi. Israyl’ Siangtho Pa aw, kote Kumpipa na hi hi!

Tua ciangin Nangmah in na mi siangthote tungah mangmuhna tawh thu na gen a, “Keimah in khangno khat tungah thahatna ka hawm a, galhangpa tungah hilo hi. Keimah in mite tungah tua khangno mipa ka tawisang hi.
Keimah in Ka nasempa David ka mu zo a, Ka sathau siangtho tawh sathau ka nilh khin hi.
Amah tawh Ka vangliatna om tawntung ding a, Ka khut in amah thahatsak ding hi.
Galte in ama kiang panin siah kai lo ding a, mimawh’ tapa khat beek in amah thuaksak lo ding hi.
Keimah in ama mai-ah a galte ka sugawp ding a, amah a mudah mite gim ka thuaksak ding hi.
Ahih hangin Ka thutakna leh Ka hehpihna in amah ompih ding a, Keima Min hangin ama ki tawisang ding hi.
Tuipi ah ama khut ka koih ding a, tuikhang ah a taklam khut ka koih ding hi.
Amah in Kei hong samin, ‘Yahweh aw, ka Pa na hi hi! Ka suahtakna Suangpi na hi hi,’ hong ci ding hi.
Keimah in Amah ka tacil ka suaksak ding a, leitung kumpite sangin ka sangsakzaw ding hi.
A tawntunga Ama aa dingin ka hehpihna ka kem ding a, Amah tawh Ka thuciamna dingkip ding hi.
Tua ciangin Keimah in ama Suanpa ka phutkip tawntung ding a, ama kumpi-tokhom, vantung a kip laisiah ka omsak ding hi.
A tate in Ka Thukham nusia-in, Ka thukhennate bangin a kalsuan nop kei uh a,
Ka ngeina kipte simmawh-in, Ka thupiaknate a zuih kei uh leh,
Keimah in amau thupalsatna hangin molhtum tawh daan ka pia ding a, amau khialhna hangin dantatna khau tawh ka sat ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama kiang panin Ka itna kip ka beisiangsak kei ding a, Ka cihtakna zong ka heikhia tuan kei ding hi.
Ka thuciamna ka peel kei ding a, Ka muk pana paikhia Thukham zong ka khel kei ding hi.
Khatvei-a kicing dingin, Ka siangthona tawh ka kiciam zo a, Keimah in David kiangah:
A Suanpa a tawntungin kip ding a, Keima mai-ah ama kumpi-tokhom ni bangin kip ding hi.
Vanpi sunga a citak teci ahi kha bangin a kumpi-tokhom kikipsak tawntung ding hi,” na ci hi.
Ahih hangin Nangmah in na sathau nilhsate na paaikhia a, na nolh hi. Na sathau nilhsate tungah nakpi-in nong heh hi.
Nangmah in Na nasempa tawh na thuciamna na heisan khin hi. Nangmah in a kumpi-lukhu leilak ah paai-in na thusimsak kei hi.
Nangmah in ama kulhpite khempeuh na vangsak a, ama munkip muanhuaite na suknensak zo hi.
Lampi-a a nawkkha mi khempeuh in ama buluh uh a, a vengte simmawh khat a suak hi.
Nangmah in a galte’ taklam khut na tawisang a, ama galte na gualzosak hi.
Nangmah in ama namsau hiam na lehheisak a, galsimna a nangzosak kei hi.
Nangmah in ama minthanna na beisak a, ama kumpi-tokhom lei na denna hi.
Nangmah in a khangno hun teng na tomsak a, maizumna tawh amah na tuam hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, bang tanvei hiam? A tawntungin bucip ding na hi hiam? Meikuang bangin na hehna bang tanvei kuang ding ahi hiam?
Ka nuntakna uh a tom mahmahna hong phawk in! A mawknapi dingin bang hangin mihingte piangsak na hi hiam?
Kua mi in sihna thuak loin nungta thei ahi hiam? Sheol; hankuk’, khut panin kua mi amah leh amah kihon thei ahi hiam? Selah.
Yahweh aw, na thu man tawh David tunga na ciamsa nidanga Na itna kipte koih om ta ahi hiam?
Yahweh aw, na nasemte hong kikosiatnate hong phawk in. Minam tampite khempeuh simmawhna ka lungsim sung uh ah bangci bangin ka puakna uh hong phawk in.
Yahweh aw, na galte hong kosiatna leh Na sathau nilhsate’ khekhap a zahpih nate uh tawh thuaklah dingin hong konate uh hong siatgennate uh phawk in.
Yahweh aw, a tawntungin Nang hong kiphat hen! Halleluyah! Tua bangin hi tahen! Tua bangin piang tahen!
Yahweh aw, nangmah pen khang tawntungin kote tenna mun nong hi den hi.
Mualliante a kipiansak ma, Nangmah in leitang leh leitung na bawl ma-in, tawntung panin tawntung dong Nang pen kote Pa na hi hi.
Nangmah in mihing leivui na suakkiksak a, “No mihing’ tate aw, ciahkik un!” na ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma mit ah kum tul khat sung pen a bei ciangin zanni bang hi lel a, zanvil khat tawh a kibang lel hi.
Nangmah in si-in ihmutna ah tuikhang nawnkhiat bangin amaute na puakhia hi. Zingsangin amaute lopa bangin khang uh hi:
zingsangin tua pen paakin, khang a, nitak ciangin kisattanin, a vul hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma sinsona leh ka lau mahmah uh nangma hehluatna in kote hong laugawpsak hi.
Nangmah in na mai-ah kote khialhnate na koih hi. Nangmah in ka hihsim mawhnate uh Na omna khuavak ah na koih hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma hehluatna hangin ka nite khempeuh uh bei a, ka kumte uh ngaihsutpak khat bangin beitum hi.
Ka nuntak hun uh kum sawmsagih hi a, ka hat uh leh kum sawmgiat ahi hi. Tua hi napi-in ka thahat sung uh haksatna leh dahna hi a, tuate manlang takin bei-in, ka lengkhiamang uh hi.
Na sinsona a vangliatzia kua in thei ahi hiam? Na hehna a vangliatzia pen Nang hong kizahtak ding na deihna zah mahin lian hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pilna lungsim ka ngaih theih nadingun ka nuntak nite uh a simzia hong hilh in.
Yahweh hong kilehkik in; bang tanvei sawt lai ding na hi hiam? Na nasemte tungah hong heh nawn kei inla, hong lainat in!
Zingsang tungin Na hehpihna tawh kote hong lungkimsak in; tua ciangin ka nuntak sung tawntungun kote nuamin ka kipaak ding uh hi!
Kote nong gimsak ni zah leh siatna ka thuak uh kum zah mahin a tamin hong nuamsak in.
Na nasemte tungah Na nasepte kilangsak in. Na minthanna vang, a tate uh tungah kilangsak in.
Yahweh i Pa hoihna, eite tungah hong om tahen. Kote nong khualna-in, ka khutte uh tawh ka sepna uh hong kipsak in. Hi hi, ka khutte uh tawh ka sepna uh hong kipsak in.
Sangpen Pa mun simthama a teng mipa pen Vanglianpenpa’ liim nuai-ah a om ding hi.
Yahweh kiangah, “Nang pen ka bukna leh ka munkip muanhuai na hi hi! Nang pen kote Pa na hi a, Nangmah kong muang uh hi!” i ci hi.
Amah in vasa siahpa thangzak pan leh sih theihna natna lauhuai panin hong honkhia taktak ding hi.
Amah in a khate tawh nang hong tuam ding a, Ama khate’ nuai-ah na lungmuang ding hi. Ama thuman pen na lum leh na kidalna hi ding hi.
Nangmah in zan hun lauhuaina na kihta kei ding a, sun-a leng thaltang zong na lau kei ding hi.
Khuamial lakah a vak khiankhian pulnatna, sun tangpi-a suksiatnate ahi zongin na lau kei ding hi.
Na kiim ah mi tul khat, na taklam ah mi tul sawm hong tuk kha ding hi; ahih hangin tua in na kiang nai hong neh lo ding hi.
Nangmah in na mit tawh na en lel ding a, migilote a kithukkikna na mu ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Yahweh na bukna na hisak hi. Sangpen Pa na Inn hisak na hih manin,
nangma tungah siatna bangmah hong tung lo ding a, na tenna mun zong gimna in hong neh lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in na lampi khempeuh ah nang hong cing dingin a vantung mite hong kemsak ding hi.
Suang tungah na khe a kitah khak loh nadingin, amaute in a khut tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi.
Nangmah in humpinelkai leh gul gu nei tung na tawn ding a, na khe nuai-ah humpinelkai khanglai leh gulpi na tuancil ding hi.
Yahweh in, “Itna tawh kei hong bel na hih manin, nang hong honkhia-in, kong suaktasak ding hi. Nangmah in Ka Min thei na hih manin mun sangna ah kong koih ding hi.
Nangmah in Kei nong sam ding a, nang kong dawng ding hi. Haksat hun ciangin nang kong ompih ding a, nangmah hong honkhia-in kong pahtawi ding hi.
Nuntak sau tawh nang kong lungkimsak ding a, Ka hotkhiatna kong lak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh aw, nangma tungah lungdam koih ding a hoih hi a, Sangpen Pa aw, Na Min phatnate sak ding a lungdam huai khat ahi hi.
-3 Zangsawm zither khausai awging tawh harp leh lyre kihual taka tumin, zingsangin Nangma itna kip tangko ding leh zan simin Nangma thutakna genkhiat ding a a hoih ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nangmah in na sepna hangin kote nong lungkimsak hi. Na khuta na sepnate lungdamin la-in ka sa uh hi.
Yahweh aw, na nasepte lian taktak a, na ngaihsutnate thuk mahmah hi!
Ngaihsutna nei lote in a thei loh, mi haite in a teltheih loh thu in:
lopa bangin migilote selkhia-in, paak bangin mawhna bawlte a palh hangin, amaute kisusia paisuak ding uh hi!
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang hong kitawisang tawntung ding hi!
Na galte en in, Yahweh aw, bang hang hiam cihleh na galte beimang ding uh hi! Mawhna bawlte khempeuh kithehthang uh hi!
Ahih hangin Nangmah in zangsial bangin ka kite uh nong tawisang a, sathau hoihpen tawh sathau nong nilh hi.
Ko hong buksimte, ko hong langpang migilote a kizawhgawpna ka mit uh tawh ka mukhin uh hi. Ka bilte un a zaksa thu in:
Nisuh kung bangin thumaan mite nisuh palh ding a, Lebanon-a tamtak bangin khang ding hi.
Yahweh’ Inn sungah a kisuan mite pen i Pa’ huangte sungah palh ding hi.

-15 Amaute pen a tek hun ah zong gah veve ding uh hi. “Yahweh thutang hi! Amah i Suangpi hi a, Ama sungah thumaan lohna khat zong om lo hi!” ci-in tangko theih nadingin amaute tui kiuhkeuh-in, hing sitset ding uh hi.
Yahweh in uk hi! Nangmah in thupitna puan bangin na silh hi! Yahweh kote Pa aw, nangmah in thahatna tawh puantual bangin na kituam a, na silh hi! Leitung zong na kipsak a, a kiliing thei kei ding hi!
Tanglai pek panin na kumpi-tokhom kikipsak a, a tawntunga om densa na hi hi!
Yahweh aw, tuikhangte kiliikto-in, tuikhangte in a aw khangsak uh a, tuikhangte in a tuihualte sangsak uh hi.
A sangna-a Yahweh pen tuipi tampite’ gamlumna sangin thahatzaw a, tuipi tuihualte sangin hatzaw hi.
Na tecite kician taktak hi; Yahweh aw, sianthona pen etlawm a, a tawntungin Na Inn tawh kilawm hi.

headings.text: Na Thukham a Kihilhpa Thupha Ngah Hi!

verses.text: Phulakna thu nei Yahweh kote Pa, phulakna nei kote Pa aw, hong taangkhia in!
Leitung Thukhenpa aw, thoto inla, a kituak thuhkikna tawh a kiphasakte thukkik in!
Yahweh aw, migilote bang tanvei, bang tanvei migilote gualzo lai ding ahi hiam?
Amaute in gitlohna thu sungkhia-in kisaktheihna vive gen uh hi; mawhna bawlte khempeuh kisialhna tawh kidim uh hi!
Yahweh aw, amaute in Na mite sugawp uh a, Na luahte gimsak uh hi.
Amaute in meigongte leh khualmite that uh a, pa nei lote a suamlum uh hi.
Tua hi napi-in amaute in, “Yahweh in mu lo hi; Yaaqob’ Pa in phawkkha lo hi!” ci uh hi.
No mite laka thutheihna nei lote aw, thusim un! No mihaite aw, cik ciangin pil ding na hi hiam?
Bil khua a zasakpa in za lo ding ahi hiam? Mittang a bawlpa in mu lo ding ahi hiam?
Minamte a thuhilhpa in dantat lo ding ahi hiam? Mihingte thutheihna a hilhpa in thutheihna nei lo ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh in mihingte’ ngaihsutnate thei a, Amah in tuate a mawknapi ahih lam zong thei hi.
Yahweh aw, Na Thukham sung hilhin, thuhilhin, na lamlah mipa thupha ngah ahi hi;
Tua ciangin migilote aa dingin dum a kitawh dongin Nangmah in haksat nite panin amah na tawlngasak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a mite paaikhia lo ding a, Ama luahte zong nusia lo ding hi;
Ahih hangin thutang pen thumaan lampite ah ciahkik ding a, lungsim thutakte khempeuh in zui ding uh hi.
Siatna bawlte langah ei aa dingin kua pang ding ahi hiam? Mawhna bawlte langah ei aa dingin kua dingto ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh aw, nang pen kote’ huhpa hi zenzen kei lecin, hankuk dai dide sungah ka teng khin tham ding uh hi.
Kote in, “Ka khe uh taal hi!” ci le ung, Na itna kip leh na hehpihna in kote hong lenkip hi, Yahweh aw.
Kote sungah lunghimawhna a tamluat ciangin, Nangma hehnepna in kote hong nuamsak hi.
Thukham pansanin siatna a piangsak mawhna kumpi-tokhom, Nang tawh kipawl thei ahi hiam?
Amaute in thuman mite’ nuntakna langpanin kigawm khawm uh a, mawhbang lo mite sihna dan a thuaksak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh pen i kidalna hi a, eite Pa pen i bukna Suangpi ahi hi.
Nangmah in amau khialhna amau tung mah ah na tungsak hi! Amau gitlohna laizangah amaute na sattan ding hi! Yahweh kote Pa aw, nangmah in amaute na susia ding hi!
Aw, hong pai un, Yahweh tungah la sa ni! I hotkhiatna Suangpi tungah lungdamin nakpi-in kiko ni!
Lungdam kohna tawh Ama omna mai-ah va pai ni! Lungdamin Ama tungah la ngaih sa ni!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nang pen Vanglianpen Vantung Pa na hi a, pasian (el) khempeuh tungah Kumpi lian khat na hi hi!
Nangma khut sungah leitung thukpite om hi. Muan lian sangpite zong Nang aa ahi hi.
Tuipi Nangma aa ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma bawlsa hi a, Na khut tawh leikeu na bawl hi.
Hong pai un! Kun-in bia ni! Kote hong Bawlpa Yahweh aw, Nangma mai-ah kote hong khukdin sak in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Nang pen kote Pa na hi a, kote pen Na lonona-a mite leh Na khut sunga tuute ka hi uh hi. Tuni-in hih bangin Ama tangkona Yahweh’ awging za un:
“Meribah-a na hih bangun leh sehnel gam sung Massah ah tua ni-a na hih bangun na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un;
tua teng pen na pate un Ka nasepna mu napi-in Kei hong ze-etna leh hong phinna mun ahi hi.
Keimah in kum sawmli sung a gilo khang mite a mudah a, ‘Amaute a lungsim pialsate hi uh a, Ka lampite a thei kei uh hi,’ ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ka hehsa-in amaute tungah ka kiciam a, ‘Ka tawlngakna ah amaute cikmahin a lut kei ding uh hi,’ ka ci hi!” a ci hi.

headings.text: A Siangtho a Etlawmte tawh Yahweh Bia Un!

verses.text: Yahweh tungah lathak sa un! Leitung khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah la sa un!
Yahweh tungah la sa unla, Ama min phat un! Nisim-in Ama hotkhiatna tangko un!
Minamte tungah Ama minthanna genkhia unla, minam khempeuh lakah Ama na lamdangte gen un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh lian a, nakpi-in phat ding ahi hi! Amah bek zahtak ding hi a, pasiante zahtak ding hi lo hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh minamte’ pasiante khempeuh pen milim hi lel a, ahih hangin Yahweh in vantungte a bawl hi!
Pahtawina leh thupitna Ama kiangah om a, hatna leh hoihna Ama munsiangtho ah om hi.
Minam innkuante aw, Yahweh a hi ding bangin hisak un, minthanna leh thahatna Yahweh aa ahi bangin phawk un.
Ama Min tawh kituak minthanna Yahweh pia un! Biakna paipih unla, Ama huang sung zuan un.
A siangtho a etlawmte tawh Yahweh bia un! Leitung khempeuh aw, Ama mai-ah liing un!
Minamte lakah, “Yahweh in uk hi!” ci un. Leitung kiptakin kikhosak a, kikhin thei lo hi! Yahweh in thumaan takin minamte thukhen ding hi!
Vantungte nuam uh henla, leitung kipak hen! Tuipi leh a sunga omte khempeuh awng tahen!
Lote leh a sunga omte khempeuh in nuamin diang uh hen! Tua ciangin gamlak-a singkungte in lungdamna la sa ding uh hi!

Yahweh hong pai ahih manin amaute in Yahweh mai-ah lungdamna la sa ding uh hi! Leitung thu a khen dingin Amah hong pai hi! Amah in thumaan takin leitung thu khen ding a, Ama thuman tawh minamte thu khen ding hi.

headings.text: Yahweh’ Min Siangtho Phawkin Lungdam Ko Un!

verses.text: Yahweh in uk hi! Leitung lungdam hen! Tuikulhneu honpite zong kipaak uh hen!
Meiite leh khuamial sahpih in Amah umcih hi; thumaanna leh thutanna pen Ama kumpi-tokhom bulpi ahi hi.
Ama mai-ah meikuang pai a, Ama kiimkot-a a galte a kangtum hi.
Ama khuaphialepte in leitung taan a, leitung in mu-in a liing hi.
Leitung khempeuh a Ukpa mai, Yahweh omna ah muan lianpite khuainun bangin tui ding hi.
Vantungte in Ama thumaanna tangko ding uh a, minam khempeuh in Ama minthanna mu ding uh hi.
Biakna ah a kisek milim a zangte, bangmah man lo milim a kisaktheihpihte leh pasiante a bia amaute khempeuh kizogawp henla, maizum uh hen!
Zion in za-in, kipaak a, Yahweh aw, Na thukhennate hangin Yahdah’ tanu nuam mahmah uh hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nang pen leitung khempeuh ah Sangpen Pa na hi hi! Pasian khempeuh sangin Nang na lianzaw hi!
Nangmah in siatna a mudah mite na it hi! Nang hong it mite’ nuntakna na hu ding a, migilote’ khut sung panin amaute na honkhia ding hi!
Thutang mite aa dingin khuavak khaici bangin kituh a, lungsim thutang mite aa dingin lungnopna kituh hi.
No thumaan mite aw, Yahweh sungah lungdam un! Yahweh’ Min siangtho phawkin lungdamnate ko un!
Yahweh tungah la thak khat sa un; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in na lamdang lianpite bawl hi! Ama taklam khat leh Ama khut siangtho in a hotkhiatna sem khin hi!
Yahweh in Ama hotkhiatna theikhiasak khin hi! Amah in minamte muhna ah Ama thumaanna kilang takin lakkhia khin hi.
Amah in Israyl innkuan tungah Ama hehpihna leh cihtakna phawk zo a, leitung mongte khempeuh dong in eite Pa’ hotkhiatna a mu khin uh hi.
Leitung khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah lungdamin awng un! La sa ziahziah un! Lungdamin la sa un; hi hi, phatnate sa un!
Lyre khausai tumin Yahweh tungah gingsak unla, lyre khausai leh la ngaih tawh phatna la sa un!
Peengkulte leh tuutal kite tawh i Kumpipa Yahweh mai-ah lungdamin awng un!
Tuipi leh a sunga om khempeuh awng henla, leitung leh a sunga teng khempeuh awng beba uh hen!
Gunte in a khutte uh beng henla, mualte lungdamin la sa khawm uh hen!
Yahweh mai-ah amaute in la sa uh hen! Bang hang hiam cihleh leitung thu a khen dingin Amah hong pai ta hi! Yahweh in minamte amau hihna tawh kituakin thumaan takin leitung thukhen ding hi!
Yahweh uk hi; minamte liing uh hen! Cherub-te kikal ah kumpi-tokhom tawh Yahweh tu hi; leitung kiliing hen!
Yahweh aw, Zion ah nang na lian a, minamte khempeuh sangin na sangzaw hi.
A lian a lipkhaphuai Nangma Min amaute in phat ta uh hen! Nang na siangtho hi!
Nang Kumpi na hi a, thutang na deih hi! Deihsak tuam neih lohna na phutkip khin hi! Nangmah in Yaaqob sungah thukhenna leh thutang na sem hi!
Yahweh i Pa liansak un! Ama khephung ah bia un! Yahweh aw, nang na siangtho hi!
A thumaan nangma siampite lakah Mosheh leh Aaron kihel hi. Nangma Min a lo siampite lakah Samuyl zong kihel hi. Yahweh aw, amaute in Nang hong sam uh a, Nangmah in amaute na dawng hi.
Nangmah in meii khuapi sung panin amaute na hopih hi; amaute in na piaksa tecite leh biakna ngeina kemcing uh hi.
Yahweh kote Pa aw, nangmah in amaute na dawng hi. Nangmah in amau mawh kaltangnate na thukkik hangin, Nang pen amaute tungah mawh a maisak Pa na hi hi.
Yahweh i Pa liansak un! Amah bia unla, Ama mual siangtho lamah kunsuk un! Yahweh kote Pa aw, nang na siangtho hi!
No gam khempeuh aw, Yahweh tungah lungdamna aw gingsak un!
Kipaak takin Yahweh’ na sem un! Lasakna tawh Ama omna mai-ah pai un!
Yahweh pen i Pa ahihna thei un! Eite hong bawlpa Amah hi a, ei leh ei-a piang i hi kei hi. Eite Ama mite i hi a, Ama lonona sunga tuute i hi hi.
Lungdamkohna tawh Ama kongpite ah lutin, phatna tawh Ama huang sungah pai un. Ama tungah lungdam unla, Ama Min phat un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh thumaan a, ama itna kip tawntung hi; Ama thuman khang tawntungin kip paisuak hi!

headings.text: Lampi Hoih I Tawn Ding Hi

verses.text: Na itna leh na thutangna la-in ka sa ding hi! Yahweh aw, nang tungah phatnate ka sa ding uh hi!
Paubanna om loin kidawm takin ka gamta ding uh hi. Aw, cik ciangin hong pai ding na hi hiam? Lungsim paubanna om loin Inn sungah ka pai ding uh hi.
Belial; a sia, a hoih loh, ngimna ka mitsuan kei ding uh hi. Lam khial mite’ nasepna ka mudah uh hi. Amau nasepnate in ko tungah hong bawm lo ding hi.
Eite kiang panin lungsim kawi mite paikhia ding uh a, eite in gitlohna i thei kha kei ding hi.
A sanggampa a gensia sim mi peuhmah i susia mang ding hi. Kiphatsak mithahte leh lungsim kiliansakte i koih khong kei ding hi.
Eite tawh amaute hong tenkhop theih nadingin gam sunga mi muanhuaite i mit suan hi. Paubanna om loin a gamta mipa in eite tawh na hong semkhawm ding hi.
A zuau gamtattat mipa Inn sungah teng lo ding hi. Zuau thu a gen mipa, eite omna ah om thei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Yahweh’ khuapi panin gamtat siatna khempeuh i beisak theih nadingin zing tuungin gam sunga migilo khempeuh i susia ding hi.

headings.text: Hih Bangin Kigelh Ding a, Khangthakte in Yahweh Phat Ding Uh Hi!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, ka thungetnate uh hong za inla, Ka kikonate uh na kiang hong tung tahen!
Haksat hun ciangin ko kiang panin Na maitang hong seel kei in. Na bil hong ngat inla, Nang kong sap ni-un kote hong dawng pah in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka nuntak nite uh meikhu sangin mangthang baihzaw a, ka guhte uh tap tung bangin a sa hi.
Ka lungsim uh na lua a, ka an nek ding uh mangngilhin lopa bangin ka bul uh hi.
A gingin ka tautauna uh hangin, ka guh leh ka vun uh kimat hi.
Gamlaka tuivapi tawh ka kibang uh a, mun kolhna-a om simbu bang ka suakta uh hi.
Ka ihmu thei kei a, inn dawna kawlgit khatguak om tawh ka kibang uh hi.
Sun nilohin ka galte un hong zahko a, ko langneihna bek a buaipih mite in kote’ min tawh midang samsiat uh hi.
Kote in anlum bangin vut ka ne uh a, ka dawn uh zong khitui tawh a kihel hi;
Nangma thangpaihna leh Na hehna hang ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah kote nong domto a, tua ciangin nong paaikhia hi.
Ka nuntakna uh nitak lam niliim tawh kibang a, lopa bangin ka vulgawp uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nangmah in a tawntungin kumpi-tokhom ah na tu a, khang khempeuh ah Nangma Min phawkna kip den hi.
A kiseh hun a tun khit ciangin Zion pahtawi hun tung ahih manin Nangmah tho-in Zion na hehpih ding hi.
Na nasemte in tua khua sungtumte tawh ka lungkim mahmah uh a, a leivuite nangawn thupi ka sa uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh aw, minamte in Nangma Min hong zahtak ding uh a, leitung kumpite khempeuh in Na minthanna hong zahtak ding uh hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, nangmah in Zion na lamkik khin a, Na minthanna na kilangsak hi.
Nangmah in mi gentheite’ thungetna kinin, amau thungetna na simmawh kei ding hi.
Yahweh aw, a piang nai lo mite in Nang hong phat theih nadingun mailama khanglai mite aa dingin hih bangin kigelh ding hi:
“Yahweh in Ama munsiangtho a sang panin hong en suk a, vantung panin Yahweh in leitung ensukin,
thongkiate thuumna a zak theih nading leh, sihna thuak dinga kimawhsak mite a khahkhiat nadingin a ensuk ahi hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Yahweh’ na sem dingin minamte leh kumpigamte a kikaikhop ciangin
Zion ah Yahweh Min kitangko ding a, Yerusalem ah amah kiphat ding hi!
Yahweh in a viangliatna tawh i thahatna hong kiamsak a, eite’ Pa in i nite hong tomsak hi.
Eite in, “Yahweh kote Pa aw, khang tawntungin Nangma kumte kip paisuak ahih manin, ka nuntak kumte a lang a phak ciangin kote hong la kei in.
A kipat cil-in Nangmah in leitung bulpi na phut a, vantungte, Nangma khut-a na bawl ahi hi.
A gilomite, a mawhnate uh hangin kisusia a, ahih hangin Nang na kip ding hi. Hi hi, amaute khempeuh puan bangin paat ding uh hi. Puan bangin amaute na laih ding a, amaute maimang ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Nang na kibang den a, Na nuntak kumte in mong nei lo ding hi.
Na nasemte’ tate nungta ding uh a, amau’ suante Nangma omna ah kikipsak ding hi.

headings.text: A Thuciamna leh A Thukham Zuite tungah Yahweh Dik

verses.text: Ka nuntakna uh tawh nangmah Yahweh kong phat uh hi! Ko sunga om khempeuh in Nangma Min siangtho phat hi!
Ka nuntakna uh tawh nangmah Yahweh kong phat uh a, Nangma hanga phattuamna khempeuh mangngilh kei ding uh hi.
Nangmah in kote khialhna khempeuh nong maisak a, kote natna khempeuh nong damsak hi!
Nangmah in hankhuk panin kote nuntakna na tankhia a, itna kip leh hehpihna lukhu nong khusak hi!
Nangmah in puan etlawmte tawh kote nong zem a, muvanlai bangin ka khangnona uh nong thaksuaksak hi.
Yahweh aw, a kinengniam khempeuh aa dingin nangmah in thumaan leh thutangin na sem hi.
Nangmah in na lampite Mosheh na theisak a, Israyl mite tungah na sepnate na theisak hi.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in hehpihna nei-in, mawhna maisak a, hehhak-in, itna kip tawh na kidim hi;
Ahih hangin Nangmah in nong mawhsak paisuak kei ding a, Na hehna zong na kem paisuak kei ding hi.
Nangmah in kote mawhnate tawh kituakin nong tuaksak kei ding a, ka khialhnate uh tawh kituakin zong nong dantat kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin vantungte, leitung panin a san mah bangin, amah a zahtak mite tungah ama itna kip lianin sang mahmah hi.
Nisuahna panin nitumna a kigamlat mah bangin eite kiang panin i thupalsatna a gamlapi ah hong hepkhiatsak hi.
Pa in a tate a lainat mah bangin, Yahweh aw, nangmah in nang hong zahtak mite na lainat hi.
Kote hong kibawlzia na thei a, leivui ka hih lelna uh na phawk gige hi.
Mihing nuntakna sung pen lopa bang hi a, gamlak-a paak bangin a palh hi.
Tua ciangin huih in amah nawkin, beimang a, tua mun in mah theikha nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, nang hong zahtak mite tungah tawntung panin tawntung dong na hehpihna om a, Na thumaanna in khang sawnsawnte a ompih hi.
Tua mite in Na thuciamna zui-in, na sehsa na thupiakte zui-in sep ding a phawk mite ahi uh hi.
Yahweh aw, nangmah in vantung ah na tokhom na phutkhin a, ahih hangin Na kumpigam in leitung khempeuh a uk hi.
Ama kammal ging a ngai, Ama thupiak banga semin a thahat no Ama vantungmite aw, Yahweh phat un!
Ama deihna banga a sem, no Ama nasem honpite aw, Yahweh phat un!
Ama gam sung mun khempeuh-a ama bawlsate khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un! I nuntakna in, Yahweh phat hen!

headings.text: Minthanna Khempeuh Nang aa hi, Yahweh!

verses.text: Ka nuntakna aw, Yahweh phat in! Yahweh kote Pa aw, nakpi-in na lian hi! Nangmah in pahtawina leh thupitna na silh hi!
Dial puanpi bangin khuavak na silh hi. Sehnel gama biakbuk dalna puante bangin vantungte na zalkhia hi.
Nangmah in na inndei tungnung khuamte phutin tui tawh na nga khawm hi. Nangmah in na leeng dingin meiite na zang a, huih khate tungah na tuang hi. (La 104:13)
Nangmah in na vantungmite kha-in na bawl a, meikuang zong na nasemte na suaksak hi.
Nangmah in leitung ama bulpite tungah na koih a, a tawntungin kihemkhia peuhmah lo ding hi.
Nangmah in dial puanpi tawh tuam bangin tui thukpi tawh leitung na tuam a, tui khan sungin tuite in mualliante tuumcip hi.
Ahih hangin Nangma tai na hangin amaute taikhia uh a, Na vanging aw hangin amaute kikhawhkhia uh hi.
Amaute in mualliante tuum uh a, Yahweh in amaute aa dingin a sehna mun kuamte sungah a tuaksuk uh hi.
Nangmah in amau’ kantan loh ding gamgi na koih a, leitung a tuum dingin hong paikik lo ding uh hi.
Nangmah in kuamte sungah tuinakte na phulsak a, mualte kikalah amaute luang uh hi.
Amaute in gam sunga gamsa khempeuh tui sik uh hi; tua ahih manin gam-laate a dangtaakna pha hi.
Tuite nai-ah vantungte’ vasate in omna mun nei uh a, singhiangte lakah la sa uh hi.
Nangmah in na inndei tungnung panin mualte tui na pia a, Na nasepna gahte tawh leitung na dim hi.
Nangmah in ganhingte aa dingin lopa leh mihing aa dingin ankung khawh dingin na posak hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in leitung panin an ngah thei ding hi;
Mihing lungsim a nuamsak dingin leenggahzu, a mai a zolsak dingin sathau leh mihing’ lungsim a hatsak dingin an a ngah thei ding hi.
Yahweh in a suan Lebanon-a tamtak kungte, Yahweh’ singkungte in tui hoih takin ngah a,
tua mun ah vasate in bu a bawl uh hi. Vakang khesau namte in a niim detna munte ah a inn ding a nei hi.
Mual sangpite gam-keelte aa hi a, suanghengte pen sakhi-te bukna ding ahi hi.
Nangmah in Pawite ciamteh nadingin khapi na bawl a, ni in ama tum hun ding thei hi.
Nangmah in khuamial na puak a, zan hong suakin, gamlak ganhing khempeuh a vakkhia uh hi.
Humpinelkai khanglaite sa man dingin hawk uh a, a an ding uh Nangma kiang panin zong uh hi.
Tua ciangin ni hong suak a, a kua sungah lum dingin a kikhawm uh hi;
Nitak mateng nasem dingin a nasepna ah a kuankhiat mah bangun a paikhia uh ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, na nasepte tam zen mah si! Nangmah in pilna tawh tuate khempeuh na piangsak a, nangma hauhnate tawh leitung kidim hi.
Hih teng ah a lian mahmah a zai mahmah tuipi om a, a sungah a vak muamua, nuntakna nei ganhing a neu a lian sim zawh lohin om hi.
Tua lai-ah tembawte kilehsuk kilehto a, ommaih nadinga na bawl Leviathan zong tua lai-ah om hi.
Hihte khempeuh in amau hun tawh kizui-in an Na piak ding ngakin hong en uh hi.
Nangmah in amaute na piak ciangin amaute in khawm uh a, Na khutte na honkhiat ciangin, a tampite hangin a gilvah uh hi.
Nangmah in na maitang na seel ciangin, amaute patau-in liing uh hi. Nangmah in amau hu na lakkhiatsak ciangin, amaute si-in lei ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Nangmah in Na Kha na sawl ciangin, amaute kipiangsak a, tua ciangin Nangmah in leitung maitang na puahpha hi.
Yahweh aw, na minthanna kip paisuak hen! Na sepnate ah nuamsa in;
Yahweh aw, leitung na en a, a liing hi; mualte na lawng a, meikhu a suak hi;
Yahweh aw, ka nuntak sungun nang tungah la ka sa ding uh hi! Kote Pa aw, ka dam sungun Nang tungah phatnate ka sa ding uh hi!
Yahweh aw, Nang sungah nuam ka sak mah bangun ka lung ngaihngaihna uh Nang aa dingin a lungkimhuai hi tahen;
Ahih hangin mi mawhte leitung panin kisusia henla, gitlohna om nawn kei hen! Yahweh aw, nang kong phat uh hi! Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!
Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un! Ama Min tawh sam un! Ama nasepsate minamte lakah theikhiasak un!
Ama tungah la sa un, Ama tungah phatna late sa un! Ama na lamdangte khempeuh gen un!
Ama Min siangtho thang hen! Yahweh a zong note khempeuh aw, na lungsim uh kipaak mahmah hen!
Yahweh leh Ama thahatna zong unla, a tawntungin Ama maitang zong un!
Ama sepsa a na lamdang septe phawk unla, Ama nalamdangte leh a kam pana thukhennate phawk un,
Ama nasempa Abraham’ suante, Yaaqob’ tate Ama teeltuamte aw!
Amah pen eite Pa Yahweh ahi hi! Amah in leitung khempeuh ah thukhen hi.

Ahih hangin amaute tawmno bek hi a, tawm lua mahmah takpi-in tua gam ah khualmi ahi uh hi.

Amah in amaute a nengniam dingin kuamah phal lo hi. Hi hi, Amah in amaute a khualna hangin kumpite a taii a,

headings.text: Hong Hon Inla, Minamte Lak Panin Kaikhawm In, Yahweh aw!

verses.text: Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Yahweh aw, nang tungah lungdam kong ko uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh na itna a tawntungin kip den hi!
Kua in Yahweh’ nasep lianpite tangko thei ding ahi hiam? Kua in Amah phatna khempeuh genkhia thei ding ahi hiam?
A thutanna a kemcing mite leh a tawntungin thumaan takin a gamta mite thupha ngah ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, na mite na angvan ciangin kote hong phawk inla, Na hotkhiatna tawh hong veh in.
Tua in Na teelsate bangin phattuamnate ah nuamsak nading, Nangma minamte nopsakna ah ka kipaak theih nading uh leh Na gamluahte tawh ka minthan theih nading uh ahi hi.
Ka pu ka pate uh-a kipan kote ka mawhkhin uh a, siatna bawlin, ka gitloh gamtat khin uh hi.
Egypt gam sungah ka pu ka pate un Nangma na lamdang septe tel thei lo uh a, Nangma hehpihna a honpite phawkkha lo uh hi; tua banah amaute in San Tuipi gei-ah nang hong hehsak uh hi.
Tua hi napi-in a thahat Nangma vangliatna na theihsak nadingin Nangma Min na khualna-in amaute na honkhia hi.
Nangmah in San Tuipi tai-in, a keucip hi; Nangmah in sehnelgam kantan bangin amaute a thuknate tawnin na paipih hi.
Nangmah in amau a mudah mipa khut sung panin na honkhia hi. Nangmah in galpa khut sung panin amaute na tankhia hi.
Tuite in amau galte vukcip a, amaute khat beek suakta lo hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Na kammalte um uh a, Nangmah phatna a sa uh hi.
Ahih hangin a sawt loin amaute in Na nasepte mangngilh pah uh a, Nangma lamlahna a ngak kei uh hi.
Amaute in sehnelgam sungah nakpi takin duh venvan nei uh a, Yahweh aw, amaute in gamlapi ah Nang hong ze-et uh hi.
Nangmah in amau hong ngetnate na pia a, ahih hangin amau nuntakna sungah gawnna na sawl hi.
Amaute in giahphual sunga Mosheh leh Yahweh’ mi siangthopa Aaron a haza uh hi.
Tua ciangin lei kihongin, Dathan valhtum a, Nangma ukna a langpan Abiram pawlte a vukcip hi.
Amaute lakah mei hong kithawhkuang a, meikuang in migilote a kangtum hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ mual tung tua lai-ah Baal Peor biaknatau kual leh mun sang bawl uh a, tua lai-ah a kun uh hi.

Egypt ah na lianpite a bawl Yahweh amaute Honpa aw, amaute in nang hong mangngilh uh hi.
Ham gam sungah na lamdangte bawlin, San Tuipi gei-ah a mulkikhuaite a sempa hong mangngilh uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in tua gam nuam nial uh a, Na ciamna a um kei uh hi.
Amaute a puanbuk sung uh ah phun uh a, Nangma thu hong mang lo uh hi, Yahweh kote Pa aw.
Tua ciangin Nangmah in amaute langah na khut na liik a, gam sungah amaute a puk ding,

Baal Peor tawh amaute kizomin, a sisate tunga biakna kipiate a ne uh hi.
Amau gamtatnate tawh nakpi takin Nang hong hehsak uh a, tua ciangin amaute lakah pulnatna a tung hi.
Ahih hangin Phinehas dingto-in, dantatna tawh palai hong sep ciangin pulnatna a khawl hi.
Tua hi a, hih thu pen a khang a khangin ama thumaanna-in a kiciamteh tawntung hi.
Meribah tuinakte ah zong amaute in Yahweh hehsak uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute hangin Mosheh tungah siatna a tung hi;

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ hehna, ama mite langah hong kuangkhia a, Amah in a ama luah mite a kih hi.

headings.text: Yahweh’ Tatsa Mite in Gen Ni!

gam teng panin a kikawikhawmte, nisuahna, nitumna, leilu leh leitaw pana kikaikawmte in ci uh hen.

Tua hi a, amaute a lungkham uh ciangin Yahweh kiang kiko uh a, Amah in amau lunggimna panin a honkhia hi.

Amaute zukham bangin suk-hoi to-hoi uh a, amau pilna khempeuh a kivalhtum hi.
Tua hi a, a lungkham uh ciangin Yahweh kiangah amaute kiko uh a, Amah in amau lunggimna panin a honkhia hi.
Amah in huihpi daisakin, a hawk baba tuihual zong a dai hi.
Tuate a daih ciangin amaute kipaak uh a, Amah in amau lunggulhna tembaw khawlmun ah amaute a paipih hi.

Amaute in mihon kikhopna sungah Amah liansak uh henla, upate thu kikupkhopna ah Amah phat uh hen.
Amah in gunpite sehnelgam suaksak a, ciktui luannate leikeu suaksakin,

headings.text: Minamte Lakah Nang Hong Phatin Lungdam Kong Ko ding Uh Hi!

Bang hang hiam cihleh nong hehpihna vantungte sangin sangzaw a, Na thuman in meiite ban hi.

Na it mite a kihotkhiat theih nadingin Na khut taklam tawh hu inla, kote hong dawng in!
Nangmah Yahweh in na sianthona tawh thugenin, “Ka gualzo ding hi! Shechem ka khenkhia ding a, Succoth Kuam ka tehkhia ding hi!
Gilead pen Kei aa hi a, Menasheh kei aa ahi hi! Ephraim in Ka lutang-a sik lukhu; thahatna, ahi hi! Yahdah pen Ka Thukhampiapa; kumpi-ciangkhut, ahi hi.
Moab pen Ka kisilna tuikuangpi hi a, Edom’ ngawng tungah Ka khedap ka koih ding hi! Philistia tungah ka gualzo ding hi!” na cikhin hi.
Kua in kote khuapi muanhuai sungah hong paipih ding ahi hiam? Kua in Edom ah kote hong makaih ding ahi hiam?

headings.text: Mi a Samsiatpa Ama tungah Samsiatna Tung Hen!

verses.text: Kote kong phat, Yahweh kote Pa aw, dai dide kei in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh migilote kam leh zuauthu gente in kote langah a kamka khin uh hi! Amaute in kote langpanin leii zuau tawh thugen khin uh hi.
Muhdahna kammalte tawh kote hong umcih uh a, thu om lopi-in kote hong busim uh hi.

A tate pa nei lo hi suak henla, a zi meigong hi hen.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in mi hehpih ding ngaihsun lo hi; ahih hangin lungsim tamzante a thah theih nadingin mi zawngte leh mi cimawhte a bawlsia hi.
Amah in samsiatna genkhiat ding nuamsa ahih nungsang, ama tungah samsiatna tung tahen. Amah in thupha piakna nuamsa lo ahih nungsang, ama kiang panin thupha gamla om tahen.
Thumaan mite amau dialpuanpi tawh a kitun mah bangin samsiatna tawh amah a kitun nungsang, samsiatna ama pumpi ah tui bangin lut henla, sathau bangin a guhte sungah lut hen.
Amah kitunna puantualte samsiatna hi henla, a kawng a gak kawnggak samsiatna hi tawntung tahen!

Ahih hangin Yahweh kote Pa aw, Nangma Min na khualna-in kote hong thunuam in! Na hehpihna in ciangtan nei lo ahih manin, kote hong honkhia in;
Kote zawngin cimawh ka hih manun kote sungah ka lungsim uh a na hi.
Nitaklam niliim bangin kote damdamin ka mang uh a, kaukhup bangin kote hong kisingkhia hi.

Tua hi leh amaute in hih hotkhiatna pen Nang kiang pana hong pai ahihna, Yahweh aw, Nangmah in hih thu na sep ahihna thei ding uh hi!
Amaute in hong samsia kha thei mah ding uh hi; ahih hangin Nangmah in thupha nong pia ding hi! Amaute a thawh uh ciangin maizumsak inla, ahih hangin Na nasemte hong kipaaksak in!

headings.text: Yahweh in I Ukpa leh I Kumpipa kiangah Gen

Yahweh in Zion panin Na thahatna ciangkhut hong puak ding a, Nangmah in Na galte lakah na uk ding hi!

Vangliatna tawh na mainawt ni-in Na mite in Thukham a zuih nopna uh hong lakkhia ding uh hi. Amaute in puantual siangthote tawh kizemin Nang tawh pumkhat hong suak ding uh hi. Zingsang daitui bangin amaute in Nang tawh uk khawmin, leitung tuam bit ding hi.
Yahweh in, ‘Nang pen Melchizedek bangin a tawntungin siampi na hi hi,’ ci-in kiciam zo a, a lungsim a khel kei ding hi.

Amaute in minamte lakah thukhen ding a, amaute in misi tawh leitung dimsakin, leitung bup-a gam-ukte suzan ding uh hi.
Gualzawhna a piapa Khat in amau kumpi-tokhomte tungah amaute tusak ding a, Yahweh in amaute tawisang ding hi.
Halleluyah! Yahweh aw, thutang mite thukikupna leh mihon kikhopna lakah ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Nang tungah lungdam kong ko ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, na nasepte lian mahmah a, tuate sungah nuam a sa mi khempeuh in na nasepte kankan uh hi.
Na nasepte pahtawina leh thupitna hi a, Na thumaanna a tawntung, tawntungin a kip hi.
Nangmah in na bawl na lamdangte phawk ding na suaksak hi. Yahweh aw, nang pen hehpih siamin na lainat hi.

Tuate a tawntungin kip ngitnget a, thuman leh thutang takin a kibawl ahi hi.
Nangmah in na mite tungah tatkhiatna na puak hi; Nangmah in tawntung-a dingin Na thuciamna na kipsak hi. Nangma Min siangtho-in zahtakhuai hi.

headings.text: Nang Hong Zahtakte Thupha Ngah Ahi Hi

verses.text: Halleluyah! Yahweh aw, Nangmah hong zahtakin, Na Thukhamte zuihna ah nuam a sa mahmah mite in thupha ngah ahi hi.
Ama suanlekhakte, leitung ah mi thahat hi ding a, a khangkhanga thutangte thupha kipia ding hi.
Ama inn sungah hauhna leh lawhcinna om ding a, ama thumaanna kip paisuak ding hi.
Thutang mite aa dingin khuamial sungah khuavak hong suakkhia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen hehpihna nei-in, mi a lainat mahmah, a thutang mite tungah a thumaanpa ahi hi.
Thutang mipa diktatin, mi zawngte leitawi pia a, amah in thutang takin na a vaihawm hi.
Amah kiliing ngei peuhmah lo ding hi; thumaan mite kiphawk tawntung ding hi.
Thusia hangin amah lau lo ding hi; Yahweh aw, ama lungtang kipin, Nangmah hong muang hi.
Ama lungtang kikipsak a, a lau kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in gualzawhna tawh a galte a en ding hi.
Amah in hawmkhia-in, mi zawngte tungah piakhin hi. Ama thumaanna kip paisuak a, pahtawina tawh a ki tawisang ding hi.
Migilopa in mu-in heh ding a, a ha a gawi ding hi; tua khit ciangin a tuisuak beimang ding hi. Migilote lunggulhna in a mawkna suak ding hi.
Halleluyah! No Yahweh’ nasemte aw, phat un, Yahweh Min phat un!
Tu leh a tawntungin Yahweh Min kiphat tahen!
Nisuahna panin nitumna dongin Yahweh Min phat ding ahi hi.
Leitung minamte khempeuh sangin Yahweh sangzaw a, ama minthanna vantungte sangin sangzaw hi.
Thumaan mahmahna tawh a sangna-a om Yahweh i Pa tawh a kibang,
leitung leh vantung sunga om khempeuh a en dingin a kiniamkhiat tawm amah tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?
Amah in leivui panin mi zawngte phong a, ninphual panin mi cimawhte a domto hi.
Mi liante, Ama mi uliante tawh tu khawmsak hi.
Amah in ta nei nupi lungnuamte bangin tasel numei inn a keemsak hi. Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!
Egypt panin Israyl a paikhiat lai, theihpih loh pau a zang mite kiang panin Yaaqob innkuan a taikhiat lai-in,

Tuutalte bangin mualliante diang a, tuunote bangin mualneute zuan uh hi.
Tuipi aw, bang hangin taimangin, Yardan aw, bang hangin nung heikik na hi hiam?
Mualliante aw, tuutalte bangin na dianna uh bang hang hi a, no mualneute aw, tuuno bangin a zuanna uh bang ahi hiam?
Leitung aw, Yahweh mai, Yaaqob’ Pa mai-ah liing in;
Amah in suangtum pen bualtui a suaksak, meisuang pen tuite nak a suaksakpa ahi hi!
Kote hang hi loin, a lian Yahweh aw, kote hang hi lozaw-in Nangma Min hang, Na hehpihna hang leh na thuman hangin Na minthanna lakkhia in.
Bang hangin minamte in, “Tu-in Vanglianpa koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci zenzen ding uh ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin vantung ah eite Pa om a, Amah in a lungkim bangin a sem hi.
Amau pasiante ahih leh mihing khut tawh kibawl ngun leh khamte ahi hi.
Amaute in kam nei a, ahih hangin pau thei lo a, mit nei napi-in a mu thei kei hi.
Amaute in bil nei a, ahih hangin za thei lo a, nak nei napi-in a nam thei kei hi.
Amaute khut nei a, ahih hangin zawt thei lo uh a, khe nei napi-in pai thei loin, a gawl uh tawh zong aw a gingsak thei kei hi.
Tua bang a bawl mite tuate mah bang pah ding uh a, tuate a muang peuhmah zong tuate mah bang ding hi.
Israyl aw, Yahweh muang un! Amah pen eite hong huhpa leh i lum ahi hi!

Yahweh a zahtak note aw, Yahweh muang un! Amah pen eite hong huhpa leh i lum ahi hi!
Yahweh in eite hong phawk ngitnget a, Amah in eite thupha hong pia ding hi! Amah in Israyl’ innkuan thupha pia ding hi! Amah in Aaron’ innkuan thupha pia ding hi!
Yahweh in Amah zahtakna a pia mite a neu a lian, thupha pia ding hi!

Yahweh a phatte pen misite hi lo a, daihna sungah a paisukte zong hilo hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh aw, tu leh a tawntungin kote in nang kong phat ding uh hi! Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!

headings.text: Yahweh’ Min I Lo Ding Hi!

verses.text: Yahweh aw, nangmah in kote aw leh kong thuumnate uh hong za na hih manin kong it uh hi.

Yahweh aw, ka ciamnate uh, Na mite khempeuh mai-ah ka tangtun ding uh a,

headings.text: A Lian Yahweh, Kong Phat Uh Hi!

verses.text: No minamte khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un! No mihingte khempeuh aw, Amah phat un!
Bang hang hiam cihleh eite tungah Ama hong itna leh dikna lian mahmah a, Yahweh’ thu a manna kip tawntung hi! Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!
Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah thumaanin, Ama itna kip kho tawntung hi!
Israyl in, “Ama itna kip kho tawntung hi,” ci tahen!

I lunggim ciangin Yahweh i sam hi; Yahweh aw, nangmah in kote nong dawng a, mun tanzau-na ah nong koih hi.

I puk nadingin amaute in hong sawn uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh in ei hong huh hi!
Yahweh pen ka thahatna leh ka zaila hi a, Amah pen eite hotkhiatna hong suakzo hi.
Thumaan mite puanbuk sungah hotkhiatna leh nuamna awging om a, Yahweh’ taklam khut in hangsan takin sem hi!
Yahweh’ taklam khut kitawisang hi! Yahweh’ taklam khut in hangsan takin sem hi!
Eite si loin i nungta ding a, Yahweh’ nasepnate i genkhia ding hi.
Yahweh in nasia takin ei hong thuhilh khin a, ahih hangin sihna ah eite hong pia kei hi.
Thumaanna kulh kongpite hong hon in! Tua teng tawnin ka pai ding uh a, Yahweh ka phat ding uh hi!
Hih in Yahweh’ kulh kongpi hi a, thumaan mite tua teng tawnin lut thei ding uh hi!

Yahweh pen eite tungah khuavak hong pia i Pa ahi hi. Pawi aa dingin biakpiakna, khauhualte tawh kih unla, biaknatau’ kite dongah paipih un!
Nang pen kote Pa na hi a, Nang kong phat ding uh hi! Kote Pa na hi a, kong tawisang ding uh hi!
Yahweh thumaanin a itna kip kho tawntung ahih manin Ama tungah lungdamna ko un!

headings.text: Na Lungsim Khempeuh tawh Yahweh Zong In
Yahweh aw, Na Kammal Ka Mangngilh Kei Ding Uh Hi!
Hong Nungtasak Inla, Na Deihna Bangin Hong Semsak In
Yahweh aw, Na Deihna Hong Theisak In
Na Thukham Ka Zuih Theih Nadingun Thutheihna Hong Guan In
Na Thumaana, A Thumaanin Na Gamta Hi
Nang Hong Zahtakte in Nuamsa Ding
Na Thukham Ka It Mahmah Uh Hi
Na Thukham in Ko Aa Dingin Meivak Hi
A Mawknapi Ngaihsutnate Ka Mudah-in, Ahih hangin Na Thukham Ka It Uh Hi
Na Itna Kip tawh Kituakin Na Nasemte tungah Hong Bawl In
Na Nasemte tungah Na Maipha Hong Tang Hen
Lungsim Takpi tawh Kong Kiko Uh Hi
Yahweh aw, Ka Thu Hong Panpih Inla, Hong Hon In
Na Thukham a Itte Lungnuam Uh Hi
Nang Kong Phat Ding Uh Hi

verses.text: Amau gamtatna ah paubanna om loin, Yahweh’ Thukham sungah a kalsuan mite thupha ngah ahi hi!
Ama thuhilhnate zui-in, a lungsim khempeuh tawh Yahweh a zong mite thupha ngah ahi hi.
Amaute in khialhna zong bawl lo uh a, Ama lampite a zui uh hi.
Nangma thuhilhte limtaka zuih dingin thu nong pia hi.
Nangma ngeina kipte zuihna ah ka gamtatna kip tahen;
Na Thukham khempeuh mitsuanin nei ka hih manun ka maizum ngei kei ding uh hi!
Nangma thumaan ngeina kipte ka sin khit uh ciangin lungsim thutang tawh nangmah kong phat ding uh hi!
Na ngeina kipte ka zui ding uh hi! Ko hong nusia suak kei in, Yahweh aw!
Tangval khat in ama gamtatna bangci siantho sak ding ahi hiam? Nangma Thukham limtakin zuihna tawh siangthosak thei ding hi!
Ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nang kong zong uh hi; Na Thukhamte panin hong pialsak kei in!
Nangmah tungah ka mawh khak loh nadingun ka lungsim sungah Na Thukham ka keemcing uh hi.

Na kam pana thukhennate khempeuh ka mukun ka genkhin uh hi.
Hauhnate khempeuh sangin nangma thuhilhnate ah nuam ka sazaw uh hi.
Na thuhilhte ka lung ngaingai ding uh a, Na lampite ka ngaihsun tinten ding uh hi.
Na ngeina kipte ah nuamsa-in Na Thukham ka mangngilh kei ding uh hi!
Kote nungta-in Nangma Thukham ka zuih theih nadingun Na nasemte tungah hong cingh in.
Na Thukham sung panin a lamdang nate ka muh theih nadingun ka mitte uh hong honsak in.
Kote, leitung ah khualmi ka hi uh hi. Ko kiang panin Na Thukhamte hong seel kei in.
Na thukhennate a tawntungin ka lunggulh venvan hi.
Nangmah in Na Thukhamte panin a pialkhia, a kimawh paih, a kiphasak mite na taii hi.
Na thute zui tentin ka hih manun ko kiang panin simmawhna leh gensiatna hong lakkhiatsak in.
Ko langah tu-in hong gensia uliante kisiamangsak in; ahih hangin Na nasemte in na ngeina kipte ngaihsunsun hi.
Na thuhilhnate ka nopsakna uh hi a, tuate in Nangma lampite ah kote hong paipih ding ahi hi.

Ka gamtatnate kong pulak uh a, kote nong dawng hi. Na ngeina kipte hong hilh in.
Na thuhilhte a deihna hong telsak in. Tua ciangin kote in tuate ka lungngaingai ding uh a, Nangma nasep a lamdangte ka gen ding uh hi.
Dahluatna hangin ka nuntakna uh tuisuak hi; Na kammal tawh kizui-in kote hong thahatsak inla, hong domto in.
Zuaugenna panin kote hong hemkhia inla, hong hehpih-in Na Thukham hong ngahsak in.
Thuman lampi ka teel khin uh a, Na vaihawmnate kote mai-ah ka koih uh hi.
Na thuhilhnate ah ka belh dikdek uh hi! Yahweh aw, kote hong maizumsak kei in.
Kote lungsim thutheihna hong zaisak na hih manin Na Thukham lampi ah ka tai ding uh hi.
Pa Yahweh aw, na ngeina kipte lampi hong hilh in; a tawp dongin ka zui ding uh hi.
Thu theihtelna hong pia in, Na Thukham ka zui ding uh hi. Hi hi, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ka zui ding uh hi.
Na Thukham lampi ah kote hong tawnsak in; bang hang hiam cihleh tua lai-ah nuam ka sa uh hi.

Zuau vive muhmuhna panin ka mite hong heikhiatsak inla, Na lampite tungtawnin nuntakna hong pia in.
Nangmah hong zahtakin nangma na a sem Na nasemte tungah Na thu hong kipsak in.
Ka kihtak uh ko hong kikona leh hong kimindaisakna panin hong heikhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh Na thukhenna in thumaanna lam hong makaih hi.
Yahweh aw, Na thute ka lunggulh mahmahna uh na thei hi! Na thumaanna tawh kote nuntakna hong pia in!
Yahweh aw, Na kammal omsa bangin ko kiangah nong hehpihnate, na hotkhiatna hong tung tahen!
Tua hileh, ko hong zahkote ka dawng thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in Nangma Thukham ka muang uh hi.
Hih a man thu ka kam uh panin la khia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in Nangma thukhennate ka lamen uh hi;
Tua hileh, kote in Na Thukham a tawntungin ka zui paisuak thei ding uh hi!
Nangma thute zuih ding hanciam ka hih manun nuamtakin ka nungta ding uh hi.
Kumpite mai-ah nangma thute ka gen ding uh a, maizumna ka thuak kei ding uh hi.
Ka it uh Nangma Thukhamte zuihna ah nuam ka sa hi!
Ka it uh Nangma Thukhamte lamah ka khut ka lamto a, Na ngeina kipte ka lungngaingai ding uh hi.
Kote lametna hong neisak Na nasemte tunga Na kammal hong phawk in.
Hih in ka thuakna ah keima kihehnepna hi a, na kammal in kei nuntakna hong pia hi.

Hih ka ompakna inn sungah nangma ngeina kipte la-in ka sasa uh hi.

Kote pen Nang hong zahtak khempeuhte leh Na thu a zuite lawm ka hi uh hi.

Nang na thumaan a, na thumaan gamtat hi! Na ngeina kipte hong hilh in!
Kote langah mi kiphasakte in zuau thu genkhawm uh a, ahih hangin kote in ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh na thute ka zui ding uh hi.

Nangma kam pana Thukham pen ngun leh kham tul tampite sangin ko aa dingin hoihzaw hi.
Nangma khut in kote hong bawlin hong zem hi! Na Thukhamte ka sin theih nadingun thu theihtelna hong guan in.
Na kammalte lametin nei ka hih manun Nang hong zahtakte in kote hong mu-in lungdam ding uh hi.

Nangma Thukham in kote lungnopna hilo hileh, ka gimthuakna uh ah ka mangthang khin ding uh hi.
Na thuhilhnate ka mangngilh ngei kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate hangin Nangmah in nuntakna nong pia hi.
Kote Nangma aa ka hi uh hi; Na thuhilhnate kan ka hih manun kote hong hon in!
Kote hong susia nuamin migilote in hong buk uh hi; ahih hangin kote in Nangma tecipannate ngaihsunin ka tel uh hi.

A thumaan Nangma khensatnate zuih dingin ka kiciam khin uh a, ka tangtun ding uh hi.
Nakpi takin gimna ka thuak uh hi! Yahweh aw, nangma kammal tawh kizui-in nuntakna hong pia in.
Ka kam panun uttawmna hanga biakna hong sang in. Yahweh aw, kong thuum uh hi, Na khensatnate hong hilh in.
Ka nuntakna uh lauhuai ngitngetin a om hangin Na Thukham ka mangngilh kei uh hi.
Na thuhilhnate panin ka pial lo hi napi-in, migilote in kote thang hong siah uh hi.
Na tecipannate tawntung ka gamh dingun ka nei uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate in kote lungnopna ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, a tawp dongin Nangma deihna sep ding, Na ngeina kipte zuih dingin ka lungsim ka awnsak uh hi!
Lungkaka mite’ ngaihsutnate ka mudah uh a, ahih hangin Na Thukham ka it uh hi.

Nangmah in leitung migilo khempeuh sik-ek bangin na nilkhia hi; tua ahih ciangin kote in Nangma tecipannate ka deih hi.
Nang kong zahtakna-in ka pumpi liing kelkel a, Na thukhennate ka kihta uh hi.

Na nasemte aa dingin hong kikham inla, mi kiphasakte in kote hong nengniamsak kei in!

Na nasemte ka hi uh hi! Na tecipannate ka theih nadingun thu theihtelna hong guan in.

Tua ahih ciangin kote in kham sangin Na Thukhamte ka itzaw uh hi! Hi hi, kham hoihpen sangin zong ka deihzaw uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Na thuhilhte khempeuh a man taktakna ka lungngai uh hi, tua ahih ciangin a man lo lampi peuhmah ka mudah uh hi.
Na tecipannate lamdang mahmah hi! Tua ahih ciangin ka lungsim khempeuh uh tawh ka zui uh hi!

A Lian Yahweh aw, nang na thumaan a, Na thukhennate khempeuh thutang hi!

Yahweh aw, nangma itna kip lian mahmah hi! Na khensatnate tawh kizui-in kote nuntakna hong pia in.

headings.text: Yahweh kiang pan Huhna Hong Pai

headings.text: Ei lamah Yahweh Hong Pang Lo Hileh

headings.text: Yahweh a Muang Mite, Zion Mual Bangin Om

headings.text: Yahweh in Inn Lam Lo Hileh

headings.text: Yahweh a Zahtak Khempeuh in Thupha Ngah Ahi Hi!

headings.text: Yahweh Muang In, Hong Tan Ding Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, a thupite sung panin nang tungah kong kiko uh hi!

headings.text: I Lungsim I Kiphasak Kei Hi

Yahweh aw, nangma tungah amah kiciam a, Yaaqob’ Vanglian Pa, nangma tungah hih bangin kiciam hi:
“Yaaqob’ Vanglian Pa, Yahweh aa dingin tenna mun khat ka muh matengin,
ka tenna ka inn sungah lut loin, ka tawlngakna ka lupna ah zong ka paito kei ding a,
Ka mitte ihmusak loin, ka mitkhute zong ka kikhupsak kei ding hi.” a ci hi.
En in! Ephrathah ah tua thu i za hi! Yaar gamlak; Kiryath Yearim, ah tua thu i tuak hi.

Na siampite in thumaanna puan bangin silh henla, Na misiangte lungdamin awng ta uh hen!
Na nasempa David na khualna-in Na sathau nilhpa nolh kei in.
Yahweh aw, thuman-in David tungah na ciam a, na ciampel kei ding hi: “Na pumpi pana piang na suan khat, na kumpi-tokhom a ka luahsak ding hi.
Na tapate in Ka thuciamna leh amaute ka hilhsa Ka tecipannate a zuih leh, amau tapate zong a tawntungin na kumpi-tokhom tungah tu ding uh hi” na ci hi.
Yahweh aw, Nangmah in Zion na teel khin a, Na tenna mun dingin na deih hi.
Yahweh in, “Hih in a tawntunga Ka tawlngakna mun ahi hi. Ka deihna mun ahih manin hih lai-ah ka teng ding hi.
Nek leh dawn tawh thupha dimletin ka pia ding a, a mizawngte anlum tawh ka gilvahsak ding hi.

En un, sanggamte kipumkhatin a tenkhop uh ciangin bangzah takin hoihin nuam ahi hiam!

En un, Yahweh’ Inn ah zanin a ding no Yahweh’ nasemte khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un!

headings.text: Khang Tawntungin Na Min leh Nangmah Phawkna Kip Ngitnget Hi

verses.text: Halleluyah! Yahweh’ Min phat un! No Yahweh’ nasemte aw, Yahweh phat un!
Yahweh’ Inn sunga om, i Pa’ Inn omna huang sungah na a sem note aw,
Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh thumaan hi! Ama Min phatnate sa un; bang hang hiam cihleh tua in phatnop huai taktak hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Ama aa dingin Yaaqob teelkhin a, Ama neihsa manpha dingin Israyl a teelkhin hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh a liatna leh pasian khempeuh sangin eite Pa a liatzawkna i thei hi.
Vantung leh leitung, tuipi leh a thukpite sungah Yahweh in a ut peuhpeuh a bawl hi.
Amah pen leitung mongte panin tuikhu a lamtopa, guah tawh kipawl khuaphialepte a bawlpa, Ama vankholna-innte panin huih a nungkhiasakpa ahi hi.
Aman in Egypt-a mihing, ganhing’ tacil a susia hi.
Egypt aw, Amah in nangma laizang, Pharaoh leh ama nasem khempeuhte tungah limte leh na lamdangte a sawl hi.
Amah in minam tampi zo a, kumpi thahatte a that hi—
Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon, Bashan kumpipa Og leh Canaan gama kumpite khempeuh that hi—
Amah in a gam uh luah dingin Ama mi Israyl-te tungah gamh-in a pia hi!
Yahweh aw, Na Min kip ngitnget hi! Yahweh aw, Nangmah phawkna khang tawntungin a kip hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a mite tungah thukhen ding a, Ama nasemte a lainat ding hi!
Minamte’ pasiante (elohim) ngun leh kham hi lel a, mihingte’ khut tawh kibawl ahi lel hi!
Amaute in kam nei napi-in pau thei lo a, mittang nei napi-in mu thei lo hi.
Bil nei napi-in za thei lo a, a kam sungah hu khatbeek zong a om kei hi.
Pasian (elohim) a bawl mite tuate mah a bang uh hi; tuate a muang mi peuhmah zong tuate mah tawh a kibang ahi uh hi!
Israyl’ innkuan aw, Yahweh phat un! Aaron’ innkuan aw, Yahweh phat un!
Levi’ innkuan aw, Yahweh phat un! No Yahweh a zahtak mite aw, Yahweh phat un!
Yerusalem-a om Zion panin Yahweh kiphat tahen! Halleluyah!

headings.text: Vantunga I Pa Yahweh tungah Lungdam Ko Un

verses.text: Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah thumaan-in, Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Pasian khempeuh sangin a lianzaw vantunga i Pa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Kumpite’ Kumpipa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Amah bek in a lamdang na lianpite a bawlpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Pilna leh theihtelna tawh vantungte a bawlpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Tuite tungah leitung a zal-pa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Khuavak lianpite a bawlpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Sun a uk dingin nitang a bawlpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Zan a uk dingin khapi leh aksite a bawpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Egypt tacil khempeuh a sattukpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Amaute lak panin Israyl a paikhiatpihpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
A ban zanin a thahat khut tawh amaute a paikhiatpihpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
San Tuipi khen nih a suahpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Israyl-te a laizang tawnin a kantansakpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
San Tuipi sungah Pharaoh leh a mihonpite a singkhiapa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Gamlak ah Ama mite a makaihpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Kumpi lianpite a vattukpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Kumpi minthangte a thatlumpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Amor mite’ kumpi Sihon a thatpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Bashan kumpi Og a thatpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
A gam uh luah dingin a piapa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
A nasempa Israyl tungah gamh a piapa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Mi niam i hih laitakin eite hong phawkpa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
I galte kiang panin ei hong tankhiapa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Nuntakna nei khempeuh an a piapa tungah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.
Vantunga om eite Pa kiangah lungdamna ko un! Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama itna kip tawntung hi.

headings.text: Babylon Gun Gei Panin Zion Lunggulhna

verses.text: Babylon gun gei-ah eite i tusuk hi; hi hi, Zion a phawk ciangin i kap hi.
Babylon laizang-a muisum kungte tungah i harp-te i khai hi.
Ahih hangin sal-a hong kaite in la sa dingin hong sawl uh a, ei hong bawlsiate in gualnop nadingin, “Zion late khat hong sak un,” a ci uh hi.
Ka la, gamdang pi khat ah Yahweh’ la bangci sak theih ding i hiam?
Yerusalem aw, nang hong mangngilh hi le-ung, ka taklam khut in zong a siamna mangngilh ding hi!
Yerusalem aw, nang hong mangngilh hi le-ung, ka ukpite uh lungnopna sangin Yerusalem a deih lozaw hi le-ung, ka leiite uh ka dangtawng ah toncip tahen!
Yahweh aw, Edom mite tungah hih thu phawk in: amaute in Yerusalem a puk ni-in, ‘Phelkek un, a bulkip dongin susiamang un!’ a ci uh hi.
Suksiat dingin a seh nang Babylon’ tanu! Ko tungah nong bawlna hangin nang tungah hong thuk dingpa,
na taneute manin suangtumte tungah denna-in hong neihsak ding mi thutang pa, mi lungdam ahi hi!

headings.text: Na Min leh Na Thukham Kitawisang Hi

verses.text: Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Nang tungah ka lungdam uh hi! Pasian (el) khempeuh mai-ah, kote Vantung Pa, Nangmah phatnate ka sa uh hi!
Nangma munsiangtho lamah ka kun uh a, Nangma itna kip leh Na thuman hangin Nangma Min ka phat uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Nangmah in na khempeuh sangin Na Min leh Na Thukham na liansakzaw hi!
Kote kong kiko ni-in, Nangmah in nong dawng a, thahatna tawh nong hangsansak hi!
Yahweh aw, leitung kumpite khempeuh in Na kam pana thute a zak uh ciangin amaute in Nang hong phawkkha ding uh hi!
Hi hi, Yahweh aw, amaute in na nasepna ziate la-in sa ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, Na minthanna lian mahmah hi!
Yahweh aw, a sangna ah na om hangin a tualniamte kiang na naih hi; ahih hangin mi kiphasakte a gamla pan bekin na thei hi.
Haksatna laizangah ka pai uh hangin nangmah in kote nuntakna nong pia ding a, Nangmah in ka galte uh hehna langpanin na khut zan-in, Na taklam khut in kote hong hon ding hi.
Yahweh aw, Kei* tungtawnin amaute na kaikhawm ding hi. Yahweh aw, na itna kip tawntung hi; Nangma khut mahmah tawh na sepsate nusia kei in!

headings.text: Nang Kiang Lo Koi-ah Pai Ding Ka Hi Uh Hiam?

verses.text: Yahweh aw, nangmah in nong lim ettel mahmah a, nong thei hi:
Nangmah in ka heisuk ka hei tohna uh ah nong thei hi. Nangmah in a gamla panin ka ngaihsutna khempeuh uh na tel hi.
Ka pusuahna na kantel a, ka lupsukna na entel hi; Kote’ ziate khempeuh na thei hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh aw, kote’ leii tunga kammal khat beek nangma theih loh a om kei hi.
Ka nung ka mai uh panin Nangmah in kote bit takin nong keem a, kote tungah Na khutpeek nong nga hi.
Mong nei lo Nangma thutheihna kote aa dingin lamdang lua mahmah hi. Tua pen kote theihzawh ding hi lo a, kote tunglamah sang om mahmah hi.
Nangma Kha panin koi-ah pai ding ka hi uh hiam? Nangma kiang panin koi-ah taikhia ding ka hi uh hiam?
Vantung ah kahto le-ung, Nang na om a, Sheol; hankhuk, sungah kote in lupna bawl hi le-ung zong, en in, Nang na om hi.
Phalvak’ khate tungah tuang thei-in, tuipi mong gamlapente ah teng thei hi le-ung zong,
tua lai nangawn ah Nangma khut in kote lam hong lakin, hong lenkip hi.
“Khuamial in eite hong tuamcip taktak ding a, eite kiimkot-a i khuavak omsun in zanhun hi ding hi,” ci ta le-ung zong,
Nang aa dingin zan pen sun bangin taang ahih nungsangin, khuamial nangawn in nangma muh loh dingin bangmah seel thei lo a, khuamial leh khuavak pen nang aa dingin a kibang ahi hi.
Hi hi, Nangmah in ka hinna a sungtawngpen dongin na piangsak a, ka nu’ naubu sungah kote nong tuam hi.
A lipkhap huai leh a lamdang lua mahmahin kote hong bawl na hih manin kong phat uh hi; kote in tel takin ka theih mah bangun Na nasepte lamdang lua mahmah hi.
Mun simtham ah kei hong kibawl lai-in ka guh ka tangte nang kiang panin kiliah lo a, leitung-a a thukpite sungah limtakin hong kikhuituah lai-in,
pumpi a hi nai lo kote Na mit-in nong mu hi; ahih hangin kote ni khat nangawn na nuntak ma-un Nangma laibu sungah kote nuntak zah ding a kisehsa ni khempeuh kigelh khin hi.
Yahweh aw, Na ngaihsutnate ko aa dingin manpha lua mahmah a, tuate kigawm leh nak liat lua mahmah hi!
Kote in tuate sim zo hi le-ung, sehnel mal zah sangin tamzaw ding hi. Kote ka khanlawh ciangun nang tawh ka om khawm lai uh hi.
Yahweh aw, migilote that hoh lecin! Tua ciangin kote in, “Sisan luangsak mite, ko kiang panin paikhia mang un!” ka ci ding uh hi.
A thusia geelna uh a bukim nadingin amaute in Nangma Min gensia uh hi! Na galte in Nangma Min a mawkna a suaksak uh hi!
Yahweh aw, nang hong mudahte mudah hilo ka hi uh hiam? Nangmah langpanin a ding mite kih hilo ka hi uh hiam?
Kote in amaute a man taktak mudahna tawh ka mudah uh a, galte bangin ka ngaihsun uh hi!
Yahweh aw, kote hong entel inla, ka lungsim uh hong thei in! Hong sit inla, ka ngaihsutnate uh hong thei in.
Kote sungah gitlohna khatpeuh a om peuhmah hiam hong en inla, nuntak tawntungna lampi ah kote hong paipih in.

headings.text: Nangma Kiangah Thutangte Teng Ding Uh Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, mi tatsiate kiang panin hong honkhia inla, mi ngongtatte kiang panin kote hong dal in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in a lungsim sungah thusia bekbek geel uh a, sun tawntungin gal thu bekbek geel simsim uh hi.
A leii uh gulpi aa bangin hiam a, a thugente uh gul gupha a bang hi.
Yahweh aw, migilote’ khut panin hong keem in. Ko hong lamkhialsak nuam mi ngongtatte kiang panin hong dal in.
Mi kiphasakte in khauhual-in kote thang hong siah uh hi. Amaute in lam lianpi gei-ah ngen-thangzak phah-in kote thangzak hong siah uh hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, kote in nangma kiangah, “Kote Pa na hi hi!” kong ci uh hi. Yahweh aw, kong thuumnate uh hong za in!
Kote kihonkhiatna tha, Yahweh kote Pa aw, gal kido ni-in kote’ lutang kidalna na hi hi.
Yahweh aw, migilote deihna pia kei in. Amau ngimnate tangtungsak kei in; tua bang hi keileh amaute kiliansak ding uh hi. Selah.
Ko hong umcih mite in a muk tawh a siamsiat uh siatna mah in amau’ lutangte tuam tahen!
Amaute tungah mei-am kuang zu tahen! Meikuang sungah amaute kipaai henla, a thawhkik theih nawn loh nadingin dum thukpi sungah kipaai tahen!
Mi gensiate leitung ah kipsak kei in! Mi ngongtatpa, amah a susia dingin siatna in beng tahen!
Yahweh in a thuak mite’ thu a panpih ding leh mi zawngte aa dingin thutangin a sep ding lam i thei hi.
Thumaan mite bek in Nangma Min ah lungdamna ko ding uh a, thutang mite bek Nangma omna ah teng ding uh hi!

headings.text: Yahweh aw, Nangma Lampi Bek Hong Zuisak In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, Nangma Min tawh kong sam uh hi! Hong manlang in! Nang kong sap uh ciangin ka aw uh hong za in!
Ka thungetnate uh, Nangma mai-ah paknamtui bang henla, ka khut laptohnate uh nitak biakpiakna bang tahen!
Yahweh aw, ka kam uh hong uk in. Ka muk’ kongkhakte uh hong cing in.
Khialhna a bawl mite tawh siatna a gamta khawm dingin kammal hoih lo khatpeuh ah ka lungsim uh hong awnsak kei in. Amau limsakte zong hong nesak kei in!

Thumaan mipa in kote hong vua hen; tua in migitna hi ding hi. Thumaan mipa in kote hong tai hen, tua in lu tunga dingin sathau hoih mahmah hi ding hi. Kote lutang in tua nialsak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih liamnate hangin ka thungetna uh hong luangkhia ahi hi.
Suangtumte lakah amau thukhente kilawnpaai a, tua ciangin amaute in ka kammalte uh hong za hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka kammal uh a khum hi.
Mi khat in lo kho-in a kalh gawp bangin hankhuk gong ah ka guhte uh kithehthang hi;
Ahih hangin Yahweh kote Pa aw, nangmah kong mitsuan uh hi. Nangma sungah kong bu uh hi; belh ding nei loin ka nuntakna uh hong nusia kei in!
Ko hong siahna thangzakte pan, mawhna bawlte siah thangzakte panin kote hong keem in.
Kote muanhuaina ah ka suahtak uh ciangin migilote amau thangzak mah ah awksak in!

headings.text: Yahweh aw, Kote Bukna Na Hi

verses.text: Yahweh aw, nangma tungah ka aw-un kong kiko uh hi; Yahweh aw, ka aw uh tawh Nangma tungah thuumna kong bawl uh hi.
Ka lungkim lohnate uh Na mai-ah kong sungkhia uh a, Nangma kiangah ka gentheihnate kong gen uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka sung uh ah ka lungsim uh a zawm hi. Hi hi, ka lampite uh a theipa Nang na hi a, ka lampi totna uh ah amaute in kote thang hong siahsim uh hi.
Ka taklam hong en inla, hong mu in: kuamah in kote hong kin lo a, belh ding ka nei kei uh a, kuamah in kote hong don lo hi.
Yahweh aw, nangma tungah kong kiko uh hi, “Nangmah ka bukna na hi a, a nungtate’ gam sungah kote’ sehtanh na hi hi!” ka ci uh hi.
Kote hong kiniam koih lua mahmah ahih manin ka kikona uh hong ngai in. Ko hong bawlsiate kiang panin hong honkhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh ko sangin amaute thahatzaw uh hi.
Nangma Min ka phat theih nadingun thong panin kote hong paikhiatpih in. Tua ciangin kote tungah nong limbawlna hangin thumaan mite in kote kiim ah hong kikhawm ding uh hi.

headings.text: Ka Pai Nading Lampi Hong Theisak In

verses.text: Yahweh aw, ka thungetna uh hong za inla, ka thuumna uh hong ngai in! Nangma cihtakna tawh kote hong dawng in! Na thumaanna tawh hong dawng in!
Nangma muhna ah a nungta mihingte a thutang khat beek om lo ahih manin Na nasemte tungah thukhenna hong thuaksak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka galte in kote hong bawlsia-in, ka nuntakna uh leilak ah hong tuancil uh a, sawtpek-a a site bangin mun mial sungah kote hong tengsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka cih nading ka thei nawn kei uh a, ka sung uh ah ka lungsim uh cimawh hi.
Tanglai hunte ka phawk uh a, Nangma nasepnate khempeuh lungngaingai-in Na khut-a na nasepna ka ngaihsun uh hi.
Nangma kiangah ka khut uh kong zankhia uh hi; a dangtaak gam in tui a lunggulh bangin Nang kong lunggulh uh hi. Selah.
Yahweh aw, ka kha uh zawmta ahih manin manlangin kote hong dawng in! Ko kiang panin Na maitang seel kei in; tua bang hileh gum sungah a kiasukte tawh ka kibang ding uh hi.
Nangmah hong muang ka hih manun zingsangin na itna kip hong zasak in! Ka lungsim uh Nangma kiang hong domto ka hih manun kote pai nading lampi hong theisak in.
Yahweh aw, nangma sungah kibu ka hih manun ka galte uh kiang panin kote hong honkhia in!1
Nangmah in kote Pa hi na hih manin Nangma deihna banga gamta dingin kote hong hilh in! Na Kha in thumaan a, tua ahih ciangin thutang mite gam sungah kote hong makaih hi!
Yahweh aw, Na Min na khualna-in kote hong nungtasak in! Na thumaanna na khualna-in lunggimna panin hong lakhia in!
Na itna kip hangin ka galte na khenkhia ding hi. Ko hong bawlsiate khempeuh na susia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote pen Na nasemte ka hi uh hi.
Ka khutte, galdozia ding leh ka khutmete galsimzia ding a hilh, kote Thahatpa Yahweh, nang hong kiphat tahen;
Amah pen eite nuai-ah minamte a koihpa, eite tungah hehpih-itna kip hong neipa leh eite bukna, i tausang leh i kihotkhiatna, i lum leh bukna-in i neihpa ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, na phawk tham dingin mihing bang hi a, na ngaihsut tham dingin mihing’ tapa bang hilel ahi hiam?
Mi pen a khiatna nei lopi tawh kibang a, ama nuntak nite pen a kikhin dandan niliim tawh kibang hi.
Yahweh aw, na vantungte niamsak inla, hong tuaksuk in; mual liante lawng inla, mei khusak in.
Khuaphialep sawl inla, ka galte uh taikeksak in! Na khuaphialep thaltangte kap inla, amaute zogawp in!
A sangna panin Na khut zankhia in! Tui tampite leh gamdang mite khut panin suakta sak inla, hong khahkhia in;
Amau kamte in kiphatsak kam paukhia a, a taklam khut uh zong a zuautat khut taklam ahi hi.
Yahweh aw, nangma tungah lathak kong sa ding uh hi! Harp zangsawm khausai tumin nang tungah phatna kong sa ding uh hi;
Nang pen kumpite tungah hotkhiatna a piapa, sih theihna namsau panin Na nasempa David a honkhiapa na hi hi.
A kam-un kiphatsak kam a pau, a taklam khut uh a zuautat khut taklam ahi, gamdang mite khut panin kote hong suakta sak inla, hong khahkhia in—
Tua hileh ka tapate uh a khangno lai-in a khang cing kungte bang thei ding uh a, ka tanute uh kumpi inn lam nadinga a kisui innkiu khuampite bang ding uh hi;
Ka saalte uh an namkim tawh dim ding a, ka tuute uh tul tampi leh tulsawm tampi-in, ka lo sung uh ah pung ding hi;
Ka bawngtalte uh vangik a pua dingin thahat ding uh a, kulh vanna mun om loin, sal-a kikai zong om lo ding a, kongzing lakah lunggimin a kap zong omlo ding hi.
Hih bang tawh a kituak mite mi lungdam hi a, Yahweh pen Pa-in a nei mite mi nuamsa ahi hi!

headings.text: Thuman tawh Yahweh a Zong Mite Amah in Neh Hi

verses.text: Kote’ Pa Kumpipa aw, nang kong tawisang ding uh hi! Nangma Min a tawntungin ka phat den ding uh hi!
Ni simin Nang kong phat ding uh a, Nangma Min a tawntungin ka phat den ding uh hi.
Yahweh aw, Nang na lian hi, nakpi taka phat ding na hi hi! Nangma liatna in ngaihsut zawh ding hi lo hi!
Khang khat in khanggui zom khat tungah Nangma nasepte phat ding uh a, a vanglian na bawl nate kigengen ding hi.
Nangma thupitna minthangin a liatna leh a lamdang Na nasepte ka lungngaingai ding uh hi.
Kote in a lipkhaphuai na sepnate a vangliatna ka gen ding uh a, Nangma liatna ka tangko ding uh hi!
Na sianthona lianpi a kiphawkna ka sungkhia ding uh a, Na thumaanna lianpi la-in ka sa ding uh hi!
Yahweh dikin hehpihna tawh kidim a, hehhakin, itna kip lianpi a nei hi.
Mi khempeuh tungah Yahweh dik a, ama bawlsa na khempeuh tungah ama hehpihna honpite a om hi!
Yahweh aw, Na bawlsa na khempeuh in nang hong phat ding uh a, Na misiangte in Nang hong phat ding uh hi!
Na misiangte in Na kumpigam minthanna tangko-in Na vangliatna genkhia ding uh hi—
Yahweh aw, tua in Na vanglian nasepnate leh Na kumpigam a thupit mahmahna, mite’ tapate in a theih nading uh ahi hi.
Nangma kumpigam in tawntung kumpigam hi a, Nangmah in khang tawntungin na uk hi!
Yahweh aw, mi khempeuh mittang in lametna tawh Nang hong en uh a, a hunhun-in amaute an na pia hi.
Nangmah in Na khutpeek zalkhia-in, nuntakna nei khempeuh in a lunggulhna uh ah lungkimna na pia hi.
Yahweh pen Ama lampite khempeuh ah thumaan a, Ama nasepnate khempeuh siangtho hi.
Yahweh in Amah a sam mite khempeuh, thuman tawh Amah a sam khempeuh-te kiang a neh hi.
Yahweh in Amah a zahtak mite’ deihna sepsak ding a, amau kikona za-in amaute a hu ding hi.
Yahweh in Amah a itte khempeuh dal a, ahih hangin Amah in migilote khempeuh susia ding hi.
Tu-in i kamte in Yahweh’ phatna gengen a, mihing khempeuh in a tawntungin Ama Min siangtho phat ding uh hi!
Halleluyah! Kote’ hinna aw, Yahweh phat un!
I nuntak sungin Yahweh i phat ding hi! Nuntakna i neih lai-in i Pa tungah phatna late i sa ding hi!
Uliante muanin nei kei inla, amaute sungah huhna a om lo mihing’ tapate zong muang kei un.
A hu in amah a nusiat ciangin amah pen lei ah ciah a, tua ni mahmah-in ama ngaihsutnate bei hi.
Yaaqob’ Pa pen ama huhpa-in a nei mipa mi nuamsa hi a, ama lametna pen Yahweh a Pa sungah om hi.
Amah pen vantung leh leitung, tuipite leh a sunga om khempeuh a bawlpa, a tawntungin thuman a keempa,
a kinengniam mite aa dingin thutangin thu a khenpa, gilkialte tungah an a piapa ahi hi. Yahweh in thongkiate a suaktasak hi!
Yahweh in mittawte’ mit honsak a, a kiniamsak mite a lamto hi! Yahweh in thumaan mite it hi!
Yahweh in peemtate keem hi! Amah in pa nei lote leh meigongte noptuamna a pia hi; ahih hangin Amah in migilote lampi a lumlet gawpsak hi.
Yahweh in a tawntungin uk ding hi—Zion aw, nangma Pa in khang tawntungin uk ding hi. Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!

headings.text: Amah a Zahtak Mite tungah Yahweh Lungkim

verses.text: Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Bang hang hiam cihleh i Pa tungah phatna la sak ding a hoih ahi hi. Phatna sak ding nuam a, zong a kilawm ahi hi.
Yahweh in Yerusalem khuapi lam a, Amah in a kinilkhia Israyl-te a kaikhawm hi.
Amah in lungsim tamzante damsak a, amau liammate a khuituah hi.
Amah in aksite a phazah ding seh a, a vekpi-in amau min ciatin a sam hi.
I Pa lian hi! Vanglian-in thahat a, Ama thu theihtelna in mong nei lo hi!
Yahweh in a kiniamkhiat mite lamto a, ahih hangin migilote lei a denna hi.
Yahweh tungah lungdamkohna tawh la sa un! I Pa tungah harp khausai tawh phatna late sa un!
Amah pen vantungte meii tawh a tuampa, leitung-a dingin guah a zusakpa, mualte tungah lopa a posakpa ahi hi.
Yahweh in gamsate tungah a an ding pia a, a ham va-ak note an a pia hi.
Yahweh in sakol’ thahatna ah nuam a sa hi lo a, mihing’ khe ah zong a lungkim hilo hi.
Amah a zahtak mite sungah Yahweh lungkim a, Ama hehpihna a lamen mite sungah a lungkim hi.
Yerusalem aw, Yahweh phat in! Zion aw, nangma Pa phat in!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in na kulh kongpi zawlte khauhsak khin a, nangma laizang-a om na tate thupha piakhin hi!
Yahweh in nangma gamgite sunglam ah kilemna omsak a, mangbuh limcipente tawh nang hong taisak hi.
Yahweh in Ama Thukham leitung ah puak a, Ama thu manlang takin a tung hi.
Yahweh in tuumul bangin vuuk hong pia a, vut bangin vuuk-paak thehthang hi.
Yahweh in moh themneng bangin a gial hong zusak hi! Ama votna mai-ah kua ding zo ding ahi hiam?
Yahweh in thu pia-in, tuate a tuisuak hi; Yahweh in Ama huih nungsak a, tuite a luang hi.
Yahweh in Yaaqob tungah Ama Thukham gen a, Israyl tungah Ama ngeina kipte leh a thukhennate a gen hi!
Yahweh in minam dang kuamah aa dingin hih thu sem lo a, minam khat kuamah in Ama Thukhennate thei ngei lo uh hi! Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!
Halleluyah! Vantungte panin Yahweh phat un! A sangna munte panin Yahweh phat un!
Ama vantungmi khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un! Ama aa a honpi khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un!
Ni leh kha aw, Yahweh phat un! No a tang aksi khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un!
No vantungte’ vantungte, no vantungte’ tunga tuite aw, Yahweh phat un.
Amaute in Yahweh Min phat tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in thupia-in amaute a kipiangsak hi!
Amah in amaute a tawntungin phutkip khin a, Amah in a beimang lo ding thukip khat zong a bawlkhin hi.
No a lian Tanin leh a thukpite khempeuh aw, leitung panin Yahweh phat un.
Meikuang leh gial, vuuk leh meii, Ama kammal a tangtungsak huihpi!
Mual liante leh mualneute khempeuh, gah nei singkungte leh tamtak kungte khempeuh;
gamsate leh ganhonte khempeuh, awmtal ganhingte leh a leeng vasate;
leitung kumpite leh minamte khempeuh; uliante leh leitung thukhente khempeuh;
tangvalte leh nungakte, khanghamte leh naupangte—
Amaute in Yahweh Min phat tahen! Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh Min khat beek kiliansak a, Ama minthanna leitung leh vantung-te tunglam ah om hi!
Yahweh in a mite aa dingin Kumpi khat khangsak khin a—Ama misiangte khempeuh aa ding, Israyl mite aa ding leh Amah a naih mite aa dingin Thumaan Khuavak ahi hi. Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!
Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Yahweh tungah lathak sa un! Misiangte kikhopna ah Yahweh phatna sa un!
Amaute a Bawl Yahweh sungah Israyl lungdam hen! Zion’ tate amau Kumpipa sungah lungdam hen!
Laamna tawh Ama Min phat tahen! Yahweh tungah khuang leh harp khausai tawh phatna late sa uh hen!
Ama mite sungah Yahweh lungkim ahih manin Amah in a kiniamkhiat mite hotkhiatna tawh zeem ding hi!
Minthanna tawh misiangte kipaak uh henla, a lupna tung uh ah nakpi-in la sa uh hen!
Nakpi-in Yahweh phatnate amau kam sungah om henla, amau khut sungah langnih hiam namsau om ta hen,
tua in minamte tungah phula-in mite tungah dantatna a sep nading,
sikkual tawh a kumpite uh hencipin, a uliante uh sik hennate tawh a hen nading,
amaute tungah a kigelhsa thukhennate a kithuaksak nading ahi hi—Yahweh’ misiangte khempeuh in hih pahtawina a nei uh hi. Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un!

headings.text: Husang Khempeuh in Yahweh Phat Un!

verses.text: Halleluyah! Yahweh phat un! Ama munsiangtho ah Yahweh phat un! A thahat Ama vantungte ah Yahweh phat un!
A nasep lianpite hangin Yahweh phat un! Teh theih loh a liatna tawh kizui-in Yahweh phat un!
Tuu’ ki peengkul aw tawh Yahweh phat un! Lyre leh harp khausai tawh Yahweh phat un!
Laamna leh khuang tawh Yahweh phat un! Khausai tumgingte leh tamngaite tawh Yahweh phat un!
Daltuah aw ngaih tawh Yahweh phat un! Daltuah a eute tawh Yahweh phat un!
Nuntakna a nei khempeuh aw, Yahweh phat un! Halleluyah!
